nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sweet! I'm armed!
At the bottom of the slide, Ben sees two groups of Centerscore students forming around two large crates, one left, one right.
On the left...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Paintball guns!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm armed and ready for the party!
Ryan reaches the bottom of the slide behind Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Outta the way!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Go!
Ryan gives Ben a hard shove in the back!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben slams into the slide headfirst and tumbles down! When he reaches the bottom...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ow... I think I left most of my skin on the slide...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You only live once!
Ben leaps onto the slide, gliding swiftly down!
Justin powers on his own megaphone...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's almost time to start. Let's go over some rules...
Erik raises his arms with joy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I love rules! They're just above 'regulations' on my favorite things list!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: In about five minutes, a bell will sound, and we will enter the arena via this ladder behind me.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The Spartans will be entering several hundred yards away.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The game is paintball. If you get hit by a paintball, you're out.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And don't even `think` about cheating! This whole estate is covered with hundreds of security cameras!
nodes.text_bbcode: And don't even [color=#e23b3b][i]think[/i][/color] about cheating! This whole estate is covered with hundreds of security cameras!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait... I hate to break it to you, Justin, but none of us have guns!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Or ammo!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or paint!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I've been told that everything you need will be available inside the arena.
A few of the Spartans stifle laughter...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: But who cares about that? Let me remind you what's at stake!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The last Spartan standing gets ultimate power, all the chicks he wants, and his own personal helicopter!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Sick!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What? That's not what we discussed at all!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The last one standing `actually` gets to decide how to use the $100,000 prize for the school!
nodes.text_bbcode: The last one standing [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] gets to decide how to use the $100,000 prize for the school!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: So... Pretty much exactly what I said! Power, chicks, helicopter! The big three! Now come on Spartans!
The Spartans leave, sprinting around the perimeter of the arena toward their entry point.
As soon as they're gone, the bell sounds!
The Centerscore crowd surges toward the ladder! Ben gets shoved forward!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He's pushed toward the ladder! He climbs, following the people in front of him up to...
The top of an enormous slide!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Gulp!` Long way down!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gulp![/i][/color] Long way down!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hurry up, dummy!
The Centerscore half of the crowd erupts with laughter.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha! His mom!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Again? Really? What information do you guys have about my mom?
The laughter continues.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Quiet down! Have any of you actually met Chad's mom? She's a Senator!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Why are you laughing?! Is there something funny about her?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean, besides her face?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! `Face!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! [color=#e23b3b][i]Face![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice one, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The best insults are the ones they don't get!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Really? `Spartan's` going to lose the `Spartan` Games?
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan's[/i][/color] going to lose the [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan[/i][/color] Games?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Maybe you didn't hear me just now. These games are being held `on Carson's father's estate...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you didn't hear me just now. These games are being held [color=#e23b3b][i]on Carson's father's estate...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Does that count as a home field advantage? I believe it does!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Burn! Backbutter confirms!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What did I say about talking, Mark?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Do you still think someone from Centerscore's going to win?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah! That's what I thought.
On the perimeter of a vast, enclosed estate, students from Centerscore and Spartan gather around the two Presidents, Justin and Chad.
In the growing crowd around them, Ben nudges his way through, finally settling beside Taylor, Brendan, and the rest of the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can you believe it, Brendan? Everyone is here for the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... It's incredible.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you think we have a chance?
Brendan awkwardly glances away, clearly trying to avoid talking to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Is something wrong?
Taylor leans across Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, Brendan happens to be a nice guy... And I get that you're all, like, `hot` now or whatever...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Brendan happens to be a nice guy... And I get that you're all, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]hot[/i][/color] now or whatever...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But get a clue! We don't talk to `anyone` who abandons friends for popularity the way you did!
nodes.text_bbcode: But get a clue! We don't talk to [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone[/i][/color] who abandons friends for popularity the way you did!

nodes.text: Taylor pulls the nerds back into the crowd, away from Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that just Taylor talking... Or do the guys think I abandoned them too?
Chad powers on a megaphone...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Welcome, Spartans and losers, to Carson's father's estate!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: In just a few moments, the Spartan Games will begin!
All the Spartan guys hoot and holler!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What's this? A lack of enthusiasm from Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Heh. It's probably because you guys already know you're going to lose!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Grrr!
$ZOE steadies herself!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Found my footing!
She takes one step and then another...
When she nearly slips again, she rights herself, and soon she is halfway across!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm doing it! I'm really doing it!
Behind her, the cheerleaders try to follow her lead.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh... Don't look down... Don't look down...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Isn't that what you do when you're high up?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm not going to stand here and watch my white shoes pick up river mud. I can't! And I won't!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I see a fish!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is so lame...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm out here... Crossing a river... Getting everything dirty and... And...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh!
Jessica loses her footing on the rock just ahead of $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Watch it!
Jessica topples into the water.
A moment later, she emerges and tries to rise unsteadily to her feet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here, take my hand.
Jessica takes $ZOE's hand and makes her way back onto the rocks.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just glad you're okay!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was a 'thank you', not an award. Geez. Stop being so cheerful.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Move out!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: They found us! The Spartans have found us!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda! Save yourself! Save yourself!
Jessica and $ZOE turn to look. They see Chad and a bunch of Spartan boys ruthlessly shoot down Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You may have taken Nicole, but you won't get Amanda!
Hector jumps in front of his girlfriend, as another volley fires!
He lands on the ground splattered in paint.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go on without me, babe...
Amanda backs up, her hands brought up to the side of her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm saying I'm tired of your flack and your getting us into trouble, and I want you out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... I'm the one that led you guys here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'm not grateful, so scram.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't toss me out of the group!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure I can! I'm the captain, remember?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, fine! I'm leaving you guys anyway!
$ZOE picks up her gun and runs into the forest.
Away from the girls, she can feel tears prick at her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Think they can survive without me?! I'd like to see them try!
$ZOE plunges deeper into the forest. When she looks up again, she's hopelessly lost.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where... Where am I?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: About to be taken out!
From behind a tree, Chad steps out and points his gun at $ZOE.
He shoots!
And a paintball mark appears in the middle of $ZOE's chest.
Oh no! $ZOE has failed!
But she can't leave the Spartan Games now!
Try again and see if you can prevent Jessica from kicking her out!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Jessica pulls $ZOE aside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What did you want to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, it's been kind of a stressful day.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't like being shot at, getting separated from my boyfriend, or running in the wilderness with every bug, river, and clod of dirt thrown in my way.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I especially don't like you trying to take over the squad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... So?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Even if I don't like it... I have to admit that I'm not as good at this `nature` and `survival` thing as you are...
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if I don't like it... I have to admit that I'm not as good at this [color=#3b78e2][i]nature[/i][/color] and [color=#3b78e2][i]survival[/i][/color] thing as you are...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, I just wanted to say 'thanks' and to tell you that, for now, I'll listen to you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But don't think I'll tolerate it when we're in school again and things are back to normal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course not.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You think we can win these games?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...
$ZOE is suddenly interrupted by loud shouts in the distance!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole? You really think Nicole's our best bet?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Hector and Amanda would probably just make out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not going to lie... That probably would have happened.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Really? You'd do that here?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, we're fleeing for our fake lives here. Tensions are running high, girlfriends are wanting to be kissed...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Point taken. Okay, Nicole. Stay here with Hector.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Aw, come on... My hair's ruined, my makeup rubbed off, and my feet are tired.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No one said you had to stand up to stand guard.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Besides, you'll get the chance to tan when you're done.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I guess.
Nicole and Hector sit facing the entrance to the woods, their guns at the ready.
Amanda wanders down to the lake to dip her toes in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure. I don't really care. Amanda and Hector, go stand guard over there.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure thing, Captain.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, I was thinking... This might be a good time for you to show me that lip thing again...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And again, baby!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, no way! Don't you two spend the whole time making out!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No... Not the `whole` time!
nodes.text_bbcode: No... Not the [color=#e23b3b][i]whole[/i][/color] time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tee hee...
They run off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's like we're not even at war...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah really.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, I'm off to tan!
Nicole wanders down to the lake and plops down in the warm sand.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Everybody, come here and huddle!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Everybody, come here and huddle![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nicole, Amanda, and Hector come back and crowd around Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As much as I hate to admit it, $ZOE's right about the Spartans. They're still after us.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awww... No tanning?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I didn't say that, did I?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We can swim and tan, but... We need to set up a guard or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But we should probably have two just in case.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine. Who else wants to sit with Hector? Any volunteers?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh, I un-volunteer...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I want to build a sand castle...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can do it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No. I need to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, then I really think it should be....

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Jessica, but that's not a good idea. The Spartans are still hunting us!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should at least set up a guard or...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wasn't `asking` for your opinion, was I?
nodes.text_bbcode: I wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]asking[/i][/color] for your opinion, was I?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: In fact, I don't think anyone here was interested in what you had to say, were they?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, no one said anything, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I said before that `I'm still in charge!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I said before that [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm still in charge![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So I'd appreciate it if you kept your negative comments to yourself.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're getting totes annoying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I shouldn't have said anything...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I was about to say...
$ZOE waits.
Jessica looks from the beach to the woods to the beach and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you think, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm asking what you think. About now. About us being here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, this is as good a spot as any to make camp.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're better protected here. With the water behind us, the only spot we'd have to really watch is the path we came on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As long as a couple people stand guard, we can relax... For now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... Okay... Maybe you're not just full of `lame` ideas.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't get too excited.
Jessica calls out to the other cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Stop, you guys!
$ZOE loses her balance and tilts over! She makes a grab for something, anything...
And latches onto Jessica's arm!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Stop it! Don't do that! I can't...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Aaaaaaaah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aaaaaaaah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: They both topple into the river!
A moment later, Jessica rises unsteadily to her feet in the moving water and splashes $ZOE who falls back down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This... Is all... Your fault!
Jessica slips again.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can help! Hang on!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay!
Amanda puts a hand on Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not you, Manda-Panda... Though this is nice...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A little help here?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Here, Jessica, take my hand.
Hector pulls her up.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Here, $ZOE... Take hold of my hand!
$ZOE takes Amanda's hand and gets back on the rocks. The cheerleaders cross the river at last.
On land, Jessica angrily wrings out her wet clothes and glares at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Next time you feel like taking a dive, leave me out of it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Move out!
The cheerleaders find the river and follow its meandering path through the woods.
Eventually they come up to a place where raging river rapids block the path.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We can't go any further.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, I knew this was a bad idea! We should have gone the other way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Calm down...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No way! I'm mad! Now we have to go back!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, we don't. I see a sloping path down to the bottom on the other side of the river.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All we have to do is cross.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Are you joking? I'm wearing white sneakers!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No way am I stepping into any part of `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No way am I stepping into any part of [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, maybe we shouldn't cross `here`, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, maybe we shouldn't cross [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color], but...

nodes.text: Jessica points at the roiling water of the river. The water streams quickly by, picking up speed as it approaches the rapids' crest.
$ZOE looks upstream and sees a wider, calmer part of the river where stepping stones are clearly available. She runs to it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Up here! We can cross here! The water's not too deep.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh goodie.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Does someone want to carry me across? I'd be their best friend forever...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No way.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're already my second-in-command. I don't need you to be more.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now move aside, $ZOE. If we're crossing this river, all of you are going to be behind me!
Jessica cautiously steps onto the first rock, then the second, and so on... The other cheerleaders follow.
$ZOE goes next. She takes one tentative step... And loses her footing on the mossy rocks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is a faster river than I thought!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Being near water is our best chance at surviving.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: How do you even know that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I may have read it somewhere... But just think about all the running we're doing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If we're in the Spartan Games for more than a day, we'll need to find a water source anyway.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm getting thirsty just thinking about water.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I guess I am too...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, we can't go back into the forest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The Spartan boys are there, and they seem to know the forest pretty well.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If they're as experienced at this as they say they are, they have an advantage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll be easier for us if we can see them coming, and I think having water at our backs would help.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But... But what about the people we left behind? Like Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to find my boyfriend too, but we can't right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if we get caught now, we won't be able to help either of them.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think $ZOE's right.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And I think Ben can handle himself.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Fine.` Let's go with `$ZOE's` `perfect` plan.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Fine.[/i][/color] Let's go with [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE's[/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color] plan.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We follow the river.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I knew it! You just suggested water so you could get back to your boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's part of the reason, but... But...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No. We're going with my plan.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All we need to do is get back into the forest, find Ben, and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, is this whole plan to go back into the scary forest with all the evil Spartan just `your` way of looking for `your` boyfriend?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, is this whole plan to go back into the scary forest with all the evil Spartan just [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] way of looking for [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's not the reason!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, maybe it's `part` of the reason...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, maybe it's [color=#3b78e2][i]part[/i][/color] of the reason...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But only, like, three-fourths!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Ahhhh!` Fractions!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhh![/i][/color] Fractions!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Enough! Ladies, listen!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Instead of trying to find boyfriends...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What about just finding a safe place to hang out?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I like $ZOE's water idea...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Only because all that running made me thirsty.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And isn't water one of the things we need anyway if we're going to be out here for a while?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But what about Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure Ben will figure something out. He's very resourceful.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You `would` say that.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]would[/i][/color] say that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, but she's right. Ben will be okay. But we won't be unless we get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Fine.` Let's follow the river.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Fine.[/i][/color] Let's follow the river.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Uh... For Howard?
After many tense, breathless minutes, the forest opens up.
The cheerleaders find themselves in another section of the estate, this part a picturesque, well-manicured lawn.
They rush into a protected gazebo and catch their breaths.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We made it! We're in the clear!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait, is that a good thing?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Please tell me we can just stop running now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. We'll rest here for a minute, but then we're leaving. The Spartan boys won't quit, and...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing, I'm just saying...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're not just 'saying' anything. You're `ordering` the squad around.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not just 'saying' anything. You're [color=#3b78e2][i]ordering[/i][/color] the squad around.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I shouldn't have to remind you that even if we're in the middle of frikkin' nowhere, I'm `still` Cheer Captain, and that means I'm in charge!
nodes.text_bbcode: I shouldn't have to remind you that even if we're in the middle of frikkin' nowhere, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] Cheer Captain, and that means I'm in charge!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... Captain.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Obviously, we can't stay here. The boys will catch up to us.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: So where do we go?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Let me think a minute...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We don't have time to 'think for a minute'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need to find Howard, but where would he be?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Water! Where there are ducks, there's Howard. And there's a good chance Sam might be there too... Which means we need to find a lake or something!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay girls, here's the plan. Normally in a crisis like this, I go to the mall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But there is no mall...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know that! So I propose that we go back into the forest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because I said so!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, I don't think that's a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And what do you suggest?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We need to head for water. I think I saw a rushing stream where we were running.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If we follow it, we might be able to find a lake or someplace we can set up a camp!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How is going towards water any better than going into the woods?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... We need to get to water...
$ZOE makes to tackle Carson, but stumbles!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I won't make it in time!
She watches helpless as Carson levels the gun at Hector's chest with a good-natured smile.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Sorry, old chap...
At that moment, an Amazonian war cry can be heard throughout the forest!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What's... What's that?!
Amanda hurtles out from behind a tree and body slams Carson!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No one touches my Hecky-Wecky!
Hector turns to Carson.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ha! Now the tables have turned, haven't they?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You want some paint to go with that smarmy smile?
Hector starts to shoot Carson when paint pellets explode near his head!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There are still some people behind us! Run!
They all sprint away!
$ZOE dashes after them before Carson can fully recover.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, you don't!
$ZOE bursts forward with renewed speed and tackles Carson to the ground, right before he pulls the trigger!
Paintballs released from the gun spray up in the air like a fountain!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Got him!
When they hit the ground, $ZOE rolls free of Carson and onto her feet!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE.
Hector turns to Carson.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ha! Now the tables have turned, haven't they?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You want some paint to go with that smarmy smile?
Hector starts to shoot Carson when paint pellets explode near his head!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There are still some people behind us! Run!
They all sprint away!
$ZOE freezes!
$ZOE runs ahead and sees the remaining cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Some people did make it!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We're almost out of the woods! My mall sense is tingling!
Just as Nicole says those words, Carson steps out from around a tree!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `Ahhhh!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhh!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Ahhhh!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhh!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `You!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hector, fancy meeting you here.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I refuse to be killed by this sham of a guy!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: That's too bad.
Carson raises his paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Because you're about to.
$ZOE ducks her head and runs in the opposite direction, weaving around trees for cover.
Paintballs slap color onto the trees around her, but $ZOE remains untouched!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was close!
Behind her, $ZOE hears the cries of her fellow cheerleaders as they go down.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Noooo!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Noooo!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `This shirt is brand new!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]This shirt is brand new![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Keith... I'll always remember you!
$ZOE trips and tumbles to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhh! No!
$ZOE manages to roll to her feet, but Preston is close to her.
He levels his gun... He aims...
And just as he squeezes the trigger, Keith steps into his line of fire and gets shot!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Noooo!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Noooo!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `This shirt is brand new!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]This shirt is brand new![/i][/color]

nodes.text: While Keith bitterly walks off the grounds, $ZOE takes the opportunity to run deeper into the forest!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought he had me!
Fallen leaves and dry twigs snap beneath her feet as she rushes through the forest.
In the chaos, it's hard to see anything save the girls beside her or the trees whipping past.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We're... Huff... Outpacing Chad... Huff... I think!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just Chad? Where are his henchmen?
And that's when $ZOE sees a shadowy figure moving around in the trees!
The figure jumps out, brandishing his weapon!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Got you now!
$ZOE banks left, cutting into a cluster of trees and yelling behind her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Watch out! There's a Spartan on the right!
$ZOE hears the whirring of a paintball gun as it spits out a magazine of ammo!
$ZOE changes course at the last second, avoiding the web entirely!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank goodness!
She runs on.
She plunges into the web! Instantly, sticky tendrils cling to her hair and face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Eeeeeek!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Eeeeeek![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gross gross gross gross!
She tears at her face, whipping the web aside as she tries to run straight.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Way to not alert the Spartans...
$ZOE can't stop herself in time!
Now that you've seen what Ben's been up to, we're going to take a look at how $ZOE is faring.
Rewinding back to when the Spartan ambush started...
As more Spartans crest over the hill, all of Centerscore scatters!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: $ZOE?! $ZOE?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Howard?! Where are you?!
In the rush, Jessica and the cheerleaders get swept away from Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! Ben!
Jessica starts to turn back for him, but $ZOE grabs her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on! You'll get shot if you go back!
$ZOE pulls Jessica away, and the two girls regroup with the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]RUN!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The cheerleading squad runs like a pack of gazelles!
Back at the start, Chad and a group of Spartan boys watch them.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! They should have split up.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hunting them down as a large group will be easier than shooting pigeons in the dark...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Is that... A thing you do?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Shut up, Carson.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Let's get down to chasing these girls. They're cheerleaders. Easy pickings.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Spartans, to me! We're going to hunt them down!
The Spartans assemble behind Chad. Chad turns to Carson and Preston.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You two, hold up a minute...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yes, boss?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Take the shortcut in the woods to get ahead of them. We'll send them your way, and you finish the job. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: The pincer attack?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The pincer attack. Now move out!
Meanwhile, in the forest, $ZOE and the cheerleaders run frantically!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Can we stop running now?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, I hate... Huff... Running! It's messing up my hair!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Mine too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Run run run!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The Spartans are out there, and Howard's all by himself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Sam... I hope she's okay too... But if I'm going to see both of them, I have to live through this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We keep moving! They aren't that far behind us!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How can you be so sure?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, I can't even hear them.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Surely they've given up by now...
Keith slows down, and all the other cheerleaders follow suit.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Keep moving!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And just who died and made you the boss of us?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not the boss of anyone! I just don't think we're safe...
Suddenly, the whizzing of paintballs cuts $ZOE off!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Eeek!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Eeek!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Paint!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Paint![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Keep your head low and run!
$ZOE sprints away from the paintballs, the other cheerleaders following her lead.
As $ZOE plunges further into the wooded area, she glances back and sees Chad falling behind them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe we can outrun him!
When $ZOE turns to look straight ahead, she sees a large spider's web stretched across two tree trunks!

nodes.text: Sam runs through the forest, feeling the spray of the river on her face as she rushes past trees and bushes.
Just ahead, she can see Chad, Carson, and Preston.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just a little faster!
At last, the three boys are only a few yards ahead of her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just need to stand my ground and shoot...
Sam stops and aims her gun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha! Eat paint!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're turning on me? After everything we've been through?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry I have to do this...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I suppose this kind of betrayal was inevitable.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We all have to make sacrifices during wartime.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's just... I thought we had something special...
Sam pulls the trigger...
And hits Zach over Nick's shoulder!
Nick glances behind him and sees Zach clutching the paintball splatter on his stomach.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sam! How could you?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It was perfect! I was still in the game!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But you had paint on you!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I tipped over a can of paint in a supply room, so it didn't count.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Wow, this blows! I had the perfect plan!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, Zach. Sometimes we have to make sacrifices.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: When you said that, I thought you were...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Talking to you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe a little bit.
Zach trudges away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad to see the knock on the head didn't hurt him too much.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you mean what you said about us having something special?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I might have been overcome with emotion in a moment of doubt... It was purely self-preservation.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh. That's too bad... Because I had the same thought...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Must be the self-preservation talking.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Nick Brown. Let's clean up this mess.
Congratulations! You helped Sam navigate through some very tough spots, and it looks like she made a friend!
But what about the rest of the Centerscore contestants? Let's see what happened to Colt and Denni!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're turning on me? After everything we've been through?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick. It's just... I was thinking over what Jacob and the guys were saying.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I am Centerscore. And you are Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It just wasn't meant to be.
Sam squeezes the trigger and shoots Nick!
Nick puts a hand to his stomach where yellow paint has splattered.
He looks at Sam with hurt eyes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I thought... We got along so well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, Nick...
As Nick walks off, Zach pops up and shoots Sam!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha! For Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Zach! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You were consorting with the enemy, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And Phil said you came down with Stockholm whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It's better I take you out now.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Just in case you turn.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Those are zombies.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Exactly!
Sam stalks out of the cabin, her chances of winning the Spartan Games falling as fast as her tears.
Looks like Sam didn't trust the right people this time around!
Play again and see if you can make things right...
And keep in mind, once you pass Sam's section, you'll be able to see what happened to Colt and Denni!

nodes.text: Sam ducks!
Aimed too high, Phil's bullet whizzes over Sam's head, just as Sam's bullet takes Phil out!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry it came down to this, Phil.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Me too.
Phil's heads for the door. As he leaves, he looks at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I hope you're right about Nick.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Win this one for us.
As Phil leaves, Nick comes into the room.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I called the game judges. An evacuation team will be here in a few minutes to take care of Zach...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You look pleasantly paint-free.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just hope I'm doing the right thing.
Sam whips her pistol around and aims it at Nick Brown's head.
Sam jumps, but it doesn't matter!
Phil shoots high! His paintball hits Sam, just as Sam's hits Phil!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I'm out of the game!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: We both are...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who's going to win it for us now?
Sam freezes!
Phil's paintball hits Sam, just as Sam's hits Phil!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I'm out of the game!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: We both are...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who's going to win it for us now?
Sam enters the dining room once more, her gun ready in front of her.
When she rounds the corner, she comes face to face with Phil!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Agh!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Agh!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Phil, you scared me!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Likewise.
They both take stock of the situation. Sam and Phil point their paintball guns at one another warily.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Phil, I don't really think we want to do this.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: No, we don't.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So why don't you put your weapon down first...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Wait, why don't you go first?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We could put them down on the count of three...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Assuming you'd actually do it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, assuming `you'd` actually do it!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, assuming [color=#3b78e2][i]you'd[/i][/color] actually do it!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: My loyalty to the team isn't in question here!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Neither is mine!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Then why are you working with a Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because he's different! If he wins, he'll still take care of Centerscore. I don't mind defending him for that.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: He's really gotten to you, hasn't he? You're displaying all the classical signs of Stockholm Syndrome!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How many are there?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: One! And that's sympathy! You're defending him!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: If we can't come to a truce, it looks like we're going to have to settle this the old-fashioned way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How's that?
Phil levels his paintball gun at her at the same moment that Sam squeezes the trigger!
Nick nods.
Together, they walk quietly towards the couch, their weapons raised.
Sam and Nick are just about to look over the couch when Zach springs up!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: `Aaaaaaiiiiieeeeeee!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aaaaaaiiiiieeeeeee!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Found him!
Reflexively, Sam and Nick both shoot!
Zach ducks but hits his head on the hard back of the sofa.
He tumbles to the rug, paint covering his sleeves. He lies still on the floor at Sam's feet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Is he okay?
Nick checks Zach over.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I think... I think he knocked himself out when he hit the sofa.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But he's breathing. That's a good sign.
Suddenly, there's a noise from down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That must be our third guest. But we should probably deal with Zach first.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Deal with him how?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: In emergencies, you can call for an outside team to evacuate people. Just let me make a quick call...
Nick gestures to a phone on a desk in the den.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. I'll check out what that noise is.
Nick nods.
Together, they walk quietly towards the bathroom door, their weapons raised.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come out, come out, wherever you are...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'm right here, suckers!
From behind them, Zach bursts from the couch!
He charges at them like a large bull, two guns at the ready.
Paintballs fly everywhere!
Three of them hit Sam's arm, legs, and body...
One of them hits Nick in the face!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Owwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Owwww![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Nick!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That's right, punks! This cabin is ours now!
Sam and Nick get to their feet and sadly make their way off the grounds.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, that's too bad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. It really is.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But maybe there's hope. Maybe Centerscore has a chance of winning with these guys.
From outside, they can hear Zach hoot with joy.
The noise does nothing to comfort Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not so sure about that...
Sam freezes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, what are you doing? We should start searching the room...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He could be anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Or right here, suckers!
From behind them, Zach bursts from the couch!
He charges at them like a large bull, two guns at the ready.
Paintballs fly everywhere!
Three of them hit Sam's arm, legs, and body...
One of them hits Nick in the face!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Owwww!`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Nick!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That's right, punks! This cabin is ours now!
Sam and Nick get to their feet and sadly make their way off the grounds.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, that's too bad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. It really is.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But maybe there's hope. Maybe Centerscore has a chance of winning with these guys.
From outside, they can hear Zach hoot with joy.
The noise does nothing to comfort Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not so sure about that...
In the cabin's den, Sam and Nick find a window that's been jammed open.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-oh...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That can't be good.
Sam scans the room carefully. To her right is a bathroom door that's slightly ajar.
To her left is a large couch that an intruder could easily hide behind.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I wonder where he went...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shh...
She puts a finger to her lips and then points at the...
Sam shoots just as Jacob turns around, hitting him square in the chest!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What the...?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, Jacob, but it was either you or us.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: 'Us', huh?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You're sticking up for that Spartan loser?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you had listened to what I said before, you'd know that he's not all that bad!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You really like a Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I, uh... I didn't say anything like that, did I?
Jacob shakes his head and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You may have shot me, but more are coming.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We are legion!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You mean 'three'?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I said what I said.
Jacob leaves the room.
And that's when Sam and Nick hear shuffling noises from a different part of the house...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We should probably go investigate.
Sam tries to shoot him, but her clumsy grip on the handle stops her!
Jacob dives into a nearby closet before Sam can get another shot in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No!
Sam and Nick jump up and run toward the closet.
Just as they approach the door, Jacob jumps out and shoots them both!
Sam feels the pellet impact her bruised elbow before she sees its yellow hue splatter all over her clothes.
Beside her, Nick tries in vain to wipe some of the yellow paint off his black shirt.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yellow's never been my color.
Nick turns away and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why'd you shoot, Jacob?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Because you were going to shoot me.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Now if you don't mind... I believe this cabin is ours now.
Sam walks away, feeling more alone than ever.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Over here! Quick!
Sam and Nick slide behind the counter just as Jacob runs into the kitchen!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Where'd they go?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whew! Just in time!
Jacob runs just past the island...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now's my chance!
Sam pops up from behind the island and aims at Jacob's exposed back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For Centerscore!
She grabs Nick's hand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on! To the bedroom!
They run into the closest room and hide behind the bed.
From their spot, they can hear Jacob walking through the house.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I can see the open door to the bedroom, guys...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... We probably should have closed that.
Jacob runs into the room, shooting paintballs!
Sam and Nick duck behind the bed until Sam hears Jacob stop firing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now's my chance!
Sam pops up from behind the bed and aims.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...
Nick grabs her hand.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No time! Come on! To the bedroom!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let's just say I'm not opposed to actually using the money to improve the school.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: As head of the journalism club, I could use the money to get new camera equipment, better software... Maybe even a lab!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That doesn't necessarily sound like you're servicing the public good.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, don't underestimate the value of making keepsakes. Pictures are ways of capturing our memories.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: For better or worse, they can show us who we are and how we live our lives.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They're important.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, that's...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's actually kind of sweet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it totally makes my reasons for wanting to win sound selfish.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What are your reasons?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's a little complicated...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure I can handle it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Last year, I was voted a Homecoming Princess. At first, I hated it. I didn't think I could be Queen, so I tried to back out of it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But as the voting went on, I realized more and more that it was what I wanted. And I tried very hard to become the candidate that people could look up to.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: People said that I was the princess who inspired everyone to be true to themselves... So when I didn't win, it was pretty crushing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then the Spartan Games came up, and I thought maybe this was another chance at that. My second chance to win a crown.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that totally crazy? I mean, it's a crown.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, it's what the crown represents. Proof that you really tried for something and won it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow. Okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, Nick... I've never met someone who just gets me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But with you...
Sam meets Nick's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, I...
Suddenly, they're interrupted by a loud thud at the window!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What the...?
Outside stand Jacob, Phil, and Zach, their paintball guns primed and ready.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Come out, Spartan! We know you're inside!
Warily, Nick opens the window, purposefully leaving the screen intact.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: All right. I'll bite. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We want to win!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let me be more specific. What do you want right now?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Food.
Jacob shoulder checks Zach.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What we want is the cabin.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let me think...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Mmmmm, no. Sorry. It's taken.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And it's just so cozy here.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: If you won't come out and surrender peacefully, we'll take it by force!
Sam elbows Nick out of the way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sam? Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh no! Don't tell me you're being held prisoner!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That Spartan lowlife! We'll rescue you, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I'm not his prisoner! Nick is helping me. I don't think you should be attacking him.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What? But he's the enemy!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Wait, guys, I know what this is. It's Stockholm Syndrome!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What the heck is that?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sounds like something we need to kick that Spartan's butt for!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: It's when the person who's captured begins to feel sympathy for her captor. I read about it in a book.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: So it means we can't listen to what she's saying. She doesn't know better!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Good enough for me! Attack!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For the love of... I can't believe you guys!
Sam leaves the window.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: For Centerscore!
The boys run around the corner of the house, disappearing from view.
Inside, Nick closes the window. He goes to a chest near the door and pulls out a paint pistol and tosses it to Sam.
Sam awkwardly grips it in her left hand. She stares down at it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I should shoot him right now and get away. He's a `Spartan`.
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I should shoot him right now and get away. He's a [color=#3b78e2][i]Spartan[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But... Somehow I can't.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, I'm defending the cabin. I understand if you want to leave, but I don't advise going out right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up for a second, would you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam?
She points out another window.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're splitting up to look for an opening. They could come from anywhere, so it's better to be careful...
A thunderous crack erupts from the back of the house!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The back! It sounds like one of them broke the door off its hinges.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who's going to pay for that?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure Carson's family will manage.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Find cover!
Sam scans their available options.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We could hide behind the kitchen island or go into the bedroom...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, let's find cover...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Historically, the winner of the Spartan Games has had better luck with the girls...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But sadly, I don't have any girls that I want to impress.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Would `you` be impressed?
nodes.text_bbcode: Would [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] be impressed?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It'd be pretty awesome.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, maybe I have a new reason to win...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But the real reason is so that I can make a difference.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That sounds really cheesy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No. That's not what I want at all.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I've discovered that popular people aren't always that happy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: As a previously popular person, I can attest to that.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Then why'd you suggest it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It seems like a common goal.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I forgot you were uncommon.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The real reason is so that I can make a difference.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That sounds really cheesy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't put it like that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it's true?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yes, actually. As cheesy as that sounds.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you don't want to 'make a difference'...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How would you put it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh? What strategy is that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: My plan is to stay away from everyone else while the numbers whittle down.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Then when there's only a couple contestants left, I plan to swoop in and paint them off, thus ensuring my victory.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I've been in these games long enough to know how to keep out of everyone's way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But wait... I thought all of the Spartans were trying to help Chad win.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why are you against him?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Have you met the guy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, yeah. He's a jerk. But you did all go to school together.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I would never team up with Chad. He's an obtuse, self-centered idiot.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: When he and Percy were in charge at Spartan, they made my life horrendous.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And I hate to think of what they'd do if they got their hands on the money from these games.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's why I'm hoping my strategy works.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why do you want to win?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Why do you think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Everything's a guessing game with you, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Answering my questions with questions, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh fine. You want to win...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh really? How do you know this isn't one big trap?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because if you had wanted to shoot me, you would have done so already.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe I'm just waiting for you to let your guard down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My guard's already down.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Look at that. Didn't shoot.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Proves my point then.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You sure I'm not just trying to take you hostage?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think you could handle me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You might be surprised...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So you believe my intentions are good?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not entirely. But... I have a good gut feeling about you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: As the journalist slash head photographer for our distinguished newspaper, I always say that it's important to follow your gut.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It tells the best stories.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But really, you don't factor into any of my grand machinations. I already have a strategy for winning.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what is it then?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You planning on waiting until I let my guard down before you shoot me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Think about it... If I hadn't wanted to shoot you, I would have done it the minute you left yourself open.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Which was every moment we've been together because you are not carrying a paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, fine. If it's not that, then are you planning on taking me hostage and using me as a pawn in your game?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Calm down. There's no grand scheme. I just want to win.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Believe what you want, but just return my favor and don't shoot me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Besides, can't a guy be selfless?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So maybe I'm starting to come around. It's just... In my experience, guys don't really know what 'being selfless' is.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh. That sounds like a tragic romantic history waiting to be explored.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, isn't it a little bit true?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know. I just saw a beautiful girl in trouble and wanted to help.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, I really screwed that one up, huh?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know. It is flattering you think I'm that much of a military strategist, so I can't really fault you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Of course I already have a winning strategy without you factoring into it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I don't get it... You're still a Spartan. You have no reason to help me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: All those things are true. And I'd love to answer your questions, but...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's dangerous out here. Why don't we talk inside?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Inside?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Inside?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm staying in the cabin up this way. Come on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think I can trust him... But maybe this cabin he has will be useful...
In the cabin, Sam sits at a table while Nick rummages around for a first aid kit.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: His back is turned... Here's my chance! I can grab his gun...
Sam shifts towards his gun which is sitting on the sofa nearby when Nick turns around.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You'd think a cabin like this would have all the amenities...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But all I can see are cappuccino machines, fancy cups, and expensive pouches of hot chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Though speaking of which... You want some?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hot chocolate? This is a paintball war, not high tea.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't hear a 'no'.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just don't poison it on your way over. We're supposed to be enemies in all this.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I wouldn't dream of it.
Nick puts some water on the stove, then continues rummaging.
Sam starts to move towards the sofa again, but stops when he glances back at her.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How is it they have a cabinet just full of gold spoons?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Almost!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: A can of foie gras, some caviar... There it is! First aid kit.
Nick sits in the chair next to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let me see your arm.
He takes her arm and begins purposefully pushing on different areas with his fingertips.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ow! Watch it!
Sam pulls her arm away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, in my expert medical opinion, I don't think it's broken.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can you have an expert medical opinion if you're not a doctor?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Touche.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I've gotten in enough scrapes of my own to know it'll be fine. Your elbow's just incredibly swollen.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You must have hit that rock really hard.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If we put on this elastic bandage and an ice pack, I think you'll survive.
He takes her arm again, this time gently winding the bandage several times around it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There you go.
Nick puts the first aid kit back in the cupboard and mixes both of them some hot chocolate.
He hands Sam a steaming cup.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe if I get him to drop his guard... I can grab his gun and some food and get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't like flirting to get my way, but... Desperate times.
Sam smiles at Nick sweetly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for patching me up.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I rescued you. I might as well make sure the job is done properly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I'm curious... Why `are` you being so helpful?
nodes.text_bbcode: So I'm curious... Why [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] you being so helpful?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The way I see it... You're either just a really nice guy, or you have an ulterior motive.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Which do you think it is?
With her good hand, Sam fumbles for a stick and swipes it at Nick's feet.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoa there!
Sam swipes at him again, but Nick grabs the stick and tosses it away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What is going on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You tell me, `Spartan!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You tell me, [color=#3b78e2][i]Spartan![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I might be confused, but didn't I just save you?
Sam is sobered by the thought. She drops her hands.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But look, I've been dealing with Spartans all day, and they're not above taking a cheap shot just to win.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Is it cliche to say 'I'm different'?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, actually.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am sorry. Thanks for saving me. My name is Sam.
Overcoming her baser instincts, Sam chooses not to attack him.
Her eyes never leaving Nick's, she rises slowly to her feet and circles him warily.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for rescuing me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I get why you're suspicious, but I can assure you I have no intention of harming you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm glad I didn't attack him... He seems different than the others...
Sam picks up her pace, making longer and longer strides to match them!
For one long moment, Sam thinks she might make it!
But they pull ahead!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! They're getting away!
Sam wills her legs to go faster, but she falls behind them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I can't keep up with you... But that doesn't mean I can't hit you from here!
Sam stops and aims her gun at the boys' retreating backs.
Welcome back to Surviving High School! It's still anyone's victory in the Spartan Games!
Last we left off, $ZOE, Amanda, and Jessica only had one working gun and were facing off against three Spartan leaders!
The Spartan boys raise their paintball guns.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm too young to be sprayed with paint!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love paint, but why does it have to be so mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I'm going down, at least one of them is coming with me!
$ZOE pumps her gun.
Just as the boys are about to shoot, a voice rings out from behind $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Stop right there, or you'll be blue and green before you can even say the word 'Mommy'!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Stop right there, or you'll be blue and green before you can even say the word 'Mommy'![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE looks back and sees Sam and several other figures emerge from the water, wearing scuba gear and brandishing paintball guns.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: It's a water ambush!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Sure. Of course this happens.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so glad to see you guys!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nice to see you again too, cuz.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now let's paint these dirtbags!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: It might be a good idea to get out of here...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, right! She's bluffing. The paintball guns can't handle water. They're all waterlogged.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We have them right where we want them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not unless we found water-proofing spray with all this great scuba gear.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You lie!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Actually, my dad does have all that stuff in our pool house...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?!
Sam shoots one of Chad's Spartan lackeys. He goes down in a spray of paint!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You were saying?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Now we get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Spartans, cover our escape!
The Spartans come together to help Chad, Carson, and Preston retreat.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, these guys bug me so much!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, we can't let these guys get away!
The swim team rushes forward.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: `Raaaaaaaawr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Raaaaaaaawr![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yar?
The swim team girls open fire and hit some of the Spartans!
Sam opens fire and pelts the last of the Spartan underlings with paint!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on! I can still see them! We can make it if we run!
Sam disappears into the forest.
Through the brush, Sam can still make out the backs of Chad's team.
She dashes through the thicket, keeping them in her line of sight...
When they bank left through a tight patch of trees, Sam manages to burst through!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, come on, come on!
The Spartan boys pick up their pace, now sprinting through the forest like nimble deer following the riverside.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no, you don't!
Bounding over the floor with a catlike grace, Colt neatly hops over all the obstacles and gets to the other side!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice! I'm a freaking ninja!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A handsome, devilish ninja... With an awesome motorcycle... And a hot girlfriend... And...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Stay on target! I'm here to rescue Tom!
Colt creeps through the cafeteria, rounds a corner, and approaches the door to the office. He throws it open...)

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.text: Colt rushes across the cafeteria...
And steps right on a pile of potato chips! They crunch loudly underfoot!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Aggggh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aggggh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt jumps away from the chips and trips over a chair! It clatters loudly to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Crap!
He stumbles to the side and steps right on a whoopie cushion!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh come on! Why is that even here?!
There's a commotion from down the hall, and the sound of rushing footsteps! Colt sprints through the room, stepping on a pile of dry leaves, a broken plate, and an old, squeaky bicycle horn!
He hurls himself through the door at the far end, runs around a corner, and races towards the door to the office. He throws it open...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The main hallway's gonna be blocked. My best bet is to go through the cafeteria...
Colt pries open the door and peeks inside. The floor is cluttered with overturned chairs, spilled food, and random bits of trash!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... Almost there... Just need to cross the room without making any noise...
Colt steels himself, takes a deep breath, and steps on...
Colt pulls open a locker door...
And a dozen filthy, reeking garbage bags tumble out!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Dahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Dahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt recoils away, gagging!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think a vagrant's been squatting here... And he loves Thai food...
Footsteps sound from down the hall! The Spartan is almost there!
Desperate, Colt dives into the foul-smelling locker and pulls the door shut!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uggghh... It's like someone ate a dumpster and then threw it back up!
The Spartan guy walks right up to the locker. He picks up one of the trashbags and examines it... Then walks off, muttering about how gross it is!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tell me about it!
Colt waits in the locker for three excruciating minutes then tumbles out...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hfff... `Hfff...` That's worse than the time Uncle Griz ate that spicy meatball pizza and used our bathroom!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hfff... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hfff...[/i][/color] That's worse than the time Uncle Griz ate that spicy meatball pizza and used our bathroom!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No... Can't distracted... Gotta stay... On target...
Colt staggers down the hall toward the office...
Colt throws open a classroom door and lunges inside...
And the Spartan guy walks by, oblivious!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hff... Hff... That was close...
Just then, there's the sound of something clattering at the other end of the room, from the closet! Colt approaches it cautiously and peeks inside...
Where Lee and Paige are making out, oblivious!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, Lee is a stone-cold player!
Leaving them to it, Colt sneaks back into the hallway. He crawls along the lockers and makes his way towards the office...
Colt hesitates for one terrified moment...
The Spartan guy gets closer! Colt spins around, panicked, and fumbles for a locker. He pulls open the door...
Colt creeps down the hall as quietly as he can...
When there's some sudden movement from down the hall! Colt can see the shadow of a Spartan guy rounding the corner!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh crap!
Colt spins around and hides in...
Colt drags himself furiously towards the school, getting closer and closer...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Almost there... `Almost there...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Almost there... [color=#e23b3b][i]Almost there...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt is nearly to the back door when suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...What is that clicking sound?
Colt spins around... And finds himself staring into the hollow, beady eyes of a honey badger!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh no... No no no...!

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Hssssssssk!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No way... He recognized me! He's `back` for revenge!
nodes.text_bbcode: No way... He recognized me! He's [color=#e23b3b][i]back[/i][/color] for revenge!

nodes.text: The badger rears up, and his eyes glow red!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Demon! `DEMON!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Demon! [color=#e23b3b][i]DEMON![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt bursts out of the brush and hurls himself into the school through a window! The badger hisses loudly behind him!
Colt hits the ground hard and sprawls out on the tile floor!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate that stupid honey badger! That thing is some kind of monster...
Outside, several Spartan guys rush out, investigating the disturbance...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not to mention way too noisy. I've got to move fast!
Colt takes a deep breath... Waits for the guard to turn his back...
Then sprints for it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, come `on!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, come [color=#e23b3b][i]on![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt dives through the building's back door, just in time!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...
Colt hesitates for a moment... The Spartan guy looks his way...
So Colt dives into the brush and starts crawling!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Phew... Close call...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, Tiny Hipster. But this is how it's got to be.
Late that night, Colt creeps on his belly through the brush...
Up ahead lies a big, empty, old school building.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look at that... While Denni and I were huddling in the mud and pulling bugs out of each others' hair, the Spartans were living large in Babytown Elementary!
A Spartan guy walks out and looks around. Colt ducks back down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I could try to crawl my way up through the bushes... Or I could rush the back door when the guy's back is turned...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no. Not `this` again. We've been over this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. Not [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] again. We've been over this!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What can I say? I'm a predictable guy... And I'm not gonna let you put yourself in that kind of danger.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are you talking about? I've been with you this whole time, taking out one Spartan guy after another! I can `clearly` handle myself!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you talking about? I've been with you this whole time, taking out one Spartan guy after another! I can [color=#3b78e2][i]clearly[/i][/color] handle myself!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This isn't creeping through the brush, nabbing goons like Mark. This is a full-blown raid on their main base.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If this goes wrong, you're not just gonna catch a stray paintball to the arm. You're gonna get hit with a total paint barrage... Or worse.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know, I don't know how many times I have to tell you this, but I knew what I was getting into when I signed up.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm fine taking risks. I like them, even. And you don't get to tell me what to do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I mean, honestly. How would you like it if I told you what you could and couldn't do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's different. I mean... You're not supposed to protect me...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course I am. I'm your girlfriend. Protecting you is my job...
Denni gently presses her paintball gun to Colt's chest.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now either we're going down there together... Or I'm shooting you right here and now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You wouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Try me!
Colt stares Denni in the eye... And then turns around and starts walking.
Denni holds the gun up after him... But lowers it, unable to shoot.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're a great girl, Denni... But you're a terrible bluffer.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Please! There's got to be another way!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Colt
