nodes.text: Look, Tom's my best friend. That means I have to try and save him... But you? You're off the hook.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If I go down there and get taken out, then you can still go on and win the game!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But if we both get taken out... Well, we might as well buy some polish, because we're gonna spend the rest of high school shining Spartan shoes!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's... Actually a good point...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I know you're as stubborn as a mule and twice as tough. I `know` you can win this game, with or without me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I know you're as stubborn as a mule and twice as tough. I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you can win this game, with or without me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now my friendship with Tom is worth risking my shot at the prize... But it's not worth risking yours.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold down the fort. I'll go down there and get him out. And if it goes wrong, and I get hit... Well... You win this thing for me, okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's... There's got to be another way...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: There's an old abandoned school down by the south bank of the lake. That's where they're holed up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice! Thanks, Mark!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Wait... That's not all. They've got a hostage... A real VIP, if you ask me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who?
Mark's face twists into a sinister grin...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Tom Prince.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No... Fancypants wouldn't let a bunch of two-bit jokers like you capture him...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Heh... It was all Chad's idea. He set up a fake motorcycle trail leading through the woods... He knew Tom would think it was yours and follow it right into our trap!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Now they've got him all tied up and blindfolded in the Principal's office... Just waiting for the right moment to finish him off!
Colt's face darkens with anger. He clenches and unclenches his fists...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tom and I promised each other we'd meet up... We were gonna fight this out together...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...
Colt turns and stalks away. Denni rushes after him...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey! What about me? Can I go now?
Colt freezes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You seriously think I'd honor a deal with a stooge like you?
Without turning around, Colt spins his gun back and shoots Mark directly in the chest with a paintball!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not a `Ghost` of a chance!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not a [color=#e23b3b][i]Ghost[/i][/color] of a chance!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh `nice!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh [color=#3b78e2][i]nice![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I've been working on that one for the last few minutes.
Colt and Denni walk to the edge of their camp, where Colt begins arming himself...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you think I'm doing? I'm going in to save Tom!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Into the heart of the Spartan camp? Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You got it. I'll sneak in at night under the cover of darkness... Take out any sentries one by one...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah? And what am I going to be doing this whole time?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Come on, Denni, don't make this harder than it has to be.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It means, I'm doing this mission solo.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no. No way. Absolutely not.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Princess...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't you Princess me! We agreed that we're in this together! That means `every` mission!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you Princess me! We agreed that we're in this together! That means [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] mission!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I'm not discussing this, okay? I can't let you go with me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What do you think we can offer him? You're not seriously going to suggest we split the prize money...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not. We're gonna offer Mark the one thing he wants more than anything else... A little respect.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't follow...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Watch and learn, Princess. Watch and learn.
Colt walks over to Mark and hunkers down next to him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Mark. Can I call you Mark?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: What `else` would you call me?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#e23b3b][i]else[/i][/color] would you call me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let me level with you, Mark. I need to know about the other Spartans. And you're going to tell me about them.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Ha! And what are you gonna do if I don't? It's not like you can torture me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not. I'm sure going through life as Mark Backbutter is torture enough.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's why I'm not going to talk about what we'll do if you `don't` talk...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's why I'm not going to talk about what we'll do if you [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] talk...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm going to talk about what we'll offer you if you `do.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm going to talk about what we'll offer you if you [color=#e23b3b][i]do.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: What are you talking about? What can you offer me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What you want more than anything else... A chance to be Spartan's big hero!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Which is truly shocking, I think we can all agree.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Heh!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What I'm saying, Mark, is let's say the Spartans wipe out all the Centerscore students. What then?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No wait, don't tell me... You're gonna take a dive and let Chad win!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: ...And? So what if that's true?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know thinking ahead's a little rough for you, but try with me for a second... What happens then? You go back to being exactly who you are: a sad, little stooge for the big Spartan fish.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But what if that's not how it went down? What if it was a nail-biting fight to the very end... And then you were the one who turned it all around and scored Spartan the win?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: You're offering to let me win the games?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not. I'm just giving you another chance.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You tell me what the Spartans are up to, and I'll let you run out of here. I'll even give you a spare paintball gun. Then you can bide your time and wait until the moment's right...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And maybe... Just maybe... Be the big hero of the games.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you think of `that,` Backbutter?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you think of [color=#e23b3b][i]that,[/i][/color] Backbutter?

nodes.text: Mark thinks it over for a minute...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You sure that'll work? Mark's a lot of things, but I don't think he's easily intimidated...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And `I` think you're underestimating just how intimidating I can be!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] think you're underestimating just how intimidating I can be!

nodes.text: Colt spins around and walks over to Mark's chair, giving it a hard shove! Mark falls back onto the ground!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yo! Not cool!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, did the little baby tumble out of his itsy bitsy chair? Cry me a tiny violin!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I don't think that's the expression...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, lookie here! We've got ourselves a WordWizard!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Here's an expression you might not be as a familiar with...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Talk... Or `else.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Talk... Or [color=#e23b3b][i]else.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Or else `what,` huh? You're gonna shoot me? Go ahead! Shoot me! I don't care!
nodes.text_bbcode: Or else [color=#e23b3b][i]what,[/i][/color] huh? You're gonna shoot me? Go ahead! Shoot me! I don't care!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shoot you? Naw. Shooting you would be `way` too easy. We're gonna have some fun with you first.
nodes.text_bbcode: Shoot you? Naw. Shooting you would be [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too easy. We're gonna have some fun with you first.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Wha... What do you mean? You can't torture me! It's against the rules!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? Well, do you know why I'm terrible at board games?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's because I `never` read the rules!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's because I [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] read the rules!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, hold on! Time out! Sorry, I hate to break up this increasingly scary thing you're doing, but... We're not actually going to torture him, are we?
Colt stands still for a moment, then turns and walks back to Denni. He speaks in an urgent whisper...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, of course not! I'm just bluffing!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh! Okay! Just wanted to make sure!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Did you seriously think I wasn't? What kind of a guy do you think I am?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You probably don't want me to answer that...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Uh, guys? I can hear you. So why don't you just shoot me and get this over with?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...I'm guessing I just messed this whole thing up, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yup. You wanna try getting him to talk?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sure...
Denni walks over to Mark.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll make this really simple, Mark, because I know you're not great with big words.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Tell us where the Spartans are, and we'll let you go. We'll even give you a spare paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You want a shot at winning this thing and being a big hero? This is it.
Mark thinks it over for a minute...
Deep in the woods at the far end of the Spartan Games Preserve...
A young man is dragged through the trees with his wrists bound and a bag over his head!

nodes.speaker: Masked Man
nodes.text: Mfff! Hfffflpf!
Two rough hands shove him into a chair and rip off the bag, revealing...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yo, man, this ain't cool! You can't just kidnap me like this!
Two shadowy figures approach him, slowly drifting into focus...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All's fair in love and war, Backbutter...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And me and the Princess here got plenty of both!
Denni turns to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, no offense, but could I just handle the one-liners?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That wasn't good? I thought it was clever, you know, because we're a couple and we're, you know, at war...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I get the intent, but it wasn't structurally clear, you know?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine, fine, I'll do the shooting, you do the talking...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: `Hey!` I hate to break up this little love-fest, but what's going on here? You two better let me go!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hey![/i][/color] I hate to break up this little love-fest, but what's going on here? You two better let me go!

nodes.text: Mark tries to lunge up, and Colt and Denni both level paintball guns at his chest!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Or maybe I'll just sit here quietly. Would that work better for you guys?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's probably for the best.
Eyeing them warily, Mark sits back down.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: What do you want with me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're gonna have a little chat, Mark. Play along, and you might just walk out of here unsplattered.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Give me trouble, and, well...
Colt rolls up his sleeve, revealing 14 lines drawn down his arm in marker.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why don't you ask your 14 missing Spartans how it worked out for them?
Mark's eyes go wide with horror.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: No! It... It can't be! Not you! It was a myth! A legend!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: There's a rumor going around about two mysterious Centerscore players who stalk the woods, picking off Spartans one-by-one!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: According to the rumor, they hunt in the shadows and creep through the darkness... They know no fear or hunger... And they mark every kill on their arms!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: They call them... `The Ghost` and `The Hipster!`
nodes.text_bbcode: They call them... [color=#e23b3b][i]The Ghost[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]The Hipster![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, time out! You get to be The Ghost, and I'm still The Hipster? Why do I have to be The Hipster?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, you're the one in the skinny jeans, you tell me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Behind them, Mark tries to sneak out of his chair again...
And finds two barrels jammed in his face!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You best sit your little butt down, Mark... Or we'll paint you up like a white picket fence!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: See? I've got the one-liners covered.
Mark sits down again. Colt turns and gets in his face...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now listen here, Mark. I'm gonna ask you a few questions, and you're gonna answer them.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where are the rest of the Spartans?!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I'm... I'm not telling. And there's nothing you can do about that.
He crosses his arms over his chest. Denni pulls Colt aside.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How do you wanna play this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I say we...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I haven't had the chance to do a photo shoot since Spartan closed down...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But if I had my camera with me, this would be perfect.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What would?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The stars in the sky... The fire light... You...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww... That's so sweet!
Nick and Sam part quickly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, sorry, guys! It's, uh, my turn to stand watch now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, okay. I guess I'll turn in for the night...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good night, Nick.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Good night.
Sam walks to her tent.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wonder what would have happened... If $ZOE hadn't come up...
Sam has failed.
Try again and see if you can calm everyone down before they start shooting each other!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Any exes lurking in your background?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nope, no lurkers.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I haven't really dated anyone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? Someone like you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I did attend an all boys' school for most of my life.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can see how it'd be hard to get a date.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I've had a date here and there.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I wouldn't say I've really been too interested in anyone.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Mostly, I just threw myself into my work. I would say my first love is actually photography.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... You told me earlier that you wanted to use the winnings from the Spartan Games to build a photography lab.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's right. One of the things I really miss about Spartan is their lab.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know what I'd do if I couldn't develop my pictures properly...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you like about taking pictures?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I like trying to capture a photo the way I had it in my head.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And there's nothing more fun to me than waiting for everything to be `just so` to take that perfect shot.
nodes.text_bbcode: And there's nothing more fun to me than waiting for everything to be [color=#e23b3b][i]just so[/i][/color] to take that perfect shot.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You have to be pretty patient to be a photographer, and I have that in me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's like love... The lighting, the moment, and the timing have to be just right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I never thought about it that way before...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like I said before... Sports references all the time.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sounds like it should've been a `slam dunk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like it should've been a [color=#e23b3b][i]slam dunk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No? I'll stop.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: In the end, Spencer and I had nothing in common.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He loves football, I like swimming. He loves action movies, I love scary movies.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can see how that didn't work out.
A silence stretches between them. Sam takes this moment to move closer to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what about you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hm? What do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We had a thing a while back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A `long` while back. But it ended quickly.
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]long[/i][/color] while back. But it ended quickly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He was nice and sweet, and after my last boyfriend, he was just what I needed...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to go on about my past love life.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, it's fine. I think you need to talk about it. What went wrong?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I realized that it was taking us a lot of effort to stay together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: More effort than it should've.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And more effort than it ever had with my other ex.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I just figured it wasn't meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, he was just not someone I really got along with.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, really. He's strictly a friend. We are just friends.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's all we're ever going to be.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You must like him a lot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like him? ...Oh!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, he's someone I've already dated and broken up with.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The truth is... Things ended pretty quickly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He was just not someone I really got along with.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are we?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica and I definitely aren't friends.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In fact, I think we have a score to settle, don't we?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't even think about shooting me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Too late!
Taylor shoots at Jessica, just as Jessica shoots back!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Agh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not the paint!
The sound of paintballs makes everyone panic! Nick, Sam, and Ben all raise their guns and shoot one another!
When the chaos dies, everyone looks down at themselves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no... We're all covered in paint!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What... What have we done?!
There is a brief moment of silence...
Then Nick starts chuckling.
Before long, so does $ZOE, then Ben, then finally, Taylor and Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sorry. I don't know what came over me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, these games are really getting to us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for defusing that situation, Sam.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just happy to still be in the running... It could have ended up so much worse...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I try not to think about it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, now that we've settled that... How about we travel on a little further and make camp?
Sam blanks out and says nothing.
In that moment of silence, Jessica and Taylor come to one realization...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know, Jessica... I don't think I ever really told how much I hate the way you kicked me off the team...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I never told you how much I hated it when you were the Cheer Captain...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's a good thing I took your spot.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stole it, more like!
Taylor shoots at Jessica, just as Jessica shoots back!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Agh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not the paint!
The sound of paintballs makes everyone panic! Nick, Sam, and Ben all raise their guns and shoot one another!
When the chaos dies, everyone looks down at themselves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no... We're all covered in paint!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What... What have we done?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, now that that's settled... Do you guys have any snacks?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not much.
Erik makes a sad puppy face.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, maybe you can have the candy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!
Taylor, Erik, and Ben fall on the candy with zeal.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what happened to the rest of the nerds?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a sad tale of woe and tragedy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik's right. We lost a lot of people in the last onslaught...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It was really an `onslaughter!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It was really an [color=#e23b3b][i]onslaughter![/i][/color]

nodes.text: On the run from some Spartans, the nerds take a brief breather.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sorry, guys... They got Dex...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no! Not Dextrous Shadowguard, the man who could never trip in the dark!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We still have to move quickly. There are Spartans in this place... They could come from anywhere at any time...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, from behind, `right now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, from behind, [color=#e23b3b][i]right now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Take them out, Spartans!
A volley of paintballs comes at the nerds! Taylor, Ben, and Erik jump aside in time, but Brendan and Angie get stuck in the crossfire!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Don't mourn for us! Get out now! We'll hold them off!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But...!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on!
Ben and Erik grab Taylor's arms and drag her away...
Back in the present...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that's the last time I'll ever see him...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In this game.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... Sorry, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So we vowed to make Spartan pay for what they did.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But we're running out of ammo, food, and pretty much everything else.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We don't have enough paintballs to take out Chad and all his minions.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So what was your plan?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We heard some rumors... Rumors about an abandoned town in the middle of the estate.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: An abandoned town? Really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's supposed to be a haven. There's ammo, more guns, snacks, and water.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We were heading there now when we saw this cabin. And you know the rest.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, I wonder if that's where we should be heading next.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't want to stay here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're in the same boat as you. This cabin might provide some protection, but there's nothing here for any of us.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I think this is a sign we should just move on.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe we should try to get to this abandoned town.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, we can't stay here forever, and if we can get there before any other Spartans, maybe it'll give us the firepower we need to take them out.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then let's go!
After taking everything useful they can carry, the group departs.
At first, the day is long and hard...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My feet are starting to blister...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My `blisters` are starting to blister!
nodes.text_bbcode: My [color=#e23b3b][i]blisters[/i][/color] are starting to blister!

nodes.text: But it becomes easier with time and conversation...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And then Spencer and I slipped through the halls and found Barry the Badger...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Want to know what happens when a badger meets an electric razor? Bzzzzz!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, I remember seeing that! That was great!
Until finally, in another section of the woods...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right guys. We need to be really careful. The last time we went through this, we ran into some Spartans.
Ben indicates some leftover paint on the trees and bushes in the area.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They could strike at any moment...
Suddenly, there's a sound in the brush!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Watch out, it could be...
Before Sam even has time to raise her gun, there's a paintball gun in her face!
Sam stares down the barrel of the gun into Jessica's hard, brown eyes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Neither of you move.
Without moving her head, Sam shifts her view and sees Jessica is pointing a second gun at Taylor who has a gun on Ben.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shoot me, and I take your boyfriend down.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey!
One more glance tells Sam that Nick is pointing his main gun at Jessica and his pistol at Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, this got tense fast.
$ZOE and Amanda step around Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, look! It's Sam and Ben! It's people we trust. We can put the guns away now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm doing no such thing. We don't know if they're actually on our side, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, we aren't if you keep waving that thing in my face.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica, put your gun down, and Taylor will do the same.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No way, boyfriend. She'd shoot you and me in a heartbeat.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, she wouldn't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yes, I would.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, unless you stop pointing that thing at Sam, this is going to get colorful real fast.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh oh. Everyone's on a short fuse right now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I don't say something... We're all going to take each other out!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, if `I'm` the sane, rational one here, there's a `big` problem.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, if [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the sane, rational one here, there's a [color=#3b78e2][i]big[/i][/color] problem.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I knew it was too much power for Jessica to take two weapons at the last cache drop!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shut up, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's it going to take for everyone to drop their weapons?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't know, but I don't like the way you're looking at me, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd better be careful what I say next...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, guys. Seriously. Lower your guns...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's proven that he won't do anything to harm me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He hasn't proven himself to `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: He hasn't proven himself to [color=#3b78e2][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And what would I have to do to prove myself?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Stand on your head?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? No! That proves nothing!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Except his agility!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just leave it, Taylor. He's a friend.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And I like friends!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is there anyone you don't like?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't like people who are mean, punch others, and don't pay their taxes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Awfully specific.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They go hand in hand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: In either case, he's had many chances to take me out, and he hasn't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. But if you're wrong, I'm going to make sure you both pay when these stupid games are through.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not only is he trustworthy, but he's useful. With his help, I think we can make it to the end.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We don't need help.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't we? The Spartans got the drop on us at the beginning, didn't they?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They've taken most of us out and are hunting the rest down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But Nick knows how the Spartan leaders think, and that's what we need if we're going to win.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, I don't know anything about what Chad, Carson, and Preston are up to, do you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh... No. I don't.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, what do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure most of the Spartans have been taken out. I think it might be time to leave the cabin.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, but...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know. It's hard to leave a place that's done us so much good.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But we still need to get rid of the remaining Spartans, and I have no idea what they're up to next.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're sitting ducks if we just stay here.
There's a sudden crash from outside!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Someone ran into our traps!
Nick and Sam grab their paintball guns and rush to the front of the house. Sam cautiously looks out through a window.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Who is it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's Centerscore...
Her paintball gun at the ready, Sam opens the door.
Ben, Taylor, and Erik are tangled on the ground in a heap of cans and string.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Cans on string? You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sidelined by the oldest trick in the book...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I really rolled a one on stealth there, didn't I?
Sam raises her gun carefully and approaches them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you guys doing here?
The three trespassers look up at her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Sam... We could use a hand...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And how do I know you're not just going to shoot me as soon as you stand up?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We'd never do that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, we're all on the same side... Aren't we?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are we?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yes!
Sam hesitates, then reaches down and helps untangle them all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How did you get even strung up like this?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We were really excited...
They all get to their feet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what are you guys doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We thought the cabin would be a good place to rest and get supplies.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Especially snacks! Do you have any?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come with me.
Sam brings them into the cabin. When Taylor sees Nick, she draws her gun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, don't shoot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But he's Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know. But we've been working together.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Working together? But how can that be? Spartan and Centerscore are like one-armed giants and gross goblins, worms and birds... Mortal enemies!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Erik, it's not as dramatic as that... And Nick initiated the ceasefire. He rescued me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what? Why haven't you gotten rid of him?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He's still on the other side! You're better off without him! I say we shoot him now!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm standing right here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not going to shoot him because...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We do? How do you figure that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, we don't have any more?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We only have what's in our guns... Which isn't much at all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, the things really are looking kind of grim.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha, how could I forget?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Who needs supplies when you have a partner as good as I am?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, buddy... It seems to me that `you're` the lucky one here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, buddy... It seems to me that [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] the lucky one here.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, then maybe we're just good partners for each other.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: All right. You've lifted my spirits.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam. Maybe there is a way to win this after all.
Sam stops, unsure of what to say.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's okay. You don't have to say anything. I get how bad the situation is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I wanted to say something comforting, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not really good at that sort of thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe we'll figure something out?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam.
`IMPORTANT NEWS!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]IMPORTANT NEWS![/b]

nodes.text: The writers of Surviving High School are working on a brand new series to be sold in Surviving High School's On Demand store...
And for the first time ever, we're letting `YOU` decide what we write!
nodes.text_bbcode: And for the first time ever, we're letting [b]YOU[/b] decide what we write!

nodes.text: Purchase the `Story Vote Ticket` in the On Demand Store, play through four sneak peeks, and then vote on which genre you want to play!
nodes.text_bbcode: Purchase the [b]Story Vote Ticket[/b] in the On Demand Store, play through four sneak peeks, and then vote on which genre you want to play!

nodes.text: But whatever you do... `Don't wait!` In two weeks, the two genres with the fewest votes `will be eliminated...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But whatever you do... [b]Don't wait![/b] In two weeks, the two genres with the fewest votes [b]will be eliminated...[/b]

nodes.text: So vote now... And make sure the story you want to play wins!
And now...
Everyone at Centerscore is in the middle of the vicious and brutal Spartan Games, and now it's come down to the last few contestants!
In this finale, find out who will win the grand prize once and for all!
In the cafeteria, the Centerscore camp of students crowd around a TV to watch the Spartan Games with interest.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Okay, I got up for popcorn. Did anyone else get painted while I was gone?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ugh, who knows? All I can see on my screen are $ZOE, Amanda, and Jessica. And they keep arguing about boots...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll tell you who got painted! Jacob, Phil, and Zach!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, there goes some of the eye candy. This just got more boring.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, what you should be focusing on is that they were killed by Sam, that traitor!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well, anyone can see `why.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, anyone can see [color=#3b78e2][i]why.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, they were threatening her and Nick.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Don't get me started on Nick. The point is...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's three less Centerscore students with a chance to win!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And there's only so many people left...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Most of the cheerleaders, the rebels, and the nerds were taken out.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't forget about the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Right right... There are only a handful of Centerscore students still in there. And you know who `else` is still around?
nodes.text_bbcode: Right right... There are only a handful of Centerscore students still in there. And you know who [color=#e23b3b][i]else[/i][/color] is still around?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `Chad.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Chad.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Meanwhile, in a cabin on Carson's vast family estate...
Sam and Nick sit on the couch, examining their options.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Looks like our time here is coming to an end.
Nick gestures to their rations: a sack of candy, a bag of pretzels, and an unopened can of beans.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There's a couple bottles of water left as well.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'd think a house like this would have more supplies.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah well, they probably understocked it on purpose. It gets boring when people stay in the same place the entire time.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I'm not going to lie... We don't have much left.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, at least we have...
$ZOE runs like the wind, dust billowing behind her as she takes off!
A couple of the Spartans chasing her take shots, but she manages to dodge and weave around them.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm almost there! It's so close...
With a final burst of speed, $ZOE runs behind the shooting gallery.
And there, behind a large picture of a fuzzy yellow duck, she finds...
Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! I've been so worried!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And `I've` been just sick thinking about you all alone out here!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]I've[/i][/color] been just sick thinking about you all alone out here!

nodes.text: They embrace, feeling safe and secure in one another's arms.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But how did you end up here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought you might be near the water...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where the ducks are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So after the ambush, I followed the river, but I just couldn't find you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know what you mean...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I kept going. Eventually, the river led me to a stream where I saw the ducks from the shooting gallery!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I came just as everyone was getting shot at! I didn't think ducking in here would lead me to you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But even if we're together... I don't know how we're going to make it out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, we came together. We're going to leave together.
Howard gestures with his gun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go out, guns blazing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you too.
They kiss...
And then jump out from behind the gallery, their weapons out and ready.
Backs to one another, they start firing in different directions!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Arrrrrr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Arrrrrr![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Take that!
Several Spartan underlings go down before the return fire takes $ZOE and Howard out!
As they leave the ghost town...
$ZOE takes Howard's hand.

then.text: And finally, Sam jerks her gun to Chad...
