menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: $ZOE sprints down towards the shooting gallery.
She spares one glance back at her pursuers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're so close!
Suddenly, her leg clips a watering trough, and she tumbles in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhhhh!
`Splash!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Splash![/b]

nodes.text: $ZOE lands in the trough!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cough... Cough... That water is gross!
As she spits up water, the Spartan boys surround her.
$ZOE looks forlornly at the shooting gallery and spies the yellow ducks in a row...
And that's the last thing she sees before her world goes yellow.
Both girls fire at the same time, pegging each other with paint!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ow! That stings!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ow! My arm!
Next to them, Amanda points a gun at her own foot and shoots!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So pretty!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What did you do `that` for?
nodes.text_bbcode: What did you do [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] for?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I thought that it was the game we were playing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh... Amanda...
The girls walk off the field together.
While the other cheerleaders take care of their own matters, $ZOE runs desperately away from the square down one lane of the town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know where to go!
Suddenly, $ZOE can hear the far off noise of ducks quacking in the distance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What on earth?
$ZOE follows the sound around a building. Down the street she's on, she can make out a practice shooting gallery.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The duck noises are from the plastic ducks you shoot at!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This must be a sign...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey! I see one of them! Near the gallery!
$ZOE looks to the porch where Chad and Carson are directing teams of Spartans.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: After her!
She hears the thundering of feet and knows the Spartans are almost on her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Time to run!
She hurtles down the lane towards the shooting gallery!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And this is going to be `so` sweet...
nodes.text_bbcode: And this is going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sweet...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You can't predict everything, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Which means it's only a matter of time before you fall to the bottom.
Ben hesitates a second too long!
The mistake costs him dearly...
Before Ben knows it, he's surrounded on all sides by Spartans and trapped behind the counter!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Have any last words, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Please don't?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Fire!
Ben is bombarded by paintballs!
While Ben deals with the Spartans, Jessica sprints around a building and through a garden area.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't believe we're trapped here! I'm too close to victory to leave the game now!
Jessica runs around a path in the garden and stops short.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hello, Jessica.
In front of her stand Taylor and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `You.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I just want everyone to be happy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what I want.
Taylor draws her gun and points it at Jessica at the same time Jessica points hers at Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why are you doing this?
Ben makes a grab for the white bottle, but his hand finds empty space!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I used that one already!
The mistake costs him greatly.
The splatter of a paintball on the other side of the counter makes Ben jump but doesn't stop him from dumping the contents of the yellow bottle in!
Immediately, the chemicals start to make a fizzing sound as they mix together.
By the time the Spartans have surrounded Ben on all sides, trapping him between the counter and the wall, he's ready.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Have any last words, Ben Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I do...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Eat paint!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Eat paint![/i][/color]

nodes.text: At that moment, there's a small explosion as the concoction that Ben's mixed explodes, sending projectile globs of paint at everyone around him!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: `Noooo!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Noooo!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: When the paint settles, Preston glares angrily at Ben!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: What'd you go and do that for? Now none of us are going to win!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah well, I gave my other friends better odds of winning now that you and your team have been taken out.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: You're relying on them to win it for you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We practically have this in the bag.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope...
Ben grabs the yellow bottle and dumps it in!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, it should've been the green one!
Ben stares down at his concoction and thinks about how he can fix it...
But it's too late.
Ben dumps the contents of the green bottle in!
He can hear the heavy thud of feet approach the counter.
Ben quickly grabs the...
Ben dumps the contents of the white bottle in!
When the old swinging doors to the general store burst open, Ben quickly makes a grab for the...
Ben grabs the yellow bottle and dumps it in!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, that's the wrong one!
Ben stares down at his concoction and thinks about how he can fix it...
But it's too late.
After a relatively peaceful night, the group sets out the next day, trudging across the estate until at last...
The group finds itself before the large ranch-like gates of an Old Western-style town.
Rustic wooden buildings line a wide, dusty street.
Bales of hay, hitching posts, and empty water troughs for horses are strewn about.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is this for real?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This wasn't here last year.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: When they said it was a 'ghost town', I thought they just meant it was empty.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it's like we're in a movie about the Old West! There's an old stagecoach!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's even a 'general store', a 'saloon', and a 'bank'!
Erik points to the central square of the town.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Look, guys, over there!
In the center of the square is a huge cache of weapons, snacks, and other supplies.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I bet that has all the supplies we need.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We could live here forever!
Erik rushes towards the center square.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Erik! What did I say about running ahead?!
As soon as Erik's feet hit the edge of the square, he's hit with several paintballs all at once!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik!
Erik hits the ground, gasping weakly.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll... I'll see you on the other side...
Suddenly, all around them, Spartans spring up on the rooftops of all the buildings!
At the end of the street, Chad, Preston, Carson, and Lee pop up from atop the bank.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Nice of you to drop by...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: But this is the end of the line for you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You mean this was all a trap?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Yep! And you fell right into it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: We lured everyone here with false rumors of all this bounty.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: We knew people would get desperate enough to come.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And here you are.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Since you're the only `Centerpoor` losers left, once we're done with you...
nodes.text_bbcode: Since you're the only [color=#e23b3b][i]Centerpoor[/i][/color] losers left, once we're done with you...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The school, as you know it, will be finished!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! That means... That means Howard is...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ready, men!
All the Spartans raise their guns.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Aim...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! This can't be happening...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This can't be the end of the line!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I should have known they'd do something so cheap.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe we fell into it...
Before Chad can say the final word...
The sound of galloping horses fills the air!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Does... Does anyone else hear that?
Spartans and Centerscore students look around in confusion.
A short ways away, two lone riders gallop in on horseback.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Tom?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You two!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Us two! We're here to take you down!
Colt rides forward into the fray, firing two guns at all the shooters on the roofs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where'd you even get horses?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They were just sitting in a pen somewhere in the middle.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And we stole them like commoners!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Commoners aren't always thieves, Tom...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I hate to inform you that...
His words are cut short by a paintball to his chest!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No! Not this sweater!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Clear out of the way, silvershoes. I'm charging!
Colt rides in a circle around the square, taking on the Spartans on the rooftops!
His movement causes a massive duststorm to rise around the Centerscore students, shielding them for a few precious moments.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Someone, get them!
Carson brings up his gun.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Time to paint ourselves a Ghost.
He shoots, and the aim is true!
Just after Colt takes out another round of Spartans, he goes down!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni... At last, we can be together...
Meanwhile, Ben rallies the rest of the group.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is our chance to take cover, guys! Scatter!
The Centerscore group disbands!
Ben rushes from the square and stumbles into the building marked 'General Store'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Got to hide!
He jumps over the cash register counter and sags against a shelf where supplies sit.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Safe!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But for how long?
He peeks over the counter. Through the window, he can see Preston and seven more Spartans approaching the door.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I think I saw him come in here, guys! Let's root him out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-oh!
Ben checks his gun. Only a handful of paintballs are left.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can probably take down three or four Spartans at most...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And that's only if I aim `right`... Which isn't a guarantee...
nodes.text_bbcode: And that's only if I aim [color=#e23b3b][i]right[/i][/color]... Which isn't a guarantee...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, if I'm going down, I'm taking everyone down with me!
Ben looks around... The shelf he's resting on has several different-colored bottles of unknown liquids under the sign 'Apothecary'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Chemicals!
Ben starts opening each bottle and checking each solution until a plan has formed in his head.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I have just enough stuff here to make my idea work!
With an old knife, he opens each of his paintballs and dumps the paint into an empty balloon-like sack.
Ben sets the bottles out in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I want to make it super explosive, then I need to mix some chemicals with the paint...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I have to mix these in a very specific order.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The red bottle has to go in first, then the `white` bottle...
nodes.text_bbcode: The red bottle has to go in first, then the [color=#e23b3b][i]white[/i][/color] bottle...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then the `green` bottle and finally, the `yellow` bottle...
nodes.text_bbcode: Then the [color=#e23b3b][i]green[/i][/color] bottle and finally, the [color=#e23b3b][i]yellow[/i][/color] bottle...

nodes.text: Outside, Ben can hear the Spartans approaching.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I hope you're ready to go down, Ben! I know you're in here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need to do this quickly!
Ben dumps the red bottle in the sack and reaches for the...

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.text: As they walk off, Sam turns to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, we really pulled it off!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I admit... I had my doubts when you presented the plan to me.
A couple minutes earlier...
Nick and Sam duck behind a mountain of guns.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Where should we run?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to run anymore. I'm tired of these Games, and I'm sick of Chad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want to take all of them out in one swoop.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How do you want to do that? I shot some of the Spartans before they could retreat.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't have any bullets left in my paintball gun...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I only have four shots in mine... Is there any ammo in this mountain of guns?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Unfortunately, this was just a big trap. I checked a couple, but they're empty.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then we'd better make these paintballs count. How do you think we can get close?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, maybe we can use this whole Spartan-Centerscore rivalry thing to our advantage...
Present time...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But it all seemed to have worked out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nice shooting there, partner.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I couldn't have done it without your superb acting skills...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Then it was a team effort.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look what Centerscore and Spartan can do when they actually work `together.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Look what Centerscore and Spartan can do when they actually work [color=#3b78e2][i]together.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah really. We did it. We made it to the end.
They smile at one another...
For a moment, time stands still...
Then they step together in a kiss!
Nick winds his arms around Sam, and she pulls him closer!
The two kiss for an endless moment... Then pull away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You... We...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Kissed in front of the entire school...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I really `did` betray my school...
nodes.text_bbcode: I really [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] betray my school...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Did you?
The sound of a paintball breaks the silence.
Nick looks down at his black shirt where a yellow pellet has burst open from Sam's paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe not.
For a moment, Nick doesn't say anything... Then a grin spreads across his face.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You cheater, you took my plan!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess it had to be one of us...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You mean, `at least` it was one of us.
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]at least[/i][/color] it was one of us.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Spartan, let's go home.
Wow, Centerscore won the Spartan Games! All thanks to you!
But what's going to happen with the rest of the money?
Find out next week!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. At least I made it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just wish I didn't feel like a mushy, bruised banana right before I talk to Justin...
Sam bolts for the gap in the mob, but she gets slammed from the side.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Aah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She crawls through the mob, trying to avoid getting stepped on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who wears spiked heels to school?!
Finally, she crawls out of the crowd, ending up just outside Justin's door!
Sam bolts for the gap in the mob, but she gets slammed from the side.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Aah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She crawls through the mob, trying to avoid getting stepped on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who wears spiked heels to school?!
Finally, she crawls out of the crowd, ending up just outside Justin's door!
Sam bolts for the gap in the mob, but she gets slammed from the side.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Aah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She crawls through the mob, trying to avoid getting stepped on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who wears spiked heels to school?!
Finally, she crawls out of the crowd, ending up just outside Justin's door!
Sam bolts for the gap and emerges on the other side, clear of the mob!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I made it!
Sam hesitates...
And gets slammed from the side!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Ahh!`
She crawls through the mob, trying to avoid getting stepped on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who wears spiked heels to school?!
Finally she crawls out of the crowd, ending up just outside Justin's door!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Where'd she go?! Where is she?
Out of the corner of her eye, Sam sees Jacob craning to find her in the crowd...
As he does so, he moves from his spot, leaving behind a small gap...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Daylight!
Sam tries to slip between the two bodies, but they squeeze together, sandwiching her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam slips between the two bodies, nestling into the middle of the mob!
Sam tries to slip between the two bodies, but they squeeze together, sandwiching her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam hesitates!
The bodies around Sam slam into her, knocking her to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Oof!`
She rises to her feet, now halfway through the mob!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that was lucky.
She rubs her hurt arm.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Kind of...
As the mob shifts, another gap opens between two bodies...
She heads left and pushes through the outer wall of the mob!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm in!
She tries to get to the hole, but misjudges, and an elbow hits her in the rib as she pushes through the outer wall of the mob.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...
She tries to jump into the mob, landing in a pile of elbows and knees!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Ow! Ow! Ow!`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, at least I'm closer to the door...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You shouldn't talk to me anymore. If you don't know why now, you will soon...
Nick turns and leaves. Sam calls out to him...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, that's it?! We're done?!
He doesn't turn around...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine! See if I care! You're... You're just a heartless Spartan!
Sam watches him disappear around a corner...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick...
She returns to the mob...
And is met with a sea of angry faces!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why were you talking to that Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: They're all scumbags, Sam! They totally tried to cheat us in the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Wait wait wait... Tell me you're not planning on spending the money on `them.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait wait wait... Tell me you're not planning on spending the money on [color=#e23b3b][i]them.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: She wouldn't do that, Jacob. We just chanted not to, remember?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's `my` decision.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] decision.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Not according to Justin... I heard he's already spending the money for you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!
Sam heads toward Justin's office, but is blocked by the mob.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Move out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Nobody move! She's going to spend the money on Spartans!
Sam tries to push through the mob, but it doesn't budge...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't let her in, guys!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just have to find the empty spaces!
Sam sees a hole to her left!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's exactly it! I'm afraid, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't bear the thought of you giving up everything that comes from winning the Spartan Games because of us...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Especially since we don't even know if there really is an us at all.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't get to decide all by yourself whether we're worth risking or not!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You might be right, but I have. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're jealous that I won, and you didn't!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm not jealous, Sam! I'm trying to do you a favor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What favor is that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm trying to make sure you get what I never will... A high school experience where people actually care about you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Where they actually like you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This isn't jealousy. Jealousy doesn't feel like this.
Nick shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You don't get it. It's not about the money...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Right now, there is an `us` and a `them.` But you're an us, and I'm a them. We're on opposite sides.
nodes.text_bbcode: Right now, there is an [color=#e23b3b][i]us[/i][/color] and a [color=#e23b3b][i]them.[/i][/color] But you're an us, and I'm a them. We're on opposite sides.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's what this whole thing's been about... A war that Centerscore won and Spartan lost.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What just happened... Those dumb guys being dumb guys... I was dealing with that at Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now I'm dealing with that here, from dumb Centerscorians `and` from even dumber Spartans, and I'll keep on dealing with it until I can get out of here and go to college `if` I'm lucky.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I'm dealing with that here, from dumb Centerscorians [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] from even dumber Spartans, and I'll keep on dealing with it until I can get out of here and go to college [color=#e23b3b][i]if[/i][/color] I'm lucky.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The last thing I'm going to do is bring you down with me. Everyone loves you... You've even got your own mob now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, what... You're just going to prevent `us` from ever happening because you're...
nodes.text_bbcode: So, what... You're just going to prevent [color=#3b78e2][i]us[/i][/color] from ever happening because you're...

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I could never do something like that!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's comforting to know. For a second, I thought I'd been wrong about you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Only if you thought I wasn't interested in you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know how you feel... But we're not going to happen, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't tell me I'm wrong about how you feel because I'm pretty sure you like me...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe I do...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, if it's about what they were chanting, I know it was mean. For what it's worth, I'm planning on spending some of the money on you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You can't have both, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Both?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You can't chant something like, 'No money for Spartans,' `and` tell me that you like me!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't chant something like, 'No money for Spartans,' [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] tell me that you like me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I wasn't... Wait... You thought `I` was chanting?!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I wasn't... Wait... You thought [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was chanting?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I saw you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You actually think I wouldn't give you any of the money?!
`IMPORTANT NEWS!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]IMPORTANT NEWS![/b]

nodes.text: The writers of Surviving High School are working on a brand new series to be sold in Surviving High School's On Demand store...
And for the first time ever, we're letting `YOU` decide what we write!
nodes.text_bbcode: And for the first time ever, we're letting [b]YOU[/b] decide what we write!

nodes.text: Purchase the `Story Vote Ticket` in the On Demand Store, play through four sneak peeks, and then vote on which genre you want to play!
nodes.text_bbcode: Purchase the [b]Story Vote Ticket[/b] in the On Demand Store, play through four sneak peeks, and then vote on which genre you want to play!

nodes.text: But whatever you do... `Don't wait!` In one week, the two genres with the fewest votes `will be eliminated...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But whatever you do... [b]Don't wait![/b] In one week, the two genres with the fewest votes [b]will be eliminated...[/b]

nodes.text: So vote now... And make sure the story you want to play wins!
And now...

nodes.title: Eyes on the Prize
nodes.subtitle: What should Sam do with the $100,000 prize money?

nodes.text: The day after winning the Spartan Games, Sam strides into the school...
And gets mobbed by cheering, clapping students!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Congratulations, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks, cuz!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Sam! Would you sign my poster?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There are posters of me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No... But all I had on me was this poster of an owl. It says 'Party `Fowl`'?! Ha! What a `hoot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... But all I had on me was this poster of an owl. It says 'Party [color=#e23b3b][i]Fowl[/i][/color]'?! Ha! What a [color=#e23b3b][i]hoot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Shut up, nerd! Sam, you really crushed those Spartan punks! `And` you looked hot doing it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut up, nerd! Sam, you really crushed those Spartan punks! [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] you looked hot doing it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um, thanks, and... Ew.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Way to represent Centerscore, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah! What kind of pool are you going to buy us?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pool? I think Samface knows the money should go to a new football field!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Or toward upgrading my seismic activity monitor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, everyone, I don't know how I'm going to spend the money yet...
Sam sees Nick walking alone toward class...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick!
He doesn't hear her. She tries to push through the crowd toward him, but she can't get through.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Move, people!
Just then, Zach and Jacob pass Nick. Jacob reaches out and slaps Nick's books to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha! What are you going to do about that, Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'll probably pick them up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's `real` clever. How's it feel knowing you lost $100,000 to us?
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] clever. How's it feel knowing you lost $100,000 to us?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Meh. I don't really care one way or another.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You will when you see all the cool stuff we get while you and all your Spartan pals get nothing!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah! No money for Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I like that! No money for Spartans! No money for Spartans!
Soon the chant is picked up by the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No money for Spartans! No money for Spartans!
Nick turns and sees Sam looking at him from the center of the chanting crowd!
He walks away, the hurt unmistakable...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! Wait!
Sam breaks free of the crowd and reaches Nick! He turns around...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't understand...
Sam manages to quickly chew the cupcake, swallowing the last of it down!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, Jessica! I'm not going to spend the prize money on converting the science lab into a dance club! It's a ridiculous idea!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why? It's not like science ever did anything valuable!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A dance club is completely impractical!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine then!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We're not going to go clubbing at school?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's okay! I usually just assume I'm in a dance club anyway!
Amanda does a little dance in her seat.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love this song!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can I get some milk here?
Jessica's face turns to all smiles, and she slides the carton to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Stop now! All of you! This has gone on long enough!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've decided how I'm going to spend the prize money...
The chanting stops.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Stop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Stop![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...
A container of applesauce flies through the air and splatters all over Sam!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: How do you like them apples?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: She's an apple turnover!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Shut up, Spartan! You're not getting any money, remember?!
The chanting resumes!
As Sam gets up to leave, Jessica grabs her arm.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just don't forget your roots, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. I won't.
Sam turns back toward the swim team table, but stops in her tracks. The cafeteria falls deathly silent.
Across the way, the Spartans have entered. The whole school glares at them.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Geez... Who died?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Don't you all have something better to do?!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Let it go, Chad!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: This sucks.
Nick trails in behind them...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Awww, Nick...
After the Spartans get their food, they sit at the empty tables at the cafeteria's edge.
All of the Centerscore students in their area get up and move to different tables.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is so awkward...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I almost feel bad for them...
Then it starts...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No money for Spartans! No money for Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: No money for Spartans! No money for Spartans!
The chant rises in volume, just as it did before...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No money for Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No money for Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No honey for Martians!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's it! Time to shut this crowd up!
Sam gets up and stands defiantly in front of the Spartan tables, positioning herself between both groups...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I had a lot of anger issues, most of them caused by Taylor... But really, they all `came from` me. I was constantly combative and angry...
nodes.text_bbcode: I had a lot of anger issues, most of them caused by Taylor... But really, they all [color=#3b78e2][i]came from[/i][/color] me. I was constantly combative and angry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to go back to that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Especially now that I've found the real me with swimming...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you through, Miss Perfect Actress?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not acting!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Boo hoo hoo! 'My name is Sam, and I'd be with you guys, if I weren't so flawed!'

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Please! You didn't like cheerleading because you didn't like Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And now you're trying to be polite, but we know it's because you don't like us!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not it at all!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why'd we even invite her over here?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Go back to the swim table, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can't believe it! The rumors are true! Celebrities `are` mean!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe it! The rumors are true! Celebrities [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] mean!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine! Bye!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What drama?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... I don't know what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about meetings where boys are ranked by hotness?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wait... By drama do you mean fun?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I would mean fun if they were harmless, but those rankings determine all your behavior toward guys.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatever. Is that it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about gossiping about other girls behind their back?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We don't do that!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, usually we just do it right to their ugly faces!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole! Not helping!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine! But that's it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I'm sure you as Head Cheerleader makes for a drama-free experience.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Totes!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What if I asked all the other girls?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh. I think that proves my point.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmmmf!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sounds like approval to me! Thanks, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Now I'll totally, like, `enjoy` school!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I'll totally, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]enjoy[/i][/color] school!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmmmf! Mmmmf!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I bet we could even invite guys from other schools!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course!
Unable to chew the cupcake fast enough, Sam spits it out across the table!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: O.M... Gross.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awkward...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'll never wash my face again!
$ZOE grabs the carton of milk and slides it across the table to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh! I'm sorry, Sam! I didn't realize you needed that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure you didn't...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, a dance club sounds cool, but I can't spend the money on that!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But you promised!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Way to kill the party mood, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't... Ugh. Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Just make sure that you remember who your real friends are when you're handing out the money...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I will...
The swim team leaves...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Phew... Who knew there would be this much pressure?!
The bell rings for lunch...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Finally!
At lunch, Sam is contemplating where to sit when all eyes turn to her...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I should have just lost the Spartan Games on purpose... I could have stayed in that cabin with Nick, flirting...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Instead, he and I are over before we even started, `and` to top it off, I called him heartless...
nodes.text_bbcode: Instead, he and I are over before we even started, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] to top it off, I called him heartless...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sam! Over here! Come sit with the cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And now Jessica is acting nice to me... That's not weird at all...
Sam walks over and sits down at the Center Table in between Amanda and Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, Sam! I've never sat next to a celebrity before, so I'm recording every moment with my mind!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Amanda, I'm still the same Sam. You've known me for years!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Phew! Thank you! I was running out of space in my head!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: First, I think we all want to say congratulations, you're a hero, and blah blah blah.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah, way to go, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We all knew you'd win!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But enough boring speech stuff! $ZOE baked some cupcakes with your face on them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here you go, Sam!
$ZOE hands Sam a plate of cupcakes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow! These are scarily realistic.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was able to make them so detailed because Howard bought me a special tip for my piping bag!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wow, cupcake much?
Sam grabs a cupcake and stuffs it into her mouth...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmm!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, Sam, we totes had the best idea! What if we turned that boring old science lab the nerds are always sciencing in into, like, a dance club?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmmf mmmf mmmf?!
Sam reaches for a nearby carton of milk, but Jessica slyly slides it away and pours herself a glass...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It seems like you like it! Can we count on your approval then?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Dance club!
Sam tries to chew the cupcake, so she can answer Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Mfff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mfff![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't spit out the cupcake! If I do, I'll never hear the end of it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I spend all of the money on the swim team, think about how resentful everyone's going to feel toward us.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I didn't even think of that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You probably won't be able to walk down the hall without getting dirty looks.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Dirty looks?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, Hannah... Not that kind of dirty.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that's not fun!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't want my reputation ruined. I barely have one as it is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've totally got the swim team's back, trust me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Aww. We trust you, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Sara. What about the rest of you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess we trust you...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sure. You've always been a team player...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hannah?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, we trust you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good! I'll take that.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: After the Spartan Games, does anyone really care about being nice anymore?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I do!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I think Hannah's got a point, even if it is veiled...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sam, you entered a grueling, multi-day battle royale and barely managed to escape with your life!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... It was just a paintball match...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It doesn't matter! The time for being nice has passed!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Linda, you don't feel this way too, do you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I don't think Centerscore's ever going to be the same again. It might be time to think about ourselves...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe that I'm suddenly the nice one in this group!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I was being nice...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shh, don't interrupt me, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Maybe you're getting soft, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe you're getting mean, Hannah!
The door swings open, and Principal Shapiro storms into the office.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Justin! What's this I've been hearing about you assuming authority over Samantha's prize money?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're just a common student! I should be the one to act on your behalf! I'm the President!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, you're acting like a dictator!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: When the people can't govern themselves properly, someone needs to step up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, so you're better? You're elite, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maybe I am!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know who you sound like, Justin? You sound like one of them!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I do not!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You just claimed to be an elite, `and` you called me common. If that doesn't earn you your Spartan ID card, I don't know what does...
nodes.text_bbcode: You just claimed to be an elite, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] you called me common. If that doesn't earn you your Spartan ID card, I don't know what does...

nodes.text: Justin sighs...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam. You're right. I do sound like them. I just can't stand the idea of them getting anything out of this.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not a big Spartan fan either, you know?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, just... Just remember how they treated us, okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't worry. I'm not going to forget anytime soon...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So then... You're going to stop spending `my` money?
nodes.text_bbcode: So then... You're going to stop spending [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] money?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah. It's all yours.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: They deserve nothing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not `every` Spartan is bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] Spartan is bad.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I get it. `Nick` isn't bad. `Nick` is different. Well, you're blind.
nodes.text_bbcode: I get it. [color=#e23b3b][i]Nick[/i][/color] isn't bad. [color=#e23b3b][i]Nick[/i][/color] is different. Well, you're blind.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: They're all jerks! Chad's a jerk! Preston's just a jerk with glasses! And that Carson's just a jerk with a sense of humor!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Nick's probably just a jerk with a lovely haircut!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're wrong about him...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You don't like his hair?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I meant he's not a jerk!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And the rest of them?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Do I need to bring up Mark Backbutter?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Fine! They suck, okay?! But have you thought about how it would go if the situation were reversed?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I think they'd be laughing in our faces as they spent the money on lavish things the school doesn't need!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's... Probably true...
And bursts in!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Stop what you're doing!
Justin freezes, about to bite into a blueberry bagel!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Poison bagel! Assassination attempt!
He hurls the bagel into the wall!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, I meant, 'Stop doling out the money `I` won.' I'd say I'm sorry about your lost bagel, but I'd be lying.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I meant, 'Stop doling out the money [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] won.' I'd say I'm sorry about your lost bagel, but I'd be lying.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're too late. I've already drafted up a memo that gives the money to programs I know are run by `true` Centerscore students...
nodes.text_bbcode: You're too late. I've already drafted up a memo that gives the money to programs I know are run by [color=#e23b3b][i]true[/i][/color] Centerscore students...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Things like football, Hector's Party Fund, and this new club... Citizens Against Dumb Spartans... Or C.A.D.S.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not too late, Justin. You can destroy the memo!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You know, ever since I saw that televised kiss between you and Nick, I've had my misgivings about you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because I kissed Nick?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Because you kissed a Spartan! They duped us, Sam! They tricked us into playing their crooked game!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If it weren't for the shady manner of your victory, we'd be under `their` lame thumbs!
nodes.text_bbcode: If it weren't for the shady manner of your victory, we'd be under [color=#e23b3b][i]their[/i][/color] lame thumbs!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're welcome.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I wasn't being nice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what, then? You've just decided to ignore the rules and divvy up my prize money how you see fit?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If that's what it takes to keep them from getting any funding, yes!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Justin, you're being unfair...

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This will be awesome! I've already thought up a bunch of campaign slogans!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ben Kale, your next President! `Kale` to the Chief!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben Kale, your next President! [color=#e23b3b][i]Kale[/i][/color] to the Chief!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Please stop.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Or... Big Ben! He isn't a large British clock, but he knows the time! Time to vote for him that is!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh. Worse!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Kale!` Just like the vegetable! He might make you throw up, but he sure is good for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Kale![/i][/color] Just like the vegetable! He might make you throw up, but he sure is good for you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... That one's not as solid.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I think you should forget about slogans, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That bad?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You haven't even been nominated yet!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, I know you've done `a lot` to increase your rep! You've earned a spot at the Center Table, you've thrown some totes epic parties!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I know you've done [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] to increase your rep! You've earned a spot at the Center Table, you've thrown some totes epic parties!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've started dating `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I've started dating [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That helps...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But if you're ever going to become President, you've got to have an online presence! You need Faceplace friends first!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay. How do I do that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Seriously? `How` are we dating?
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously? [color=#3b78e2][i]How[/i][/color] are we dating?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I told you! I don't use Faceplace. Do I just ask people to be my Faceplace friend?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aaah! No! Don't do that! `Never` ask directly!
nodes.text_bbcode: Aaah! No! Don't do that! [color=#3b78e2][i]Never[/i][/color] ask directly!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do I do then?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You mingle. After you've hit it off, `then,` and only then, do you send them a Friend Invite.
nodes.text_bbcode: You mingle. After you've hit it off, [color=#3b78e2][i]then,[/i][/color] and only then, do you send them a Friend Invite.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is going to take a long time, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not if you do it right! The best thing about Faceplace is that if you snag a friend who's already popular, you'll get Friend Invites from all of `their` friends!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not if you do it right! The best thing about Faceplace is that if you snag a friend who's already popular, you'll get Friend Invites from all of [color=#3b78e2][i]their[/i][/color] friends!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where do I start?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where do you think? With the most popular couples at Twin Branches!
Ben has failed.
Luckily, everyone gets a second chance!
Try again, only this time think twice before refusing the Presidency!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I'd rather stop fixating on being popular and just not worry about Faceplace at all, you know?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Going after popularity was important, Jess, but why did I do it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean, I've pranked Wilson High, I've thrown a Best Party Ever, I've sat at the Center Table...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And only now do I realize that I did it all for you... I love you, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh-huh, that's nice. So, you `don't` care about being popular anymore?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh-huh, that's nice. So, you [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] care about being popular anymore?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not at all... I might even go back to studying regularly. I've already started to spend more time with the nerds!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: As long as we're together, I don't care about being popular!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh-huh. About that... There's something I have to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Go on... You can tell me anything.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where do I begin? How about...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've been manipulating you, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This whole time... I've been manipulating you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I more or less planned your entire break up with Denni, and everything I've done since has been another step in getting you to become President!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I can't believe what I'm hearing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Believe it, Ben! It feels so super good to get this out in the open! You have no idea!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But after Denni, we kissed in your room... Don't tell me that was fake!
For an instant, there's a flicker of something deep in Jessica's eye, a twinge of vulnerability...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It didn't mean anything, Ben! It was all so that you could become President!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why is that so important?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because, Ben! I would totes have all the benefits of being First Lady! Trips to exotic places, my own office, political power!
Ben recoils in horror!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who are you?!
Jessica cackles!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
