nodes.text: Hey! I've spent a lot of time playing football!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And I'm sure you're really good at channeling your inner caveman, but it's not for me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Inner caveman?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! Hold up! I think the problem is that Nick...

options.label: Isn't communicating what he really feels.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you take away all the stressful stuff, you're left with a time of the year when family and friends can get together and love each other.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that sounds really nice. Is that what you meant, Nick?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: More or less...
Nick turns his head so only Ben can hear him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks! Nice save, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was nothing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eating?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, if there are no carols, no decorations, and no gifts, what's left? Good eats!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Many of our impoverished don't even have enough food to sustain themselves during the holiday...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! I'll never eat again!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, I might have been wrong before, but I'm pretty sure Nick didn't mean, 'Don't eat,' $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How can you like this guy, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's not always like this!
Nick turns his head so only Ben can hear him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't think things could get worse with Sam's cousin, but thanks for proving me wrong!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For, you know, stuff?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's trying to get rid of all the stuff!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Would that be so bad?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahh! I can't hear this!
Nick turns his head so only Ben can hear him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't think things could get worse with Sam's cousin, but thanks for proving me wrong!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni hasn't accepted hers...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm not surprised... She does `not` like me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not surprised... She does [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] like me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, well, what do you expect?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As fun as this is, I've got to...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I got nothing. I just don't want to talk to you anymore...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The feeling's mutual.
Afterward, Ben meets up with Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How'd it go?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I sent Friend Invites out to them both...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: First, whatever you just said sounded lame...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And second, what's Faceplace?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You seriously don't know?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You have the most sought-after online friendship and you don't even know what Faceplace is? How is that possible?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Because I have a life, Tweed. Computers are just things I hang my jacket on.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, you know what? My sister does all that computer stuff for me. She's always asking me if I think certain people are cool...
Ben makes a sound of incredulous frustration...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Power-sliding aside, you've always been protective of her, and I can respect that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Crap.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I was going to make fun of you some more, but now it'll just make me look like a jerk.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll take that as a compliment...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: By the way, nice haircut, Tweed. It looks like you're wearing a brown mop for a toupee.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See how I did that? I went there anyway.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I saw.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But that's it. I don't like you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess that `is` it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, I'm really `glad` we had this talk, Ben.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, I'm really [color=#3b78e2][i]glad[/i][/color] we had this talk, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm guessing that's sarcasm.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why don't you ask Jessica?
Nearby, Jessica makes eye contact with Ben.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's... That's great, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I was just thinking about how much I wanted to hear about how happy you are with Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Denni. I shouldn't have brought her up... I guess some of the wounds are still fresh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Something like that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Progress?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I kind of ditched them unintentionally in my quest for popularity.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But, after the Spartan Games, we're spending time together again...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that's good. I always thought you belonged with them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you calling me a nerd?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Haha! Are you denying that you are one?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. I don't think I could while keeping a straight face...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: With?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, uh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: With Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was really hoping to avoid bringing her up... But yeah.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe we shouldn't talk about her...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What about you? How are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm good. I feel like I've made a lot of progress with...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How'd that go?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It went great! Thanks for asking!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: After the corruption at Spartan was exposed, the article got picked up by one of Centerscore's city-wide papers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's really cool! You've always wanted to become a journalist!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Haha! I didn't even really think about it that way until now, but yeah... I `am` a journalist!
nodes.text_bbcode: Haha! I didn't even really think about it that way until now, but yeah... I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] a journalist!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not to brag, but that makes me sound awesome!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. It does.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, you mean my holiday vacation where I saw all the pictures of you and Jessica on her Faceplace account?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She... She posted those?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, and it looked like you two had a lot of fun!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, Denni, I didn't realize...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't... Just... Let's drop it, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, I never got to ask you about your...

nodes.prompt: I never got to ask you about your...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I never got to ask you about your...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You mean, since `I` broke up with `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, since [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] broke up with [color=#3b78e2][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, if you're going to be technical... Not since you broke up with me `the second time.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, if you're going to be technical... Not since you broke up with me [color=#e23b3b][i]the second time.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really? You're going there?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I'm sorry... Forget that. Let me start over...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You'd better...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Tuesday? We didn't talk on...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're joking, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You got me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Haha! I forgot how clever you are...
Ben and Jessica approach Denni and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Colt! You never told me how you managed to beat that Spartan! What was his name? Perry? Gary?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You mean, Percy? That guy... What a toolbox!
Colt turns his attention away from Denni, and Jessica gives Ben the subtlest of winks.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Denni...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh... Hey, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's up? We haven't really talked very much since... You know...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I know, since...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wait a second... You don't still have feelings for Denni, do you?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? No! How could you even say that?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're acting weird, that's how!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well forgive me for acting weird when my current girlfriend is going to tag along while I try to be friendly to my ex-girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not exactly a normal situation!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just watch `how` friendly you are!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just watch [color=#3b78e2][i]how[/i][/color] friendly you are!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, don't worry about that. I'm not exactly in a friendly mood anymore!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah yeah, come on!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You start with `her.` I'll distract Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: You start with [color=#3b78e2][i]her.[/i][/color] I'll distract Colt.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know, I know... And Denni's your ex...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But if you go in there alone, you'll have to deal with Colt and Denni `at the same time!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But if you go in there alone, you'll have to deal with Colt and Denni [color=#3b78e2][i]at the same time![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If I go with you, I can distract Colt while you talk to Denni!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You already thought this through?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sometimes I think I don't give you nearly as much credit as you deserve...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Awww! Come on!
The next day, Ben meets up with Jessica in the hallway.
Across the way, Colt and Denni are talking at Denni's locker.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I don't think this is a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Denni and I were dating not that long ago, and I don't think there's any chance in the world Colt would ever be my Faceplace friend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He and I go together like peas and... And a pea-crushing machine.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Colt and Denni are the new power couple of Twin Branches! The moment Denni changed her status to `Dating Colt...` Faceplace exploded!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt and Denni are the new power couple of Twin Branches! The moment Denni changed her status to [color=#3b78e2][i]Dating Colt...[/i][/color] Faceplace exploded!

nodes.text: Jessica brings up Faceplace on her phone and shows Ben all the comments about Colt and Denni on Denni's Faceplace page.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This comment is just the word 'Yes' over and over, with like a thousand exclamation marks...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know. It's nauseating.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How do people know all these details? Here, look at this post... This girl says Denni kissed Colt's knuckles!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Blech.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do they say anything about us?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... They `love` us!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... They [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] us!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, the point is that even though Colt's Faceplace friendship will be tough to get, it's got diamond-level value!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And Denni's?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Also valuable. She pulls in the hard-to-get hipster and emo crowds... But Colt's the big fish... He reaches everyone else!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... You're coming?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes! Is that a problem?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, not exactly... It's just that...

options.label: Denni and I used to date!

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.text: They push on the door, but it doesn't budge...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's some debris wedged against the door! Everybody, push!
The door begins to give way and then...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Procedure?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, in the event of an emergency, we're all supposed to head through the school quietly and calmly in an orderly manner until we reach the front.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Procedure smocedure, bro!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You mean, `bro`cedure? Anyone? Anyone?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]bro[/i][/color]cedure? Anyone? Anyone?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The roof of the library is gone! I think quietly, calmly, and orderly just got demolished in the `earthquake!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The roof of the library is gone! I think quietly, calmly, and orderly just got demolished in the [color=#e23b3b][i]earthquake![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's `still` an emergency! I know you guys are all new here, but if you violate procedure at this school, you could suffer some serious consequences!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] an emergency! I know you guys are all new here, but if you violate procedure at this school, you could suffer some serious consequences!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hey, guys, I'm Ben! Do you all have your emergency nerd handbooks? We have to follow them blindly, or we'll get in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't sound like that.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: You do, dude. You really do! Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Wait... If we do end up ditching, I bet Ben here will snitch on us!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And if he snitches on us, we'll probably have to talk to... To Ms. Lee...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Awww, man, that woman is crazier than my aunt, and she plays bingo with her cat!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Fine... Let's just do what Nerdbook says!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My name's not Nerdbook!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It is now. Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope you're okay, Jessica... Wherever you are, hang on! I'm coming!
Chad leads them through the debris toward the front door of the library...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Jessica? Oh, man, that's right! I keep forgetting that you're actually `dating` that hot blonde!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica? Oh, man, that's right! I keep forgetting that you're actually [color=#e23b3b][i]dating[/i][/color] that hot blonde!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I'm sorry, dawg, but there's no reason `we` have to go help you save `your` hot cheerleader girlfriend!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry, dawg, but there's no reason [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] have to go help you save [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] hot cheerleader girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... But she does have hot, `single,` cheerleader friends!
nodes.text_bbcode: No... But she does have hot, [color=#e23b3b][i]single,[/i][/color] cheerleader friends!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: He's right! Maybe they're all hurt!
Ben glares at him...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What? `Lightly` hurt.
nodes.text_bbcode: What? [color=#e23b3b][i]Lightly[/i][/color] hurt.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: That'd be awesome! We could be heroes! I'll be like all, 'Let me sweep you off your feet, girl, cause I'm a broom and you're my dustpan.'
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whatever works, I guess... Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope you're okay, Jessica... Wherever you are, hang on! I'm coming!
Ben leads the Spartans through the debris toward the front door of the library...
A weak voice calls out from nearby...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, guys! Do you hear that?
They listen...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: It sounds like a dude!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Help me find him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... We'll go out the back. I don't want to get caught in an aftershock any more than you guys do...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You've finally come to your senses!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, but it feels wrong in my stomach...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Bro, that's probably just all the library dust you've swallowed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-huh...
The guys head toward the back exit of the library...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not leaving the school! Not when people could still be hurt!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It's your funeral then! Come on, Mark!
Chad and Mark head toward the back exit of the library...
`IMPORTANT NEWS!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]IMPORTANT NEWS![/b]

nodes.text: The writers of Surviving High School are working on a brand new series to be sold in Surviving High School's On Demand store...
And for the first time ever, we're letting `YOU` decide what we write!
nodes.text_bbcode: And for the first time ever, we're letting [b]YOU[/b] decide what we write!

nodes.text: Visit www.facebook.com/survivinghighschool and cast your vote for the genre finalist `YOU` want to play!
nodes.text_bbcode: Visit www.facebook.com/survivinghighschool and cast your vote for the genre finalist [b]YOU[/b] want to play!

nodes.text: But `don't wait!` In one week, the vote will close, and we'll crown the winner!
nodes.text_bbcode: But [b]don't wait![/b] In one week, the vote will close, and we'll crown the winner!

nodes.text: So vote now... And make sure the story you want to play wins!
Previously on Surviving High School...
While tutoring the Spartans in the library, an earthquake shook the foundations of Twin Branches, burying Ben, Chad, and Mark in a pile of rubble!
And now...
In the darkened library, Ben coughs...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Chad? Mark? Are you guys okay?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm all right... Chad, where are you?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Over here... I think I broke something...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hold on! Stay right there!
Ben pushes a piece of debris off of himself and scrambles over the desks and chairs toward the sound of Chad's voice.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where are you? What did you break?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: My shades! My classic shades! They're all crooked now!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you serious?! I thought you were `hurt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you serious?! I thought you were [color=#e23b3b][i]hurt![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I `am` hurt. Emotionally. These shades are my life force.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] hurt. Emotionally. These shades are my life force.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'm this close to breaking your life force in two.
The lights flicker on... All around them is the destructive aftermath of the quake...
Toppled bookcases, crumbled walls, and above them, steel beams and dangling wires exposed by the collapse of the ceiling.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh man! We've gotta get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: He's right! The Backbutters aren't supposed to die young!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Chad, stay calm! Mark, just stop sucking so much.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Sorry, bro, I can't help it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've got to see if anyone else is in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa, Braniac! You might be our tutor, but I'm pretty sure `I'm` the one who's gonna say what we do or don't do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa, Braniac! You might be our tutor, but I'm pretty sure [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one who's gonna say what we do or don't do!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And I say we forget about hanging around here, waiting for the rest of the building to fall on us the moment an aftershock hits!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Aftershock?! Aww, man, I am not sticking around for that! You guys are crazy if you think I'm going to be aftershock bait!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know that an aftershock is an earthquake and not a shark, right?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: All I know is one gets you on the water, one gets you on the land! They're `both` scary!
nodes.text_bbcode: All I know is one gets you on the water, one gets you on the land! They're [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] scary!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Exactly! So let's go! There's an exit out back!
Ben leaps from dry patch to dry patch until he's on the other side of the water spill...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nothing to it!
The Spartans follow behind him until each one of them is safely on the other side with Ben.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Made it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: That wasn't so hard...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Kazam! Eat it, professional gymnasts!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... There aren't any gymnasts watching this, Mark. It's not like we're on TV.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Don't rain on the Backbutter parade.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not a sentence I ever expected to hear...
Ben starts to head back into the photo lab but the fire flares up, the heat pushing him back!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not messing with this fire anymore! It's too dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's okay... They're just pictures...
For a second, the two of them watch as the fire consumes the photo lab...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just pictures...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry...
The fire reaches the wall nearest to them and begins to eat through, spreading into the hallway!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on! We've got to get out of here!
Ben and Nick crawl through the smoke toward the entrance!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're there!
On the school's front steps, a huge crowd of students is huddled together, all of them fraught with worry...
Among them, is Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben?! Ben, where are you?!
Another aftershock strikes!
The ground rises up in a rolling wave, the building's foundation makes a low groaning sound, and cracks run through the walls at the school's entrance!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no! Not now!
A steel beam falls through the ceiling panels above Ben and Nick, slamming into the tile floor! A mountain of rubble follows, blocking them from the entrance!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We can crawl through that gap in the rubble there! You go first!
Ben helps Nick through the gap. He turns back to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm through! Come on...
As Ben crawls toward the gap, he hears a hoarse voice calling to him from behind...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ben... `Cough!` Ben, get over here and help me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben... [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough![/i][/color] Ben, get over here and help me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ben? Are you coming?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, go on, Nick! I'm right behind you!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! Go!
Nick turns and runs out, vanishing behind the blanket-thick smoke...
Outside, Nick emerges from the building!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! You're okay?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I am. Over-smoked, but okay...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where's Ben?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He was right behind me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He was?! Oh no!
Jessica marches up the steps of the school and stands at the edge of the school's entrance, unable to see inside...
Ben looks back to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's Denni, she's in trouble!
Jessica's strained voice punctures through the smoke...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben... If you don't come out of there right this second...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm... I'm going to be really `really` mad!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm... I'm going to be really [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] mad!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you hear me?
Time slows down for Ben...
Down the hall, he can make out the orange flickering of the fire, spreading out, coming closer...
He can see the desperation in Colt's soot-framed eyes...
He can hear the worry in Jessica's voice...
And then, he is filled with clarity...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you... Do you hear me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, Jess! I hear you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm okay, but stay out there!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's going on?
Ben looks at Colt...
Ben runs back into the photo lab, the fire now raging! He can hear the walls creaking...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hot![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He grabs the USB drive, turns, and sprints out, just as part of the ceiling comes crashing down!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I got it, Nick! Here!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks... That was both heroic and stupid.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm beginning to think they're kind of the same thing...
Ben rushes into the photo lab! The fire is now burning all around him! On a nearby counter, flames lick at Nick's camera!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There it is!
Ben grabs it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whooo! That's hot!
He tosses it back and forth in his hands as he bursts out of the lab!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I got it!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben. But seriously, you didn't have to do that!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... There's a picture I took of Sam on our first date... It's on a USB drive near the door!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But it's okay, Ben! You don't have to go after it!
Ben heads back into the photo lab!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!` So much smoke!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color] So much smoke!

nodes.text: He grabs a bunch of photos hanging on a wire above his head!
He emerges from the lab and drops them into the box...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's good, Ben... `Cough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's good, Ben... [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is there anything else of value to you in there?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: My camera, but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where is it?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: On the counter on the left!
Ben and Nick rush back into the photo lab where the fire has spread to the walls!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's getting hot!
Ben grabs another stack of photos...
And drops them into the box!
Ben and the Spartans get in position to push on the door... On the inside, Spencer wraps his hand around the handle...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ready! One, two, three... Go!
Ben and the Spartans collectively shove on the door just as Spencer gives it a tremendous yank... The door pops open!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Apologized? For what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For cheating in the Spartan Games...
Ben raps on the door with his knuckles...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spence... If they apologized for cheating in the Spartan Games, would you let them save you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know... What about the test scores?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Our scores didn't affect you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh really? The money you got `could` have gone to us!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh really? The money you got [color=#e23b3b][i]could[/i][/color] have gone to us!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I heard you guys bought lockers made out of gold from all that SET money! Our lockers have the same value as cardboard!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Touche.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guys, I know Spencer. He's about as stubborn as they come... But he's usually stubborn for good reason...
Carson sighs...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I never really felt right about how Percy had us cheating on the SETs, even if it did get us money...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm still getting used to a lunch menu `without` Spartan Lobster Tots...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm still getting used to a lunch menu [color=#e23b3b][i]without[/i][/color] Spartan Lobster Tots...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Nevertheless, I apologize, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah, man, whatever gets us out of here faster! I apologize!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Chad?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I'm not apologizing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, Chad, this would be a pretty progressive step in mending things between our schools!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not only would it be a reasonably nice gesture, considering that you `did` cheat on those tests and you `did` cheat in the Spartan Games, but you'd also get to `save` someone.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not only would it be a reasonably nice gesture, considering that you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] cheat on those tests and you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] cheat in the Spartan Games, but you'd also get to [color=#e23b3b][i]save[/i][/color] someone.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Fine! Fine! Fine! I apologize. For the test scores and the stupid Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Now, can we finally save this guy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Get me outta here!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Haha! Sick! I'll be Bark Mackbutter, billionaire spy, night time crime fighter, and all-the-time ladies man!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You'll be Erik, the nerd we just encountered.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Aww, major downgrade!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Carson, you're Hector. And Chad, you're Ryan! Got it?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah... Let's get this over with...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Spence? I got rid of those dumb Spartans.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Don't push it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahem... I managed to find Erik, Hector, and Ryan...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why would those guys be together?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's an earthquake, big guy. Things aren't exactly normal out here. Anyway, you ready?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... I don't hear them...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... They're right here...
Ben elbows Mark...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Uh, I just finished plugging in my science monitor! Hot boy, I love... Science.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Boom! He just said that! Now let's get this aftershock afterparty rolling!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Also, have any of you guys seen my girl? I miss Mando-Orlando!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Uh... What's going on? Where are all the chicks?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That sounds about right. Let's get this door open!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Remind me why we're following you again!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Seriously... Who appointed this guy leader?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I didn't, that's for sure!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: We should have gone out the back of the library when we had the chance! Now it's too late! We're stuck with you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, guys, but we're closer to the front now... Let's just get there...
Ben leaps onto a dry patch...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See? It's not that hard.
He takes another leap, landing on a wet tile!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Whoop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoop![/i][/color]

nodes.text: His leg gives out from under him, and he is flung into the air, crashing down onto the floor with a splash!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Ha! That looked pretty `hard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! That looked pretty [color=#e23b3b][i]hard![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Shut up, Mark!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We're not going to go this way... We're going to find a different route!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! We're not splitting up!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What other alternative do we have?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... You guys can... Can use me as a stepping stone...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Ha ha! Awesome! Let's step on Ben!
The Spartan guys delight in leaping across the slick patch by using Ben as a stepping stone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You didn't have to jump so hard on me!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'll admit... That was more fun than I thought it would be...
As the group proceeds through the smoke, Ben nods at a familiar door...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, guys. That's Ms. Prez's classroom. That means we're about halfway to the front of the school!
They push forward until they reach a demolished drinking fountain. Water pours out onto the slick floor from a busted pipe...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: That's a broken arm just waiting to happen...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: It's a slippery trap, man! We should just find another way!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, guys, you made it through a grueling, multi-day paintball battle royale! It's just water! All you have to do is step on all the dry patches! I'll show you!
Ben grabs Chad, stopping him!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What are you doing?!
Just then, a huge machine on a cart thunders past them...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Whoa! That would have hurt!
A second later, Erik follows, chasing the cart!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No one was monitoring the monitors! It's the rise of the machines! Save yourselves!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Should we be concerned?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: About a machine uprising, no. About Erik, maybe.
Ben does nothing. Chad takes another few steps...
And a huge machine on a cart slams into him, knocking him over!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Yow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I just got flattened by a machine! What do you think?!
Erik arrives, out of breath...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I sure am glad you were there to stop the seismic activity monitor from crashing into a wall! Thanks, Chad!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Machines, right? They can predict earthquakes, but they just can't steer themselves!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Unless we programmed them to...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ho boy... The future sure is the scariest time!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Right. I'm gonna go now...
Erik hefts the machine back onto the cart and runs off with it. Ben picks Chad up off the floor...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Glad to see you're here to help me `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Glad to see you're here to help me [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, Chad... I should have warned you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, the smoke's getting thicker! We've gotta keep moving!
The group comes to an intersection of hallways... As they step into the center... They hear...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No brakes! No brakes! Runaway seismic activity monitor!
Ben hears the sound of wheels rolling down the hall...
But Chad's slow to react...
The Spartans get out of the way just in time!
Jacob flies by!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Slow down, Jacob! You're going to hurt someone!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sorry! Are you guys all right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... We're fine.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Have you seen Maria?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... No, we haven't...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Okay, thanks... You're sure you guys are okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, we're all right. Go find Maria...
Jacob turns the corner, this time a little bit more cautious...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I thought that guy hated us...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think, in a crisis, petty differences don't matter anymore...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I mean... Watch out!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Aaahhhh!
Jacob collides with the Spartans, all of them falling down together in a massive heap!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What's the matter with you?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What's the matter with us?! What's the matter with you?!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah! You ran into us on purpose!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Why would I do something so stupid?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Because you don't like us... And because you `are` stupid!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because you don't like us... And because you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] stupid!

nodes.text: Jacob grabs Carson by the collar and cocks his fist back for a punch!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Give me one good reason not to, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How about `we just had an earthquake?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: How about [color=#e23b3b][i]we just had an earthquake?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jacob lowers his fist...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now why were you running so fast?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Maria... Have you seen her?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... We haven't...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Okay... Sorry... Just... Sorry...
Jacob scrambles to his feet and runs off, disappearing around the corner...
Ben does nothing, watching wide-eyed as the silhouette nears!
Ben closes his eyes, hoping they'll avoid him...
But Zach slams into Ben, knocking him over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Watch out! We're trying to get Lee to the hospital!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What happened? Is he okay?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: There's no time for talking! Now move!
Ben gets out of the way, and the football players disappear in the thickening smoke...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What's wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought they'd go around me...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: They didn't, man! They ran right over you! You got `so` owned! That was awesome!
nodes.text_bbcode: They didn't, man! They ran right over you! You got [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] owned! That was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not now, Mark. Didn't you see? Lee's hurt. This is serious.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah... Sorry...
As Ben rises to his feet he sees a silhouette in the fog rushing toward the cluster of Spartans!
Ben throws himself out of the path of the players! The Spartans follow suit!
The football players rush by...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Coming through!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Fast reflexes, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!
The stampede of football players disappears in the thickening smoke...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What did he mean by 'man down'?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You didn't see?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I had my back turned.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: They were carrying Lee...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no... I hope he's okay...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Me too...
Just then Ben sees a silhouette in the fog rushing toward the cluster of Spartans!
They topple into the hallway! As they get to their feet, Ben takes in his surroundings...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh my...
All around them is complete and utter chaos...
Water gushes from a broken pipe, students run wildly through the halls, and smoke billows in from somewhere unknown...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Cough cough!` Let's go! Everyone, this way! Stay low!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough cough![/i][/color] Let's go! Everyone, this way! Stay low!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I can't see a thing!
Ben leads the Spartans down the smoke-filled hall toward the front of the school...
Suddenly, footsteps pound from behind as a squad of football players rounds the corner and barrels toward them!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Outta the way! We've got a man down!

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.text: Sam is about to squeeze the trigger...
When one of Chad's lackeys bursts from the trees and shoves her!
Sam falls into the river with a large splash!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Aaaaaaaahhhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aaaaaaaahhhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cold water swallows her, dragging her down.
Sam lets go of her gun and fights to swim to the shore, but the rushing river carries her downstream.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm moving really fast!
Sam opens her eyes, fighting to see what's ahead...
And sees sharp rocks jutting out of the water!
She tries to paddle out of the way, but the current sweeps her into one of the rocks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Owwwwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Owwwwww![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam feels a burst of pain shoot through her right arm!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My arm! I... I can't move it!
Helpless against the current, Sam uses her left hand to stay afloat as the river carries her away...
Some time later...
Sam manages to catch hold of a tree root in the water.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Help! Someone, `help!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Help! Someone, [color=#3b78e2][i]help![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is useless... There's no one out here!
Suddenly Sam hears the splashing of feet into the river.
Strong arms come around Sam and help her to the shore.
On land, Sam and the person who rescued her both take in deep gulps of air.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, uh...
She looks up at her savior.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh! You are really stunning... I mean, uh, stunningly soaked!
He sticks his hand out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Hi... I'm Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You... You're a `Spartan!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You... You're a [color=#3b78e2][i]Spartan![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Actually... I think there might be one over there!
Angie points down the hall, where Tom and Kim are having a fight!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I just can't believe you said that to Mr. Russell! He's, like, the nicest teacher in the school!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't care how nice he is, his interpretation of free-market capitalism is completely off the mark! I'm not going to sit by while he peddles that rabble-rousing drivel!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Next thing you know, he'll be telling us to Occupy Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You don't get to tell teachers how to do their job!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, I shouldn't `have` to...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I shouldn't [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ugh! Is this what you're always like in school? A self-entitled jerk?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You know, all this time, I figured you were a free-thinking independent like me... Who knew you were a meek, little teacher's pet?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh, you did not just go there...
A few feet away, Justin turns back to $Scott and Angie...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Do you not follow any gossip? Kim and Tom are, like, a perfect couple! They never used to fight...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But now, being at the same school is tearing them apart!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But that doesn't make sense. They're spending more time together than ever! Shouldn't that just make them happier?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You `really` don't know anything about relationships, do you?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] don't know anything about relationships, do you?

nodes.text: $Scott wraps his arm around Justin's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Relationships are funny things, little buddy. They have their own very delicate rules and systems, and they don't always make sense.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: They're sort of like a board game, except you've lost the rulebook, the cards are in German, and you're pretty sure one of the pieces is actually a thumb tack.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That sounds horrible!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, it's all right. The point is, if it works, you don't question it... But if you start changing things around too much... Everything falls apart.
Down the hall, Kim punches Tom in the arm.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `Ow!` Seriously?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color] Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Right now, Tom and Kim are suddenly seeing much more of each other... And they're suddenly seeing way more of each other's flaws!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The school merger is tearing their relationship apart! You have to do something about it!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Right, right...
Justin trudges over to where Kim and Tom are arguing...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And what was with you strolling into class ten minutes late?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So I overslept a little! What's the big deal? You've never overslept?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, no, because I own a clock. Are you too poor to own a clock? Are clocks a 'rich guy' thing?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Excuse me, uh, fighting couple...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... I couldn't help but overhear you two having a bit of a conflict... And I thought I might be able to help...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you, the guidance counselor? This place really scrapes the bottom of the barrel...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No, he's just the school President. And he's apparently giving dating advice now...?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Right, well, I just thought you two should consider...
$ZOE collects herself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look, I know transferring to a new school must be very hard for all of you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want you to know, it doesn't have to be like this. I'm sure we can all work out a way to peacefully coexist!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We just need to start over, right?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hardly. This has been amusing, but we're Spartans. We don't compromise, we don't peacefully coexist, and we don't lose.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Now I'd recommend that the football team clear out of here.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: The cheerleaders, on the other hand, are welcome to stay!
Mark jumps off of his horse and leans closer to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: If I were you, I'd start reconsidering that boyfriend of yours. If you want to date a `real` winner, start with the polo team.
nodes.text_bbcode: If I were you, I'd start reconsidering that boyfriend of yours. If you want to date a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] winner, start with the polo team.

nodes.text: Mark drapes his arm around $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: How you doin', girl?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, time to put this guy in his place.

options.label: Not if you were the last guy on earth!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, Colt... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! I'm `not` okay! This was supposed to be our first date! This was supposed to be special and nice and all that stuff... But instead it's been a total disaster!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] okay! This was supposed to be our first date! This was supposed to be special and nice and all that stuff... But instead it's been a total disaster!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, it wasn't like that! It's not `your` fault those guys were jerks! There will always be people like that...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it wasn't like that! It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] fault those guys were jerks! There will always be people like that...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But it is my fault, Denni! If I hadn't joined The Immortals... If I hadn't run off to Spartan... Heck, if I hadn't crashed Tom's limo, all those years ago...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I try and try to be a better man... The man you deserve... But I can't. It's just not possible. Not here. Not with my past.
Colt gets up and starts to walk away...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, `please!` Come back!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt, [color=#3b78e2][i]please![/i][/color] Come back!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Sorry, Tiny Hipster. I... I gotta go.
Denni stands up after him.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `No!` Don't you walk away from me! Don't you DARE!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color] Don't you walk away from me! Don't you DARE!

nodes.text: Colt glances back, struggling to find something to say...
Then turns away and walks off.
That's all for Colt and Denni...
Now let's see how Ben is doing!
Just then, Preston comes up to Chad...
Preston inspects the trap in Chad's locker. He sniffs the bottle.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: This is a complicated compound aroma. The trap itself was rigged by someone intelligent. An A-student with access to a variety of chemicals.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Like that Ben Kale guy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-oh!
Ben tries to run away, but before he can, Chad sees him!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Stop that science nerd!
A hand reaches out from the crowd of students and grabs Ben.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Going somewhere?
Chad storms over to Ben, flanked by Preston.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You set a trap in my locker and now you're going to pay!
Carson rolls up his sleeves.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Let's get this over with, shall we?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm... I'm not going to fight. I can't beat three of you!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! He's a chicken!
Chad shoves Ben!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Bawk bawk-bawk `baaaaaawk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Bawk bawk-bawk [color=#e23b3b][i]baaaaaawk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Perfect chicken impression, Carson!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am `not` a chicken!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a chicken!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then how come you haven't signed up for the Spartan Games yet?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I haven't signed up yet because...

nodes.prompt: I haven't signed up yet because...

options.label: I didn't know registration had opened.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I haven't signed up yet because...

nodes.text: They press forward, going down the mountain trail.
At the bottom of the trail is a larger pool of water where the stream opens up into a lake.
The cheerleaders run to the beachy area.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I can tan!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's beautiful out here! Can we swim?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You want to swim? But you don't even have suits!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Not a problem for me.
Nicole takes her shirt off, revealing a stunning bikini.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why are you wearing that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You know, just in case I get cornered by a Spartan guy and have to talk my way out of it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you needed a bikini...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Every little piece helps!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emphasis on the `little...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Emphasis on the [color=#3b78e2][i]little...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I could use a nap.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I guess we can have a little down time...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! We can't let our guard down now!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Hector! Noooooo!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hector! Noooooo!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Amanda charges at the Spartans, her gun shooting paintballs in random directions!
She takes out a handful of them, but there are still a few left who dodge her attacks.
When Amanda's clip empties, Carson steps up to her.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I hate to do this to a beautiful woman, but...
Carson points his gun to shoot.
Amanda raises her gun reflexively and deflects it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Whoa, that was kind of awesome...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You want to see something awesome?
Amanda hurls her empty paintball gun at Carson. It hits him square in the chest, and he topples over!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ow!
Amanda runs to stand near Jessica and $ZOE. The three girls retreat towards the water.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, what's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We shoot them.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can't! I threw Lucy out!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE and I can take them!
Jessica aims and shoots at Preston and Chad!
But nothing happens!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: My gun! It's not working...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I think it broke when I fell in the water!
Chad and his cronies approach the girls.
Their backs to the water, $ZOE, Jessica, and Amanda ponder their imminent disqualification.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Well, well, well... Looks like you ladies have one gun and nowhere to turn.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Let me handle this.
Jessica puts on her best sad face and pleads with Chad.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Please, you don't have to do this.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't think you really want to pull the trigger.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Clearly, you don't know me.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah really. He hasn't had a girlfriend in forever. The sad puppy face won't work on him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, drat.
$ZOE steps up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can't we strike up some sort of deal?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: We don't deal with terrorists!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're not terrorists. We're `girls.` We're harmless... We don't pose a threat to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: We're not terrorists. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]girls.[/i][/color] We're harmless... We don't pose a threat to you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wouldn't it be more of a challenge to let us get our bearings, practice shooting at things, and then face us down later?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No! I didn't come here looking for a challenge, I came here to win!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Which is why you're going down now! Boys, ready your aim!
The Spartan boys raise their paintball guns.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm too young to be sprayed with paint!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love paint, but why does it have to be so mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I'm going down, at least one of them is coming with me!
$ZOE pumps her gun.
Just as the boys are about to shoot...

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: `Stop right there, or you'll be blue and green before you can even say the word 'Mommy'!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Stop right there, or you'll be blue and green before you can even say the word 'Mommy'![/i]

nodes.text: $ZOE turns to the sound of the voice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... It's `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's... It's [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just who is $ZOE talking to? And are they friend or foe?
Will $ZOE be rescued, or will she be shot?
Find out next time on Surviving High School!
And finds himself staring right into Chad's smug face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh oh.
There's the soft `fttt!` of a paintball gun firing, and a bright blast of red paint splatters across Colt's chest!
nodes.text_bbcode: There's the soft [b]fttt![/b] of a paintball gun firing, and a bright blast of red paint splatters across Colt's chest!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Agh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Agh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh, that `felt` great! It was almost worth everything else just to get to do that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, that [color=#e23b3b][i]felt[/i][/color] great! It was almost worth everything else just to get to do that!

nodes.text: Colt staggers back, deflated.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: But what? You honestly thought we `didn't` all know you were here? You're as stealthy as my grandmother, and she has severe intestinal problems and is missing a leg!
nodes.text_bbcode: But what? You honestly thought we [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't[/i][/color] all know you were here? You're as stealthy as my grandmother, and she has severe intestinal problems and is missing a leg!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's... Weird and sad...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: As weird and sad as you falling into such an obvious trap?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, probably not that sad...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But don't you start patting yourself on the back just yet, Snaggletooth. You might have gotten `The Ghost...` But the Hipster is still out there, and she will avenge me!
nodes.text_bbcode: But don't you start patting yourself on the back just yet, Snaggletooth. You might have gotten [color=#e23b3b][i]The Ghost...[/i][/color] But the Hipster is still out there, and she will avenge me!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Actually... We found her hiding in the bushes and took her out five minutes ago.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh. Well, then. That sucks.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I guess... I guess we're done here...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Mmmm... Not quite.
Chad fires again, shooting Colt in the chest with another paintball!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Agggh!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Now` we're done!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Now[/i][/color] we're done!

nodes.text: Chad happily walks off, leaving Colt standing in the darkness, splattered in paint.
Colt watches him go, and he knows...
And finds a gagged Tom tied to a chair just inside!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Trrrpp! `Trrrrp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Trrrpp! [color=#e23b3b][i]Trrrrp![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold on, Fancypants, I got you...
Colt rushes over to Tom and starts to untie him...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `TRRRRRP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]TRRRRRP![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Keep it down, would you?! I said I got this!
Tom thrashes and kicks! Colt rips his gag off!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?! What is it? What are you trying to say?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I think he's trying to say `'trap'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think he's trying to say [color=#e23b3b][i]'trap'.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt freezes up. In the office's window, he can see the reflections of Ryan and Travis lurking in the shadows!
They level their paintball guns at Colt's back, and he raises his hands in the air.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Heh, heh... Gotcha!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you goons doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: The Spartan guys asked us to guard Richbutt here for them!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: They said they'd give us a cut of the prize money if we did!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? And you really expect those idiots to keep their word?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: If `we're` the idiots, why'd you walk right into our trap?
nodes.text_bbcode: If [color=#e23b3b][i]we're[/i][/color] the idiots, why'd you walk right into our trap?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Yeah! And you didn't even bring your paintball gun!
Colt looks Tom in the eye. Tom scowls...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How could you be so stupid, Colt?! Did you really not think this was a trap?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I was counting on it.
Earlier that day...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, Tiny Hipster. But this is how it's got to be.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Does it?
Right now...
Colt dives forward, knocking Tom to the ground!
Above them, the window swings open! Denni leans in, a paintball gun in each hand, and blasts the room!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `Agggggh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Agggggh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: It's the Hipster! She's out for blood! Trendy, alternative blood!
Travis and Ryan try to run but get splattered with paint!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `Nooooo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Nooooo![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now get out of here!
Travis and Ryan throw down their guns and sulk off.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: This sucks!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I can't believe you convinced me to play this stupid game! I'm gonna punch you in the kidneys!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Aw man! I like my kidneys!
They leave. Denni runs over and helps Tom and Colt up.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No time to celebrate, boys! The other Spartans will be here any minute!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You don't have to tell me twice!
Tom and Colt scramble out the window!
The three of them rush across the school grounds and into the woods! Behind them, the remaining Spartans fire wildly!
Paintballs explode in their wake! Bright, red paint splatters everywhere! Colt, Denni and Tom sprint as hard as they can...
And burst into an empty grove!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hfff... `Hfff...` I think we made it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hfff... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hfff...[/i][/color] I think we made it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I've got to give you credit, Colt... You're crazy and stupid and reckless... And there's no one who I'd rather have watching my back!
Colt spins around to Denni.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We pulled it off, Princess! Your plan went off without a hitch!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... Not exactly.
Colt glances down... And sees a big, red splotch on Denni's shirt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No...
Denni falls to her knees.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Colt. It was a stray shot while we were running... I wasn't fast enough. I let you down.
Colt grabs her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, it... It wasn't your fault...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Promise me you'll win this for me, Colt. Promise me you'll make those Spartans pay.
Colt pulls Denni close.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I promise, Denni! I promise! I'll get them all for this! I'll get `them all!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I promise, Denni! I promise! I'll get them all for this! I'll get [color=#e23b3b][i]them all![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... You do realize she's not `actually` dying, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... You do realize she's not [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] dying, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Shut up, Tom.
Colt gently kisses Denni, then stands up and pumps his gun.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's payback time.
Wow! It sounds like Colt is pretty serious about revenge... But will he be the one to win the grand prize?
Find out next week, in the riveting conclusion to the Spartan Games!
He has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Sam turns the doorknob to Justin's office...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Listen, I should probably sit somewhere else...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! Wait! Stay just another moment!
Sam reluctantly stays seated. Jessica leans forward...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sam, we really like you, and we're concerned about the relationship between you and us.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I remember how tense it was when Taylor was Head Cheerleader, but it's not like that anymore, I assure you.
Slowly, as if on cue, the girls grab up $ZOE's cupcakes and begin eating them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you getting at?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We want you to come back to the cheerleading team!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We could have so much fun together! Just like old times!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's just like a party every day!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I would be so nervous cheering next to someone famous!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You have to come back!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We could gossip about guys together!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That all sounds good... But I know the real reason why you're all suddenly being extra nice to me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You want to make sure I give some of the prize money to the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Jessica?! Is that why you had me bake these cupcakes?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shh, $ZOE! Not now!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I can't come back to cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't you like us?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's not that... She just thinks she's better than us now that she's got some popularity!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is that it, Sam? Do you think you're better than us?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I don't. I just don't think cheerleading is good for me. When I was in cheerleading, I really hated...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Colt, why don't you talk to Ben for a moment? I'd like some girl time with Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, great. Girl time.
Jessica leads Denni away...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tweed? When did you get here?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was just talking to...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Relax. I didn't mean anything by it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What did you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just trying to... To patch things up between me and Denni, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, you pretty much blew it with the Hipster.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think it was just a lot of miscommunication...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or... It could be that you're the kind of guy who gives `Jessica` the perfume you made for Denni...
nodes.text_bbcode: Or... It could be that you're the kind of guy who gives [color=#e23b3b][i]Jessica[/i][/color] the perfume you made for Denni...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I'm the kinda guy who saves her from danger by power-sliding my motorcycle under a helicopter before it explodes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just saying...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, Colt, I'm not here to get into a chest-beating contest or anything like that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm here to talk to you too, actually...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, there's nothing to patch up between `us,` Tweed. We don't like each other.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, there's nothing to patch up between [color=#e23b3b][i]us,[/i][/color] Tweed. We don't like each other.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know you don't like me, but...

options.label: I need you to friend me on Faceplace!
At least you're looking out for Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about Colt?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nothing... I don't think Colt's going to accept my request anytime soon...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why not? Wait... You didn't mention Faceplace, did you?
Spencer reaches out and takes Ben's phone from his hand.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yoink.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Faceplace? That's so lame. What are you doing, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm trying to get friends. Give me back my phone, or I'll scuff your shoes.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not funny! What's my `one` rule?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not funny! What's my [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] rule?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We do not talk about Fist Club?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, right... Well I'm adding a second one... No threatening my shoes!
Spencer hands the phone back to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why do you suddenly care about Faceplace?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't tell anyone... But I'm going to run for President.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah? That's cool. You'll become, like, Mr. Popular.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... I don't get it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What does Faceplace have to do with being President?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica said I won't have a chance of becoming President as long as I have zero Faceplace friends...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Jessica... Man, I should have known.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're whipped, bro. W-I-P-T.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on! You can't be `that` bad at spelling.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on! You can't be [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] bad at spelling.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who needs spelling when you can just punch stuff?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's scarily logical, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I am `not` whipped!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] whipped!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah... You just told me it was her idea for you to get more Faceplace friends.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, to become President!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And running for President. That was your idea?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, no, that was hers too... But it's a good idea!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What about this new look you've been sporting?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Well...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine. It was her idea to make me over! Maybe I listen to her a lot, but that doesn't make me whipped!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just don't want her to leave me...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Aww, man! I `know` you're not this lame! She asks you to jump, and you say 'How high?'
nodes.text_bbcode: Aww, man! I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you're not this lame! She asks you to jump, and you say 'How high?'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What if she asks you to do something you don't want to do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not going to happen!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What if it already has?
Ben pauses...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't understand... Why are you always doing whatever `she` wants?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't understand... Why are you always doing whatever [color=#e23b3b][i]she[/i][/color] wants?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, next up... Chad and Algebra.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I don't need to do this! No one needs to know how to do math anymore!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We've all got computers and phones that can do math for us!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, you think you don't need math?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine, then let's have a quick, real-life lesson in math...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I can teach Chad that not knowing `how` to use math will hurt him financially, he might pay attention!
nodes.text_bbcode: If I can teach Chad that not knowing [color=#e23b3b][i]how[/i][/color] to use math will hurt him financially, he might pay attention!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You got any money on you?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Just pocket change...
Chad pulls a $100 bill from his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! `That` is pocket change?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] is pocket change?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Let's just get on with the math lesson, all right?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... Let's say you decide to buy something with your $100 bill.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It costs $40.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Pfft! Like anything `only` costs $40...
nodes.text_bbcode: Pfft! Like anything [color=#e23b3b][i]only[/i][/color] costs $40...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway, here, I'll give you back $60.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This is just a piece of paper that says $60!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't carry that kind of cash around, so pretend, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, wait! I forgot that there's a 10% tax. So, I'll just take four dollars from you...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Nice try! You think because I don't know math, you can trick me!
Chad whips out his phone and pulls up a calculator app...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Okay, let's see, um... I want to figure out how much I owe you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Here's my chance to trick Chad...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: So I input an amount to tax which is... Uh... How much?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... You want to tax...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's keep moving...
The group presses on.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How's everyone doing?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where are you, Jessica?
Just then, Ben hears a voice calling from the restroom...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale? Is that you? Help me out! I'm stuck in here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spence?!
Ben tries to push the door open, but it doesn't budge.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't get the door open! Is something blocking it?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! I think the quake messed up the door! I can't get it open!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... You pull, and I'll push! Ready?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One, two, three... Go!
Ben pushes as Spencer pulls, but the door is still stuck.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We need more manpower! Come on, guys!
The Spartans step up to the door...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... Who's with you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, Chad, Carson, and Mark.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Spartans?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Ex`-Spartans, yeah.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ex[/i][/color]-Spartans, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Go find someone else!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: They're cheats! They cheated to get good test scores, and they cheated in the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not going to have those guys save me! If they do, I'll owe them! And I don't want to owe `them` anything!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not going to have those guys save me! If they do, I'll owe them! And I don't want to owe [color=#e23b3b][i]them[/i][/color] anything!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, you don't have a choice! It's chaos out here! There's no one else!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not going to pull if they're the ones pushing!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Let's just leave him!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah! He doesn't even want to be saved, man! He's in the restroom! He's got everything he needs for survival in there, anyway!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What exactly do you think is in there? It's a restroom, Mark, not a grocery store!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: All I'm saying is... I could last.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, what if you guys...
