Episode Four: The Spartan Games, Part 2
Episode Five: The Spartan Games, Part 3
Episode Six: Eyes on the Prize

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey new, hot Ben, I heard that you signed up for the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I did.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Aren't you worried?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not really... What's there to be worried about?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I heard, like, almost no students from Centerscore have signed up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Really?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah... And today's the last day for registration.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If there aren't any Centerscore students, the Spartans will pick us off one-by-one!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, at least you signed up. That's something to be proud of.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...
Jessica leans in close to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I have to tell you something...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A... A lot of people see me as this strong, bossy girl...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But do you remember how I was when you first came over to my place?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course. You were... Vulnerable.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I was. That was... That was the real me. I don't show it often because...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because sometimes you have to be what people need you to be, not who you are.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I think right now they need you to be a leader.
Ben looks around the cafeteria. Everywhere, he sees Centerscore students, their eyes turned downward.
He stands up...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, everyone, can I have your attention?
The students look up...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm Ben Kale.
A ripple of murmurs runs through the students.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, I know. I look different, but trust me... I'm still the same guy who gets A's on my tests and throws Halloween masquerade balls!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Sit down, loser.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I won't! I won't because I just found out some disturbing news...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just found out that only a handful of you have signed up for the Spartan Games.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What chance do we have? They're called the `Spartan Games!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What chance do we have? They're called the [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan Games![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't argue with that...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Then sit down!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But what I can say is this...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If we don't participate in these games, there's a very real chance that the Spartan guys will run our school the same corrupted way they ran theirs.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you really want to lose the spirit of Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Think about what this school has done for you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now I don't know your story...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if you're a popular girl who found salvation with nerds...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if you're a bully who reformed himself to become a star linebacker...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! That sounds like me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Or just a nice girl who found lasting love...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I do know `my` story. I know that this is a place where a person can change.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I do know [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] story. I know that this is a place where a person can change.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where you can be a nerd and `become` popular... If that's what you want!
nodes.text_bbcode: Where you can be a nerd and [color=#e23b3b][i]become[/i][/color] popular... If that's what you want!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But how easy do you think it will be to change once Spartan's got us in the clutches of their class system?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Rise up, Centerscore! If you've already signed up, stand up! Be proud!
The group keeps moving until finally...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can we stop now? It seems like everyone's a little beat...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not me! Nature invigorates me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I could leap the Himalayan mountaintops... Run the African plains... Graze like a gazelle!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... Erik. You do that. The rest of us will sleep.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Awww...
The group sets up camp, building a small fire and pitching tents taken from the cabin.
Right before everyone turns in, Ben calls them to the center.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't think it's a good idea to sleep without a lookout.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who wants to take the first shift?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Erik, when you're not falling asleep, you're falling into traps! No way are you on shift.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I can't. I'm so tired... Yawn... I promise to take the next shift though.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll do it. I'm not tired anyway.
As everyone settles down to sleep, Sam sits alone by the fire and keeps an eye out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I never liked forest sounds...
Above the comforting sound of the fire crackling, Sam can hear the haunting noise of owls hooting and twigs snapping in the distant dark.
She draws her gun close.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It is a little lonely out here...
Sam hears footsteps behind her. She turns and finds Nick.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you mind if I join you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wouldn't mind some company.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Otherwise, I'd just sit here thinking about all those crappy Spartans in the woods that are out to get us.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, no offense.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: None taken. Although I hope you don't hold the fact I'm a Spartan against me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... It's kind of nice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, to realize that our schools don't always have to be fighting. That we can actually get along.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course, I wish more Spartans were like you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know some of the guys can be intense, but we're not all bad. We're just... Adjusting. All we've ever known is Spartan.
Nick takes a seat on the log next to her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So why aren't you sleeping?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't like forest sounds. Same as you, I'm guessing.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I saw you jump when the owl hooted.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're weird, all right?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm not arguing with that.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So, how's your elbow?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's still there.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Glad to see it's hanging on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It certainly feels a lot better. Thanks to you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Any guy would have done the same.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't know the guys I know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They'd probably try to help, but they wouldn't know the safe end of a bandage if it hit them in the face.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Is there a dangerous end of a bandage?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They wouldn't have picked up on that either.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not extremely perceptive then.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, you're the first guy I've talked to in a while who hasn't brought up a funny sports joke or made a terrible sports reference.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Clearly I haven't been making the `right calls.` I need to `get my head in the game` if I'm `going to go for the gold.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Clearly I haven't been making the [color=#e23b3b][i]right calls.[/i][/color] I need to [color=#e23b3b][i]get my head in the game[/i][/color] if I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]going to go for the gold.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Groan... Don't even start. I've had enough of it from Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Who's Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Big guy. On the football team. He's...
While Ben deals with the Spartans, Jessica sprints around a building and through a garden area.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't believe we're trapped here! I'm too close to victory to leave the game now!
Jessica runs around a path in the garden and stops short.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hello, Jessica.
In front of her stand Taylor and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `You.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I just want everyone to be happy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what I want.
Taylor draws her gun and points it at Jessica at the same time Jessica points hers at Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why are you doing this?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what do you say? Do you want to run for President this year or not?

nodes.prompt: Do you want to run for President?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you want to run for President?

nodes.text: She holds up a shirt to Ben's frame, eying how it looks.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Are you qualified for this?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course! I know what a hot guy looks like! Just let me do this, okay?!

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.text: There is a long quiet moment...
And no one stands up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really, guys? Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, dude, it's just not worth the risk. I'm hoping to get a football scholarship into college... I can't risk getting hurt over some dumb paintball contest.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, Ben, it's `way` too dangerous! I can't risk injuring these programmin' hands!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, Ben, it's [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too dangerous! I can't risk injuring these programmin' hands!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But... But school pride...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, this school's okay, but it is `not` worth getting shot with paint over!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, this school's okay, but it is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] worth getting shot with paint over!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nothing is!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't even like `looking` at paint!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't even like [color=#e23b3b][i]looking[/i][/color] at paint!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So none of you are signing up?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm not!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Me neither!
As soon as they're gone, the bell sounds!
The Centerscore crowd surges toward the ladder! Ben gets shoved forward!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He's pushed toward the ladder! He climbs, following the people in front of him up to...
The top of an enormous slide!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Gulp!` Long way down!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gulp![/i][/color] Long way down!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hurry up, dummy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... So?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Even if I don't like it... I have to admit that I'm not as good at this `nature` and `survival` thing as you are...
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if I don't like it... I have to admit that I'm not as good at this [color=#3b78e2][i]nature[/i][/color] and [color=#3b78e2][i]survival[/i][/color] thing as you are...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, I just wanted to say 'thanks' and to tell you that, for now, I'll listen to you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But don't think I'll tolerate it when we're in school again and things are back to normal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course not.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You think we can win these games?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...
$ZOE is suddenly interrupted by loud shouts in the distance!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're turning on me? After everything we've been through?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick. It's just... I was thinking over what Jacob and the guys were saying.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I am Centerscore. And you are Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It just wasn't meant to be.
Sam squeezes the trigger and shoots Nick!
Nick puts a hand to his stomach where yellow paint has splattered.
He looks at Sam with hurt eyes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I thought... We got along so well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, Nick...
As Nick walks off, Zach pops up and shoots Sam!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha! For Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Zach! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You were consorting with the enemy, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And Phil said you came down with Stockholm whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It's better I take you out now.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Just in case you turn.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Those are zombies.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Exactly!
Sam stalks out of the cabin, her chances of winning the Spartan Games falling as fast as her tears.
Looks like Sam didn't trust the right people this time around!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're splitting up to look for an opening. They could come from anywhere, so it's better to be careful...
A thunderous crack erupts from the back of the house!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The back! It sounds like one of them broke the door off its hinges.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who's going to pay for that?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure Carson's family will manage.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Find cover!
Sam scans their available options.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We could hide behind the kitchen island or go into the bedroom...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, let's find cover...
Late that night, Colt creeps on his belly through the brush...
Up ahead lies a big, empty, old school building.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look at that... While Denni and I were huddling in the mud and pulling bugs out of each others' hair, the Spartans were living large in Babytown Elementary!
A Spartan guy walks out and looks around. Colt ducks back down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I could try to crawl my way up through the bushes... Or I could rush the back door when the guy's back is turned...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, if `I'm` the sane, rational one here, there's a `big` problem.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, if [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the sane, rational one here, there's a [color=#3b78e2][i]big[/i][/color] problem.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I knew it was too much power for Jessica to take two weapons at the last cache drop!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shut up, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's it going to take for everyone to drop their weapons?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't know, but I don't like the way you're looking at me, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd better be careful what I say next...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, guys. Seriously. Lower your guns...

nodes.text: Before Ben knows it, he's surrounded on all sides by Spartans and trapped behind the counter!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Have any last words, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Please don't?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Fire!
Ben is bombarded by paintballs!
Ben sets the bottles out in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I want to make it super explosive, then I need to mix some chemicals with the paint...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I have to mix these in a very specific order.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The red bottle has to go in first, then the `white` bottle...
nodes.text_bbcode: The red bottle has to go in first, then the [color=#e23b3b][i]white[/i][/color] bottle...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then the `green` bottle and finally, the `yellow` bottle...
nodes.text_bbcode: Then the [color=#e23b3b][i]green[/i][/color] bottle and finally, the [color=#e23b3b][i]yellow[/i][/color] bottle...

nodes.text: Outside, Ben can hear the Spartans approaching.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I hope you're ready to go down, Ben! I know you're in here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need to do this quickly!
Ben dumps the red bottle in the sack and reaches for the...
While the other cheerleaders take care of their own matters, $ZOE runs desperately away from the square down one lane of the town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know where to go!
Suddenly, $ZOE can hear the far off noise of ducks quacking in the distance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What on earth?
$ZOE follows the sound around a building. Down the street she's on, she can make out a practice shooting gallery.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The duck noises are from the plastic ducks you shoot at!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This must be a sign...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey! I see one of them! Near the gallery!
$ZOE looks to the porch where Chad and Carson are directing teams of Spartans.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: After her!
She hears the thundering of feet and knows the Spartans are almost on her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Time to run!
She hurtles down the lane towards the shooting gallery!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But before I tell you, I have a few things to say...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've `never` been more embarrassed to be a Centerscore student than I've been today.
nodes.text_bbcode: I've [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] been more embarrassed to be a Centerscore student than I've been today.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All I've heard all day long is 'We deserve this' and 'We need that'!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, we do need that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Amanda! Not the time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know the swim team needs a swimming pool...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And a trip to...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A swimming pool!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know the cheerleaders need... Well, they don't need an on-campus dance club...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That was at the top of our request list!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know they actually need a new sound system!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Blech.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's better than nothing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How are you this cheerful?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know the nerds need seismic monitor whatevers...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Whoop!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know the football team needs a new field.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's right, Samface!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know all of this because you kissed up to me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And while you were all kissing up to me, you were also telling me that the Spartans shouldn't get anything!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: They shouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's hard not to deny them every cent, given their behavior... But they're still people!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, we didn't really do anything...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Zip it, Chad!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So yeah, some of the Spartans are ginormous jerks...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But they need new horseshoes for their horses...
Some of the crowd starts booing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is what I'm talking about.
Sam looks at Nick...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Someone told me today that there will always be an us and a them...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But they were wrong.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The problem isn't whether I should give money to the Spartans.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We need to realize right now...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...That there aren't any more Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We brought them into our school... That means they're a part of us now!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Spartans... Are Lizards now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, they are! But there also isn't really a Centerscore anymore either!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whoa, Sam! What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: As of right now, this school is no longer called Centerscore.
Sam sees Principal Shapiro standing in the back of the cafeteria. Shapiro nods at Sam with a smile.
The crowd buzzes with excitement!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are we called?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're... We're Twin Branches now. Two schools that are part of the same tree.
Angie stands up...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Kind of like when you make a choice and there are two `branching` paths that extend off of it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Kind of like when you make a choice and there are two [color=#3b78e2][i]branching[/i][/color] paths that extend off of it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That came from nowhere, but yes, like that too.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about the money?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Simple. Everyone gets the small things that they want.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Seriously? No dance club?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Deal with it. It's `my` choice.
nodes.text_bbcode: Deal with it. It's [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] choice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I'm choosing to use the money to try to heal our wounds... Instead of just making them deeper.
A small wave of protest goes up...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. I'm not changing my mind. This is final.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So instead of whining and complaining and begging... I suggest you start getting to know each other. Because we're all in this together now.
As the groups whisper amongst themselves, Sam goes over to Nick...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick. I didn't mean to call you heartless. I think you've got a big heart.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, no worries. I'd have been pissed off too if a girl who liked me ended things before they even got started.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, you do like me?
Nick blushes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let's change the subject... I have to say, what you just did was probably the most impressive thing I've seen today.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Today only, huh?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe this week...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on. I want to show you something...
Nick gets up and follows Sam toward the cafeteria exit...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you think everyone will be okay?
They look back... Erik gets up from his seat and sits down in between Chad and Carson.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hi! I'm Erik! I'm a Capricorn! That's the sea-goat!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know about you guys, but if I ever saw a real-life sea-goat, I'd probably swim away...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or run away... You know depending on whether I saw it in the ocean or on land.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What's with this guy?
Howard sits down across from Chad...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He'll grow on you. Anyway, welcome to Center... I mean, Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Uh, thanks.
Sam smiles...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it's going to be different. But I think it'll be okay.
A few minutes later, Sam leads Nick into the music room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This is... The music room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And the new photography lab!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I told you I'd make sure some of the money went toward you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But you didn't know we'd be simpatico...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That doesn't change the fact that you needed this.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, this is definitely the `new` most impressive thing I've seen today.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, this is definitely the [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] most impressive thing I've seen today.

nodes.text: Nick looks around the room...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just imagining what this room will look like with computers, photographs, and cameras...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh yeah, there aren't any cameras in here... That reminds me...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Of what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was just thinking we could share our first off-screen kiss...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I only kiss with an audience.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up and get over here...
Nick holds Sam around the waist, and the two of them kiss for a long, long time...
Wow! Sam bridged the gap between Spartan and Centerscore and created `Twin Branches!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow! Sam bridged the gap between Spartan and Centerscore and created [b]Twin Branches![/b]

nodes.text: Not only that, but things are heating up between her and Nick!
And all thanks to you! With everyone's eyes on the prize, you kept Sam's heart where it mattered most! You played a great game!
Don't forget to purchase a `Story Vote Ticket` in the On Demand Store!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't forget to purchase a [b]Story Vote Ticket[/b] in the On Demand Store!

nodes.text: Play through four sneak peeks, and then vote on which genre you want to play!
But whatever you do... `Don't wait!` In one week, the two genres with the fewest votes `will be eliminated...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But whatever you do... [b]Don't wait![/b] In one week, the two genres with the fewest votes [b]will be eliminated...[/b]

nodes.text: So vote now... And make sure the story you want to play wins!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going to spend the money on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Myself!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Myself![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That's so selfish!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But... Our dance club?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This decision is too hard. It's apparent that all of you are either self-centered, cold-hearted, or worse, Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Therefore, I don't see anyone worthy of the prize money... Except me, of course!
While the crowd sits there stunned, Sam turns to exit the cafeteria... Nick grabs her arm as she passes...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam? Are you sure you want to do this? You're going to send the school into chaos!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't see any alternative. Besides, how bad could it get?
A few weeks later...
Sam's helicopter touches down in the middle of the football field!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Awesome! After my vacation in Italy, I feel so well-rested! Sleeping in helps too, now that I can get to school in two minutes!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey! We're practicing here! You can't land a helicopter at midfield!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just did! What are you going to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And think real hard before answering, Zach, because I can spend money on things to make the football field `worse` than it already is!
nodes.text_bbcode: And think real hard before answering, Zach, because I can spend money on things to make the football field [color=#3b78e2][i]worse[/i][/color] than it already is!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Worse? How?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... I heard Dex was interested in studying the sleeping patterns of gophers. This field seems like the kind of fertile soil they'd enjoy.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Grrr... I don't have any complaints.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good.
As Sam heads toward the school, Zach calls out to her...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to go there without a pad and helmet?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heh. You'll see!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Dumb jock!
Sam steps into the hall, but it's completely empty...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where is everyone?
The moment Sam reaches the middle of the hall, she hears a war cry!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Spartans! Attack! No mercy!
Doors and lockers swing open, and Sam gets riddled with paintballs!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: We got another one!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: The uprising continues! Spartans forever!
Nick appears at the end of the hall...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! Look at what they've done to me!
He pulls out a paintball gun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Not you too!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam... There's an us and a them. I'm with us. And you're with them.
He pulls the trigger, and paint spills red onto Sam's chest... Right over her heart...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Noooooo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Noooooo![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Well, Sam tried to combat selfishness with some selfishness of her own...
But it doesn't look like the pleasure of spending the money on herself was worth ruining Centerscore!
You have to play again! And this time, while everyone's eyes are on the prize, try to keep Sam's on what really matters!
Don't forget to purchase a `Story Vote Ticket` in the On Demand Store!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't forget to purchase a [b]Story Vote Ticket[/b] in the On Demand Store!

nodes.text: Play through four sneak peeks, and then vote on which genre you want to play!
But whatever you do... `Don't wait!` In one week, the two genres with the fewest votes `will be eliminated...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But whatever you do... [b]Don't wait![/b] In one week, the two genres with the fewest votes [b]will be eliminated...[/b]

nodes.text: So vote now... And make sure the story you want to play wins!
Ben's phone buzzes again...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's a text from Jessica! It says, 'meet me near Lyle statue. now.'
Ben starts to head toward the Lyle statue but stops himself!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's like Spencer said... `I'm obeying her!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's like Spencer said... [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm obeying her![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe being President is her idea, but it `is` a good one. I want to become President! I'm just going to do it `my` way, starting right now!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe being President is her idea, but it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a good one. I want to become President! I'm just going to do it [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] way, starting right now!

nodes.text: Ben sends a text back to Jessica: 'no. going to get friend invites from nerds.'
Ben's phone immediately rings!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She'll just have to call back later!
He ignores it and steps back into the library, passing Tom and Jeeves as they leave...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Done studying?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Thomas studies at his best at home without any distractions obscuring his thoughts.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I just wanted to update my status on Faceplace...
Inside, Ben looks around for a few minutes...
Then he walks over to where Chad and Mark are still studying...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, guys, have you seen any of the nerds? Normally, they're in here.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, I saw them! They were all excited because of some nerdy monitor thing acting funny...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Any idea where they...
Suddenly, the ground tilts up, shaking violently! Books slide off of the desks! An entire bookcase falls to the ground with a deafening crash!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Stop, drop, and roll! Stop, drop, and roll!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's an `earthquake,` not a fire!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's an [color=#e23b3b][i]earthquake,[/i][/color] not a fire!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What do we do then, smart guy?!
Another bookcase topples over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Get under the table! Cover yourselves!
The power shuts off!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Where'd the table go?!
Then there is a loud tearing, a scream of concrete as the foundation of the library slips and the ceiling collapses in on them with a permeating finality...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The ground stops shaking, and all is silent in the rubble...
Silent and still...
Except for a few, faint coughs...
What's happened to Ben and the Spartans?!  Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!
And don't forget to visit www.facebook.com/survivinghighschool and cast your vote for the genre finalist `YOU` want to play!
nodes.text_bbcode: And don't forget to visit www.facebook.com/survivinghighschool and cast your vote for the genre finalist [b]YOU[/b] want to play!

nodes.text: In two weeks, the vote will close, and we'll crown the `winner!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In two weeks, the vote will close, and we'll crown the [b]winner![/b]

nodes.text: So vote now... And make sure the story you want to play wins!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I guess I'm just not very good at getting Faceplace friends...
Ben's phone buzzes again, and he checks his Faceplace account.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? How is this possible? I've got `negative two friends!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What? How is this possible? I've got [color=#e23b3b][i]negative two friends![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just then, Taylor and Brendan walk by Ben...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, Ben!
Taylor's phone buzzes, and she checks it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I'm losing friends!
Brendan's phone buzzes...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! Me too!
$Scott and Hector come over...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's up, kids? You guys seem...
$Scott's phone buzzes...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ahh! All my friends are leaving me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ha ha! That's funny 'cause you care so much about...
Hector's phone buzzes...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? No, dawg, no! My friends! Years of progress! `Noooooooooo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What? No, dawg, no! My friends! Years of progress! [color=#e23b3b][i]Noooooooooo![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't understand... What's going on?!
Meanwhile, in the Faceplace Headquarters, several engineers burst into the office of CEO, Spud Spuckerburg.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What is it? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nerd
nodes.text: Spud! It's happened! The one thing we feared!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: You don't mean...

nodes.speaker: Nerd
nodes.text: Yes! A black hole of patheticness...

nodes.speaker: Nerd
nodes.text: A complete loser at a school in the Bay Area named Ben Kale... He's so pathetic, anyone who gets near him `loses` Faceplace friends!
nodes.text_bbcode: A complete loser at a school in the Bay Area named Ben Kale... He's so pathetic, anyone who gets near him [color=#e23b3b][i]loses[/i][/color] Faceplace friends!

nodes.speaker: Geek
nodes.text: Wait wait wait... Isn't that impossible, given, you know, pretty much everything we know about how the internet works?
Spud stands up and slaps him across the face!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: This isn't the time for logic!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Now, I thought we accounted for this! Isn't that why we give Faceplace users a friend the moment they join?

nodes.speaker: Nerd
nodes.text: Yeah! We planned for that, Spud! But Faceplace `itself` refused to friend this kid!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! We planned for that, Spud! But Faceplace [color=#e23b3b][i]itself[/i][/color] refused to friend this kid!

nodes.speaker: Nerd
nodes.text: We didn't count on `the system` rejecting someone because they were too lame.
nodes.text_bbcode: We didn't count on [color=#e23b3b][i]the system[/i][/color] rejecting someone because they were too lame.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: This Ben Kale guy... He must be a... A perfect storm of loser...

nodes.speaker: Nerd
nodes.text: What do we do, Boss?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: The only thing we can do... We have to shut Faceplace down...
Later, Ben sits in class, surrounded by an angry crowd...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I'd love to plan a party this week... But without Faceplace, I guess I'll just read a book.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's actually not that...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Don't,` Ben, just... `Don't.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't,[/i][/color] Ben, just... [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not comparing a book to TV, dude. I'm comparing it to Amanda in a bikini!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And I'd `love` to post all the pictures I took from the motorcycle show I went to this weekend...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'd [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] to post all the pictures I took from the motorcycle show I went to this weekend...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But without Faceplace, I'll probably just, like, have them developed in a couple of days! Ugh!
Next to Ben, Erik giggles.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik? You're not upset with me for singlehandedly destroying Faceplace?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, heck no! I don't use Faceplace! I use Buddybongo! Look, my friend just drummed me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, then... Are we friends?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... Well... I'm kind of the top dog on Buddybongo...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And you're worried that I'll do the same thing to it that I did to Faceplace... I understand...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, I mean, as soon as Jessica found out that I was the only one with any online friends, she asked me out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She did?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, she thinks I could be President!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Anyway, I'd love to be your friend!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But you should probably factor in that I'm dating your woman...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow... I did not see this coming...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gotta go! She's going to show me how to kiss the way the French do!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hear it's scintillating!
That got out of hand in a hurry! You probably guessed it, but this is not the ending Ben wanted!
Try again, and see if you can prevent him from completely absolving one of the most popular social networks!
And don't forget to visit www.facebook.com/survivinghighschool and cast your vote for the genre finalist `YOU` want to play!
nodes.text_bbcode: And don't forget to visit www.facebook.com/survivinghighschool and cast your vote for the genre finalist [b]YOU[/b] want to play!

nodes.text: In two weeks, the vote will close, and we'll crown the `winner!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In two weeks, the vote will close, and we'll crown the [b]winner![/b]

nodes.text: So vote now... And make sure the story you want to play wins!
The fire reaches the wall nearest to them and begins to eat through, spreading into the hallway!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on! We've got to get out of here!
Ben and Nick crawl through the smoke toward the entrance!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're there!
On the school's front steps, a huge crowd of students is huddled together, all of them fraught with worry...
Among them, is Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben?! Ben, where are you?!
Another aftershock strikes!
The ground rises up in a rolling wave, the building's foundation makes a low groaning sound, and cracks run through the walls at the school's entrance!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no! Not now!
A steel beam falls through the ceiling panels above Ben and Nick, slamming into the tile floor! A mountain of rubble follows, blocking them from the entrance!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We can crawl through that gap in the rubble there! You go first!
Ben helps Nick through the gap. He turns back to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm through! Come on...
As Ben crawls toward the gap, he hears a hoarse voice calling to him from behind...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ben... `Cough!` Ben, get over here and help me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben... [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough![/i][/color] Ben, get over here and help me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ben? Are you coming?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, go on, Nick! I'm right behind you!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! Go!
Nick turns and runs out, vanishing behind the blanket-thick smoke...
Outside, Nick emerges from the building!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! You're okay?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I am. Over-smoked, but okay...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where's Ben?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He was right behind me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He was?! Oh no!
Jessica marches up the steps of the school and stands at the edge of the school's entrance, unable to see inside...
Ben looks back to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's Denni, she's in trouble!
Jessica's strained voice punctures through the smoke...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben... If you don't come out of there right this second...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm... I'm going to be really `really` mad!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm... I'm going to be really [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] mad!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you hear me?
Time slows down for Ben...
Down the hall, he can make out the orange flickering of the fire, spreading out, coming closer...
He can see the desperation in Colt's soot-framed eyes...
He can hear the worry in Jessica's voice...
And then, he is filled with clarity...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you... Do you hear me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, Jess! I hear you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm okay, but stay out there!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's going on?
Ben looks at Colt...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I have to help Colt save Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, the school's not safe! The whole thing could collapse at any moment!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know! That's why I have to go `now...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know! That's why I have to go [color=#e23b3b][i]now...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I love you, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben! You don't know what you're doing! Listen to me and get out here this instant!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I `am` listening to you, Jess. I'm just not `obeying` you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] listening to you, Jess. I'm just not [color=#e23b3b][i]obeying[/i][/color] you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What is that supposed to mean?!
Ben turns around...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben? Ben?! `Ben?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben? Ben?! [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He crawls to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's get Denni out of here!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Follow me!
Ben and Colt crawl into the classroom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!` I got most of the wall pieces off her, but... But...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color] I got most of the wall pieces off her, but... But...

nodes.text: Ben gasps when he sees Denni... She's lying awkwardly, her leg splayed out at an unnatural angle...
And pinned by a massive concrete boulder!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just couldn't lift it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Denni...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Denni...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Denni's eyes open weakly, and she turns her head toward Ben...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just couldn't get enough of me, could you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. Let's, uh, let's get this off of you...
Ben and Colt stand on either side of the boulder...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ready...
They heave with all of their might, but the boulder doesn't budge...
Out in the hall, another section of the school roof collapses!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is `not` happening!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] happening!

nodes.text: Colt throws his whole body against the boulder, every ounce of his strength concentrated on moving it...
But it still doesn't budge!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've got an idea...
Ben crawls back into the hallway and retrieves the steel beam that had fallen just a minute earlier...
He returns...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you thinking?! We're not going to be able to break it, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not why I brought it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Archimedes said, 'Give me a lever long enough, and I shall move the world.'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't care what some dead Greek guy said! Just do whatever it is you're going to do!
Ben shoves one end of the beam underneath the boulder and puts his weight on the exposed end...
The boulder begins to lift!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Son of a...
Colt runs over and adds his weight to the beam...
The boulder lifts up...
And rolls off of Denni, its great mass slamming onto the floor with a loud `thud!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And rolls off of Denni, its great mass slamming onto the floor with a loud [b]thud![/b]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Ow! Ow! Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ow! Ow! Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How do we get her out of here?
A few tense seconds later... Ben and Colt emerge from the school, Denni's arms around each of their shoulders!
Rescue workers help them away from the building...
Just as the walls of the school entrance collapse behind them!
The sun begins to set, and the students of Twin Branches look on as firemen put out the flames that were ravaging the school...
Among the students are a range of emotions...
`Gratitude...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Gratitude...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, Ben, uh, Mark just wanted to say thanks for getting us out of there...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Mark` wanted to say that?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Mark[/i][/color] wanted to say that?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah. What a sap!
`Relief...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Relief...[/b]

nodes.text: Jacob holds Maria in his arms while she cries...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I was so scared. I didn't know where you were...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `Sniffle!` Well, you found me now!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sniffle![/i][/color] Well, you found me now!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Heh. I'm not letting go anytime soon.
`And worry...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]And worry...[/b]

nodes.text: In the parking lot, Colt brings his motorcycle up to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She got taken to Centerscore County Hospital. See you there?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I heard Lee's there, too...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She's okay, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just her leg. She's tough.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The toughest.
Colt starts to drive off, but stops himself...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I, uh, I know it's a weird time to bring this up... But I accepted that Friend Invite you sent me on Faceplace...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Faceplace?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Your girlfriend told me that might mean something to you...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Figured it was the least I could do, you know, after...
Ben notices Jessica looking at him from across the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Anyway, see you there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm right behind you...
As Colt speeds off, Ben holds Jessica's gaze. The feeling between them is a mix of all those emotions and more...
Among them, a fragile, desperate grasp of love.
Finally, Ben breaks his gaze, gets inside his car, and heads to the hospital...
That was intense! You helped Ben save the ex-Spartans, rescue $ZOE, Howard, Sam, Nick (and his photos), and did the right thing by helping Colt save Denni!
In short, you transformed Ben into a real life hero! You played a great game!
And don't forget to visit www.facebook.com/survivinghighschool and cast your vote for the genre finalist `YOU` want to play!
nodes.text_bbcode: And don't forget to visit www.facebook.com/survivinghighschool and cast your vote for the genre finalist [b]YOU[/b] want to play!

nodes.text: In one week, the vote will close, and we'll crown the `winner!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In one week, the vote will close, and we'll crown the [b]winner![/b]

nodes.text: So vote now... And make sure the story you want to play wins!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, Colt... You heard her... I have to go...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?! You're going to abandon Denni?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't have a choice, Colt! This entire place is going to come down at any moment!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't believe this! Go on then! Save yourself!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Watch me!
Ben turns and crawls away, heading out of the school...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben! Ohmygosh! I was totes worried!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I'm... I'm okay now.
A few minutes later, Colt and Denni emerge from the school, Colt cradling Denni in his arms!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We need an ambulance!
Several of the football players help out, placing Denni in a nearby ambulance. It speeds off toward the hospital...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, it looks like you didn't need me after all...
Colt wheels on Ben, punching him in the face! Ben drops immediately!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She could have died, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I told you, I didn't have a choice!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Abandoning her `was` a choice! If you've learned anything at this school, you should have at least learned that your choices have consequences!
nodes.text_bbcode: Abandoning her [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] a choice! If you've learned anything at this school, you should have at least learned that your choices have consequences!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hope you're ready to live with this one!
Jessica comes to Ben's side...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He's wrong, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, he's not. He's completely right.
Weeks later, Ben walks down the newly rebuilt hallway... But all he sees are looks of scorn.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is everyone mad about?
Nearby, Erik drops a copy of the school paper on the ground...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't read anymore! Scandals give me heart palpitations!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Scandal?
Ben picks up the paper and looks at the headline...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no! Denni's latest article is a recap of the events of the earthquake!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Everyone knows what I did!
Just then, Denni hobbles around the corner on a pair of crutches.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni, wait...
She limps past him, not even giving him the slightest glance...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Denni...` I'm sorry...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Denni...[/i][/color] I'm sorry...

nodes.text: Well, that was heavy! It also wasn't the outcome Ben wanted!
Play again, and see if you can get a more heroic ending!
And don't forget to visit www.facebook.com/survivinghighschool and cast your vote for the genre finalist `YOU` want to play!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I gotta say, it took me quite a while to undo all the crap you pulled today... All your pathetic little compromises... But rest assured, it's done.
Chad turns to the Spartan guys.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You guys don't have to worry about sharing this place anymore. From now on... We `rule` this school!
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys don't have to worry about sharing this place anymore. From now on... We [color=#e23b3b][i]rule[/i][/color] this school!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Says who?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I guess I'm being rude. The name's Chad Slater. I'm the new school President!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But... `I'm` the school President!
nodes.text_bbcode: But... [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the school President!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I don't know how that could be... I mean, `I` was elected President of Spartan Academy... Well, technically Vice-President, but we all know what happened to Percy...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know how that could be... I mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] was elected President of Spartan Academy... Well, technically Vice-President, but we all know what happened to Percy...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh, I hate to break it to you, `Chad,` but we're not at Spartan. We're at Centerscore High. And I'm President.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, I hate to break it to you, [color=#e23b3b][i]Chad,[/i][/color] but we're not at Spartan. We're at Centerscore High. And I'm President.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah? According to who?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The... Democratic process?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh really? And who exactly voted for you? I know `I` didn't. Did any of you guys vote for him?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh really? And who exactly voted for you? I know [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] didn't. Did any of you guys vote for him?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I didn't!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Me neither!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Me `neither!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Me [color=#3b78e2][i]neither![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What? It's true! I voted for 'cheesecake!'

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I gotta say, Justin, this doesn't feel all that democratic to me! If 300 students didn't get to participate in an election... Well, that doesn't really seem fair!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Wow, Chad, you sound... Different...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Amazing what two weeks of intensive tutoring will do, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I hate to admit it... But Chad kind of has a point. I mean, I'd hate to have `him` as my President if I didn't get to have a vote...
nodes.text_bbcode: I hate to admit it... But Chad kind of has a point. I mean, I'd hate to have [color=#e23b3b][i]him[/i][/color] as my President if I didn't get to have a vote...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: See? Even `dumbhair` agrees with me! That means I `have` to be right!
nodes.text_bbcode: See? Even [color=#e23b3b][i]dumbhair[/i][/color] agrees with me! That means I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to be right!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But... What am I supposed to do? We already have an election coming up... I guess you can run against me...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I was mostly hoping you'd just resign and spare yourself the humiliation.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: See, when it comes to elections, one thing's true... In the end, it all comes down to money.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You think you can buy votes?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Now? No. But we'll see what happens once I claim the grand prize of the `Spartan Games!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now? No. But we'll see what happens once I claim the grand prize of the [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan Games![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A shocked murmur passes through the room. The Spartan guys stare at Chad reverently.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...The what now?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The Spartan Games! An annual tradition at our former institution... And one we proudly plan to bring to this school!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: A grueling, three-day, school-wide competition of strength, smarts, and skills... And at the end of it, for the last man standing... An incredible $100,000 grand prize to use towards any school-related expense!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: My, uh, ears must be malfunctioning... Because I could `swear` you just said $100,000!
nodes.text_bbcode: My, uh, ears must be malfunctioning... Because I could [color=#e23b3b][i]swear[/i][/color] you just said $100,000!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: All the wealthiest families of Spartan pool together to create the prize! It's meant to pit all of us against each other... And discover who the strongest truly is!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That sounds like a terrible idea...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: For weak, timid cowards? Perhaps. For us Spartans... It's the best three days of the year!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Now do me a favor and just resign, would you? You might walk out of here with a `shred` of dignity...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now do me a favor and just resign, would you? You might walk out of here with a [color=#e23b3b][i]shred[/i][/color] of dignity...

nodes.text: For one moment, Justin starts to back down... Then boldly steps forward!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I don't like being defied...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sure you don't, and you probably don't like being beaten either...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But you're going to have to get used to both. Because we're going to kick your butts in these Spartan games, and then `I'm` going to kick `your` butt in the student elections!
nodes.text_bbcode: But you're going to have to get used to both. Because we're going to kick your butts in these Spartan games, and then [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] going to kick [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] butt in the student elections!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How do you like `those apples?`
nodes.text_bbcode: How do you like [color=#e23b3b][i]those apples?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Them apples.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How do you like `them apples?`
nodes.text_bbcode: How do you like [color=#e23b3b][i]them apples?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: ...Fine then. You want to dig your own grave, pipsqueak? You can be my guest.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Spartans... To me!
Chad storms away.
The other Spartan guys glance at each other for a few moments, and then turn and follow him.
Justin turns back to $Scott...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well? Was that inspiring enough for you?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, actually, that was pretty good...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Also totally crazy! You just committed us to competing against the Spartans in some kind of massive brawl!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... That's not that crazy, is it? I mean, we've got a shot at winning, don't we?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...How bad could it be?
Well, it looks like Justin found his strength as a leader... But what's going to happen in these Spartan Games?
Find out on the next `Surviving High School!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Find out on the next [b]Surviving High School![/b]

nodes.text_bbcode: Previously on [b]Surviving High School...[/b]

nodes.text: Chad convinced the Centerscore Administration to run the Spartan Games, a massive, 3-day paintball battle... With a $100,000 prize!
Justin volunteered to compete... But will the other students at Centerscore have his back? Find out now!

nodes.title: The Contestants
nodes.subtitle: Who will compete in the Spartan Games?

nodes.text: As $ZOE and Howard are heading to class, Justin walks by and hands them a black flyer with a skull and crossbones on it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's this?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The Spartan Games! You guys are signing up, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That crazy paintball battle-contest? Why would we sign up for it?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Um, because there's a $100,000 prize! Imagine what Centerscore could do with that money...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And imagine what Spartan would get up to!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't want to think about that.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not to be overly dramatic, but the fate of our school depends on it!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...But no one's stepping up to compete. $ZOE, will you sign up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... I'm not sure about that...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't get it! No one I've talked to wants to join. $ZOE, why aren't you interested?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To tell you the truth, it's...

nodes.prompt: To tell you the truth, it's because of...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: To tell you the truth, it's because of...

nodes.text: Late one night, Ben and Spencer step into Ben's father's laboratory...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My dad saves all the essences that his company rejects.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Essences. Smells. He manufactures them, but they aren't always, you know, rosy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't understand. What does this have to do with anything? I thought you were gonna help me find a way to stick it to that buttface Chad!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Trust me. The answer lies in here... What did Chad do to you anyway?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, he was a big, dumb jerk who ruined the school with his dumb face and acted all dumb all the time?
Spencer slams his fist on one of the lab tables.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I should just punch in his face during the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right, calm down. Some of this stuff is expensive...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine. Have you registered for the games yet?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Um... No... Not yet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My name's at the top of the list! You'd better hurry up before registration closes, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I will.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway, what's the plan to prank Chad?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're going to put a spring-loaded perfume trap in his locker!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Perfume? We're going to make Chad smell like a girl?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! Haven't you been paying attention? We're going to make a `stinky` perfume.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Haven't you been paying attention? We're going to make a [color=#e23b3b][i]stinky[/i][/color] perfume.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Help me look through these bottles for awful smells...
Ben and Spencer look through the various bottles of essence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! This one's called `Hog Sweat!` I bet it smells horrible!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! This one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Hog Sweat![/i][/color] I bet it smells horrible!

nodes.text: Spencer uncorks the bottle and holds it under his nose...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, I wouldn't...
Spencer takes a big whiff!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Yuuuuuuuck!` It smells so bad!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yuuuuuuuck![/i][/color] It smells so bad!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll just go ahead and label that one as `Stinky.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll just go ahead and label that one as [color=#e23b3b][i]Stinky.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A few minutes later, after looking through all the bottles...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Looks like we've got several to choose from.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: First, I'll start with a base of `Hog Sweat.`
nodes.text_bbcode: First, I'll start with a base of [color=#e23b3b][i]Hog Sweat.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben pours half the bottle of `Hog Sweat` into a large bowl. Spencer leans away from it as he stirs.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben pours half the bottle of [b]Hog Sweat[/b] into a large bowl. Spencer leans away from it as he stirs.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get that stuff away from me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then, I'll add some essence of...
On the perimeter of a vast, enclosed estate, students from Centerscore and Spartan gather around the two Presidents, Justin and Chad.
In the growing crowd around them, Ben nudges his way through, finally settling beside Taylor, Brendan, and the rest of the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can you believe it, Brendan? Everyone is here for the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... It's incredible.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you think we have a chance?
Brendan awkwardly glances away, clearly trying to avoid talking to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Is something wrong?
Taylor leans across Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, Brendan happens to be a nice guy... And I get that you're all, like, `hot` now or whatever...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Brendan happens to be a nice guy... And I get that you're all, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]hot[/i][/color] now or whatever...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But get a clue! We don't talk to `anyone` who abandons friends for popularity the way you did!
nodes.text_bbcode: But get a clue! We don't talk to [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone[/i][/color] who abandons friends for popularity the way you did!

nodes.text: Taylor pulls the nerds back into the crowd, away from Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that just Taylor talking... Or do the guys think I abandoned them too?
Chad powers on a megaphone...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Welcome, Spartans and losers, to Carson's father's estate!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: In just a few moments, the Spartan Games will begin!
All the Spartan guys hoot and holler!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What's this? A lack of enthusiasm from Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Heh. It's probably because you guys already know you're going to lose!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Grrr!
Welcome back to Surviving High School! It's still anyone's victory in the Spartan Games!
Last we left off, $ZOE, Amanda, and Jessica only had one working gun and were facing off against three Spartan leaders!
The Spartan boys raise their paintball guns.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm too young to be sprayed with paint!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love paint, but why does it have to be so mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I'm going down, at least one of them is coming with me!
$ZOE pumps her gun.
Just as the boys are about to shoot, a voice rings out from behind $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Stop right there, or you'll be blue and green before you can even say the word 'Mommy'!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Stop right there, or you'll be blue and green before you can even say the word 'Mommy'![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE looks back and sees Sam and several other figures emerge from the water, wearing scuba gear and brandishing paintball guns.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: It's a water ambush!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Sure. Of course this happens.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so glad to see you guys!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nice to see you again too, cuz.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now let's paint these dirtbags!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: It might be a good idea to get out of here...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, right! She's bluffing. The paintball guns can't handle water. They're all waterlogged.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We have them right where we want them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not unless we found water-proofing spray with all this great scuba gear.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You lie!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Actually, my dad does have all that stuff in our pool house...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?!
Sam shoots one of Chad's Spartan lackeys. He goes down in a spray of paint!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You were saying?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Now we get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Spartans, cover our escape!
The Spartans come together to help Chad, Carson, and Preston retreat.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, these guys bug me so much!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, we can't let these guys get away!
The swim team rushes forward.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: `Raaaaaaaawr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Raaaaaaaawr![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yar?
The swim team girls open fire and hit some of the Spartans!
Sam opens fire and pelts the last of the Spartan underlings with paint!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on! I can still see them! We can make it if we run!
Sam disappears into the forest.
Through the brush, Sam can still make out the backs of Chad's team.
She dashes through the thicket, keeping them in her line of sight...
When they bank left through a tight patch of trees, Sam manages to burst through!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, come on, come on!
The Spartan boys pick up their pace, now sprinting through the forest like nimble deer following the riverside.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no, you don't!
Deep in the woods at the far end of the Spartan Games Preserve...
A young man is dragged through the trees with his wrists bound and a bag over his head!

nodes.speaker: Masked Man
nodes.text: Mfff! Hfffflpf!
Two rough hands shove him into a chair and rip off the bag, revealing...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yo, man, this ain't cool! You can't just kidnap me like this!
Two shadowy figures approach him, slowly drifting into focus...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All's fair in love and war, Backbutter...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And me and the Princess here got plenty of both!
Denni turns to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, no offense, but could I just handle the one-liners?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That wasn't good? I thought it was clever, you know, because we're a couple and we're, you know, at war...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I get the intent, but it wasn't structurally clear, you know?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine, fine, I'll do the shooting, you do the talking...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: `Hey!` I hate to break up this little love-fest, but what's going on here? You two better let me go!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hey![/i][/color] I hate to break up this little love-fest, but what's going on here? You two better let me go!

nodes.text: Mark tries to lunge up, and Colt and Denni both level paintball guns at his chest!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Or maybe I'll just sit here quietly. Would that work better for you guys?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's probably for the best.
Eyeing them warily, Mark sits back down.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: What do you want with me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're gonna have a little chat, Mark. Play along, and you might just walk out of here unsplattered.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Give me trouble, and, well...
Colt rolls up his sleeve, revealing 14 lines drawn down his arm in marker.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why don't you ask your 14 missing Spartans how it worked out for them?
Mark's eyes go wide with horror.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: No! It... It can't be! Not you! It was a myth! A legend!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: There's a rumor going around about two mysterious Centerscore players who stalk the woods, picking off Spartans one-by-one!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: According to the rumor, they hunt in the shadows and creep through the darkness... They know no fear or hunger... And they mark every kill on their arms!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: They call them... `The Ghost` and `The Hipster!`
nodes.text_bbcode: They call them... [color=#e23b3b][i]The Ghost[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]The Hipster![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, time out! You get to be The Ghost, and I'm still The Hipster? Why do I have to be The Hipster?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, you're the one in the skinny jeans, you tell me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Behind them, Mark tries to sneak out of his chair again...
And finds two barrels jammed in his face!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You best sit your little butt down, Mark... Or we'll paint you up like a white picket fence!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: See? I've got the one-liners covered.
Mark sits down again. Colt turns and gets in his face...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now listen here, Mark. I'm gonna ask you a few questions, and you're gonna answer them.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where are the rest of the Spartans?!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I'm... I'm not telling. And there's nothing you can do about that.
He crosses his arms over his chest. Denni pulls Colt aside.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How do you wanna play this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I say we...
`IMPORTANT NEWS!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]IMPORTANT NEWS![/b]

nodes.text: The writers of Surviving High School are working on a brand new series to be sold in Surviving High School's On Demand store...
And for the first time ever, we're letting `YOU` decide what we write!

nodes.text: Purchase the `Story Vote Ticket` in the On Demand Store, play through four sneak peeks, and then vote on which genre you want to play!

nodes.text: But whatever you do... `Don't wait!` In two weeks, the two genres with the fewest votes `will be eliminated...`
