And now...
Everyone at Centerscore is in the middle of the vicious and brutal Spartan Games, and now it's come down to the last few contestants!
In this finale, find out who will win the grand prize once and for all!
In the cafeteria, the Centerscore camp of students crowd around a TV to watch the Spartan Games with interest.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Okay, I got up for popcorn. Did anyone else get painted while I was gone?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ugh, who knows? All I can see on my screen are $ZOE, Amanda, and Jessica. And they keep arguing about boots...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll tell you who got painted! Jacob, Phil, and Zach!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, there goes some of the eye candy. This just got more boring.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, what you should be focusing on is that they were killed by Sam, that traitor!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well, anyone can see `why.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, anyone can see [color=#3b78e2][i]why.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, they were threatening her and Nick.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Don't get me started on Nick. The point is...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's three less Centerscore students with a chance to win!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And there's only so many people left...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Most of the cheerleaders, the rebels, and the nerds were taken out.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't forget about the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Right right... There are only a handful of Centerscore students still in there. And you know who `else` is still around?
nodes.text_bbcode: Right right... There are only a handful of Centerscore students still in there. And you know who [color=#e23b3b][i]else[/i][/color] is still around?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `Chad.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Chad.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Meanwhile, in a cabin on Carson's vast family estate...
Sam and Nick sit on the couch, examining their options.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Looks like our time here is coming to an end.
Nick gestures to their rations: a sack of candy, a bag of pretzels, and an unopened can of beans.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There's a couple bottles of water left as well.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'd think a house like this would have more supplies.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah well, they probably understocked it on purpose. It gets boring when people stay in the same place the entire time.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I'm not going to lie... We don't have much left.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, at least we have...
As they walk off, Sam turns to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, we really pulled it off!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I admit... I had my doubts when you presented the plan to me.
A couple minutes earlier...
Nick and Sam duck behind a mountain of guns.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Where should we run?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to run anymore. I'm tired of these Games, and I'm sick of Chad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want to take all of them out in one swoop.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How do you want to do that? I shot some of the Spartans before they could retreat.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't have any bullets left in my paintball gun...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I only have four shots in mine... Is there any ammo in this mountain of guns?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Unfortunately, this was just a big trap. I checked a couple, but they're empty.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then we'd better make these paintballs count. How do you think we can get close?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, maybe we can use this whole Spartan-Centerscore rivalry thing to our advantage...
Present time...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But it all seemed to have worked out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nice shooting there, partner.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I couldn't have done it without your superb acting skills...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Then it was a team effort.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look what Centerscore and Spartan can do when they actually work `together.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Look what Centerscore and Spartan can do when they actually work [color=#3b78e2][i]together.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah really. We did it. We made it to the end.
They smile at one another...
For a moment, time stands still...
Then they step together in a kiss!
Nick winds his arms around Sam, and she pulls him closer!
The two kiss for an endless moment... Then pull away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You... We...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Kissed in front of the entire school...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I really `did` betray my school...
nodes.text_bbcode: I really [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] betray my school...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Did you?
The sound of a paintball breaks the silence.
Nick looks down at his black shirt where a yellow pellet has burst open from Sam's paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe not.
For a moment, Nick doesn't say anything... Then a grin spreads across his face.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You cheater, you took my plan!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess it had to be one of us...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You mean, `at least` it was one of us.
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]at least[/i][/color] it was one of us.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Spartan, let's go home.
Wow, Centerscore won the Spartan Games! All thanks to you!
But what's going to happen with the rest of the money?
Find out next week!

And now...

nodes.title: Eyes on the Prize
nodes.subtitle: What should Sam do with the $100,000 prize money?

nodes.text: The day after winning the Spartan Games, Sam strides into the school...
And gets mobbed by cheering, clapping students!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Congratulations, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks, cuz!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Sam! Would you sign my poster?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There are posters of me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No... But all I had on me was this poster of an owl. It says 'Party `Fowl`'?! Ha! What a `hoot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... But all I had on me was this poster of an owl. It says 'Party [color=#e23b3b][i]Fowl[/i][/color]'?! Ha! What a [color=#e23b3b][i]hoot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Shut up, nerd! Sam, you really crushed those Spartan punks! `And` you looked hot doing it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut up, nerd! Sam, you really crushed those Spartan punks! [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] you looked hot doing it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um, thanks, and... Ew.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Way to represent Centerscore, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah! What kind of pool are you going to buy us?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pool? I think Samface knows the money should go to a new football field!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Or toward upgrading my seismic activity monitor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, everyone, I don't know how I'm going to spend the money yet...
Sam sees Nick walking alone toward class...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick!
He doesn't hear her. She tries to push through the crowd toward him, but she can't get through.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Move, people!
Just then, Zach and Jacob pass Nick. Jacob reaches out and slaps Nick's books to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha! What are you going to do about that, Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'll probably pick them up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's `real` clever. How's it feel knowing you lost $100,000 to us?
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] clever. How's it feel knowing you lost $100,000 to us?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Meh. I don't really care one way or another.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You will when you see all the cool stuff we get while you and all your Spartan pals get nothing!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah! No money for Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I like that! No money for Spartans! No money for Spartans!
Soon the chant is picked up by the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No money for Spartans! No money for Spartans!
Nick turns and sees Sam looking at him from the center of the chanting crowd!
He walks away, the hurt unmistakable...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! Wait!
Sam breaks free of the crowd and reaches Nick! He turns around...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't understand...
`IMPORTANT NEWS!`

And for the first time ever, we're letting `YOU` decide what we write!

Ben and Jessica are studying together in Jessica's room one night...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So then you just solve for X, and you got it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yay...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not the enthusiastic Jess I'm used to...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This math stuff just makes me feel stupid, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're not stupid, it's just a lot of work. Why don't you take a break?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's the Jess I know!
Jessica gets up and sits down in front of her computer...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm supposed to start tutoring the Spartans tomorrow... I hope they're as easy to tutor as you are!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I don't know what to expect considering their teachers have given them test answers for who knows `how` long!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I don't know what to expect considering their teachers have given them test answers for who knows [color=#e23b3b][i]how[/i][/color] long!

nodes.text: Jessica gasps!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just checked out your Faceplace account... You have zero friends!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I hardly ever use Faceplace.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know, but `zero` friends?! Even that nerd Andrew has, like, three friends, and he doesn't even know how to use a computer!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, but [color=#3b78e2][i]zero[/i][/color] friends?! Even that nerd Andrew has, like, three friends, and he doesn't even know how to use a computer!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sure Andrew can use a computer...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He can't! I saw him try to turn one on once by reciting it a poem!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He used the phrase, 'Boot up, foul beast!'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is it really that big of a deal?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes! It's huge! As long as you're a zero on the internet, you can't become President!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: President?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I mean... Um...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, I guess the bag is out of the cat now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Not the phrase...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...But based on some of the cats I know, it kind of makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatever. It was just an idea I had. I know how much you want to be popular...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I thought you becoming school President might be the next step! Not only would you be, like, `super` popular, you'd be super hot too!
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought you becoming school President might be the next step! Not only would you be, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]super[/i][/color] popular, you'd be super hot too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Being President makes you hot? Don't most girls think Justin's kind of gross?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh, hello? `I` dated him.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, hello? [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] dated him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I try to gloss over that `really` weird fact...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, yeah, I try to gloss over that [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] weird fact...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, if you were President, that would be, like, `the best!` I mean, I'd be the luckiest girlfriend ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, if you were President, that would be, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]the best![/i][/color] I mean, I'd be the luckiest girlfriend ever!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what do you say? Do you want to run for President this year or not?

Previously on Surviving High School...
While tutoring the Spartans in the library, an earthquake shook the foundations of Twin Branches, burying Ben, Chad, and Mark in a pile of rubble!
And now...
In the darkened library, Ben coughs...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Chad? Mark? Are you guys okay?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm all right... Chad, where are you?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Over here... I think I broke something...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hold on! Stay right there!
Ben pushes a piece of debris off of himself and scrambles over the desks and chairs toward the sound of Chad's voice.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where are you? What did you break?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: My shades! My classic shades! They're all crooked now!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you serious?! I thought you were `hurt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you serious?! I thought you were [color=#e23b3b][i]hurt![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I `am` hurt. Emotionally. These shades are my life force.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] hurt. Emotionally. These shades are my life force.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'm this close to breaking your life force in two.
The lights flicker on... All around them is the destructive aftermath of the quake...
Toppled bookcases, crumbled walls, and above them, steel beams and dangling wires exposed by the collapse of the ceiling.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh man! We've gotta get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: He's right! The Backbutters aren't supposed to die young!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Chad, stay calm! Mark, just stop sucking so much.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Sorry, bro, I can't help it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've got to see if anyone else is in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa, Braniac! You might be our tutor, but I'm pretty sure `I'm` the one who's gonna say what we do or don't do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa, Braniac! You might be our tutor, but I'm pretty sure [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one who's gonna say what we do or don't do!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And I say we forget about hanging around here, waiting for the rest of the building to fall on us the moment an aftershock hits!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Aftershock?! Aww, man, I am not sticking around for that! You guys are crazy if you think I'm going to be aftershock bait!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know that an aftershock is an earthquake and not a shark, right?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: All I know is one gets you on the water, one gets you on the land! They're `both` scary!
nodes.text_bbcode: All I know is one gets you on the water, one gets you on the land! They're [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] scary!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Exactly! So let's go! There's an exit out back!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: She's going to spend the money on Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: How she spends the money is up to her!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: No buts! It's Samantha's choice! I expect better from you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now, I'm pretty sure you two both have classes to attend to.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You remember class, right? The place you go to with the desks, books, and a teacher.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, Principal Shapiro, I remember class.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Good. That's something to get me through my day...
Later, as class wraps up, the girls from the swim team surround Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, girls!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hey, yourself!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Did you promise the Spartans that you were going to spend all the money on caviar, helicopters, and their own customized bathrooms?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I don't even know what a customized bathroom is!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: If I had a customized bathroom, it would be filled with guys!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Zero surprise all around.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There are a lot of rumors swirling around about where the money's going, and we just wanted to make sure you spend it on swim team stuff!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We can't keep swimming in my dad's backyard pool!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I agree...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Then it's settled. All the money goes toward the swim team's new Olympic-sized pool... And as a bonus, toward a trip to Italy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, I didn't say anything about...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Italian guys are `so` hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh! Italian guys are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hot!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I know! Just look at Matteo!
Matteo heads out of the room, noticing as the girls stare at him... He mumbles to himself as he leaves.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not understand this country...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You guys! I'm not going to spend the money on a trip to Italy! I'm probably not going to spend it on an `Olympic`-sized pool either...

nodes.text: If I die trying to save a bunch of photo stuff, your face is grass, Kale.

nodes.text: Spoken like a true best friend. I'm not going for photo stuff, I'm going for Howard, $ZOE, Sam, and Nick.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Samface? She's in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know, but I have to make sure!
They reach the door... And hear voices inside!
Ben flings it open!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hello?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ben?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ben, we're trapped!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Get this stuff off of us!
Ben and Spencer run over to a mass of overturned boxes and debris and start digging away until everyone is finally freed.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Cough, cough!` Ugh. Nothing quite as gross as a lungful of smoke...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough, cough![/i][/color] Ugh. Nothing quite as gross as a lungful of smoke...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben and Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, we were in a lot of trouble...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No problem! Follow us! We'll lead you out! And stay low... You want to crawl like...
The ground trembles!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's an aftershock! Get into the doorway!
The group crams itself underneath the doorframe...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard! I'm scared!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay, $ZOE. It'll pass!
Behind them, sparks shoot out of an electrical outlet!
A spark lands inside a tray of chemicals... Fire instantly spreads along the table!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fire!
The aftershock subsides...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fire! We have to get out of here quick!
$ZOE, Howard, and Sam run toward the door, but Nick stays behind.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Cough cough!` The fire's going to torch my pictures! I can't just leave them!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough cough![/i][/color] The fire's going to torch my pictures! I can't just leave them!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! They're just pictures!
Ben plunges into the room.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer! Make sure everyone else gets out! Nick and I will be right behind you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't be stupid! It's a fire, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We'll be okay!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on!
Spencer pushes Sam, Howard, and $ZOE toward the school's entrance...
Meanwhile, Nick gathers up whatever pictures he can!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There's a box in the hallway! Put them in there!
Ben grabs some pictures...
...And drops them into the box!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We could get Erik's arm out of the trap if we could put some oil in there... Something that would make his arm slick enough...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're in a forest, Ben, not a grocery store!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Taylor! Do you have any hairspray on you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She's not going to have hairspray on her during the Spart...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Here.
Taylor reaches into one of her boots and hands a small bottle of hairspray to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're in the wild! You never know when you're going to have a bad hair day...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hurry, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guys, look around for any plants that look like this!
Ben grabs several leaves off a nearby plant.
A minute later, the nerds return with a handful of leaves.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good!
Ben starts cramming the leaves into the bottle of hairspray.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The compounds in the hairspray should react with these leaves...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It should create a new solution with the right viscosity for freeing Erik.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Blah blah blah, biscuity shmiscuity. All I know is my hairspray is ruined!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Guys! Shh! Listen!
Everyone quiets down... Just enough to hear the sound of the Spartans coming toward them!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hurry!
Ben applies the new solution to the trap around Erik's arm...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope this works!
Ben pulls as hard as he can... And jerks Erik's arm free!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Come on!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Grab Erik, and let's get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guys, wait!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: There's no time!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We know where they're going to be...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, spraying us with paintballs in about thirty seconds!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I mean they're coming to this trap...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And what happens in Ogres 'N' Elves when goblins return to an activated trap?
Slowly, collectively, the nerds smile...
Thirty seconds later, a group of Spartans stands about a hundred yards away from the trap.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The alarm definitely went off. I just don't understand why there isn't someone stuck inside the trap.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Marcus! Go investigate!
One lone freshman Spartan steps out of the pack...

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: This is so stupid.
Meanwhile, the nerds are huddled behind a fallen tree nearby...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: On three guys...
Marcus inspects the trap from close up...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One...
Marcus calls back to Chad and the others...

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: There's nothing here, Chad!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Something set off the alarm!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Two...
Marcus looks back to the trap... He takes another cautious step.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Three!
The nerds fire their guns at Marcus, instantly blanketing him with paint!

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Argh!
Before the rest of the Spartans can react, the nerds dash off into the woods, safe...
For now!
Congratulations! You helped Ben patch up some of the strained relations between him and the nerds!
But what about the rest of the Centerscore contestants? Let's see what happened to $ZOE!

Later that day, Chad stands in front of a huge wooded area, gazing out at a series of barricades, trenches, and abandoned houses.
Carson and Preston stroll up behind him.
Here we are, boys... The site of the 2012 Spartan Games... And where we'll have our greatest victory!
I have to admit, Chad, I'm kind of impressed. How did you convince the Spartan Board of Trustees to finance the games now that there's no more Spartan?!
Oh, it took a little wheeling and dealing... Most of them were horrified about the idea of investing their money in a public school...
Carson shudders.
But when I stressed how good this could be for the community as a whole... A pure competition to determine survival of the fittest... Well, they couldn't say no!
I gotta say, you seem different, Chad. Smarter... Craftier... More eloquent...
Have you been reading books?
Very funny, Carson. If you must know, I've been talking to Percy over the phone, and he's been giving me some guidance on what to do...
Let's just say he's more than a little interested in getting revenge.
And this is revenge?
Are you kidding me?
Those poor Centerscore twerps are going to join these games with no idea what they're in for. They're probably expecting riddle contests and three-legged hops...
They have `no` idea they're in for a `brutal` paintball battle-royale that only the very strongest can endure!
Friend will be turned against friend! Couples will be torn apart! Whole social groups will splinter and attack each other!
And we'll be there, hidden in the chaos, taking out all our enemies and reveling in their pain!
Not to take away from your increasingly creepy scheming, but aren't you going a little over-the-top? I mean some of these kids aren't bad...
Chad spins around and grabs Carson's collar!
Centerscore destroyed Spartan High and the Immortals! They took `everything` from us... And now they want us to play nice and act like we're overjoyed to join their crappy little school?
`Never!`
Chad shoves Carson away.
Okay, okay, calm down... No need to go all psycho on me...
Either you're with me, or you're against me. What's it going to be?
I'm with you!
Carson sighs and steps forward.
I guess I'm with you, too. Just do me a favor and give me a warning next time you're going to go on a supervillain monologue.
Chad grins and turns back to the field.
First, we crush them in the games. Then, when I have the money and the Presidency, I'll crush them every day of their lives!
No one... `No one...` Makes a fool of Chad Slater!
See that? That right there? `That` would've been a good time to warn me.
Shut up, Carson.
A grueling, three-day battle-royale? Friend against friend? Couples torn apart? That sounds terrifying!
What `are` the Spartan Games? Find out next week!

We saw why some students decided to sign up... But what about the rest?
Let's flash back and find out!
I don't know, Andrew... It sounds `really` dangerous...
Oh, it will be... But is there ever glory without danger? Is there fortune without challenge? Is there `good thing` without `bad thing?!`
I'm confused. Are we talking about real-life or about Ogres 'N' Elves?
I can never tell the difference!
I'm talking about both! We spend all of our time pretending to be heroes, imagining that we're fighting epic battles...
This is our chance to do it for real!
Plus... $100,000 could buy one heck of a brand new computer lab...
And in the Auto Shop...
I don't know, Kenji... This feels `awfully` like school spirit...
Is this going to be another float situation?!
No, and jeez, are you ever gonna let that go? I'm `not` saying we should do it for our school...
I'm saying we should do it because paintball battles are awesome!
Hmm... Convincing...
And in the football locker room...
This is our chance, guys! This is our fight! This is for our field and for our honor and for the creepy way they're always looking at our cheerleaders!
We are Lizards... And they will hear us roar!
Or growl! Or hiss! Or whatever it is that Lizards technically do!
`GO LIZARDS!`
They're going down!
Spencer `SMASH!`
And in a classroom...
You sure you want to do this, Manda-Panda? It'll get pretty ugly out there...
Those Spartan guys need to pay! They said your parties were lamer than a sewing circle! I don't know what that is, but it sounds lame!
They said `what?!` Oh, they are going down...
And finally, in the parking lot...
I don't get it, dude, how is this legit? I'm not even a student anymore...
Oh, I know... But as it turns out, due to thirty-five unfulfilled detentions, you're still listed in the student registry! Which makes you eligible for the Games!
Yeah, but what do I care if Spartan or Centerscore wins?
That's the beauty of it! Everyone is so focused on which school is gonna win, they've missed the whole point of the contest...
It's not a `team` that wins! It's just one person! And that person can spend the money however they want!
All we have to do is team up with whoever is strongest...
Then betray them at the last minute!
Heh... I like the way you think, Ryan...
And I like the way you punch things! And that's why we're gonna win!
Uh oh... The rest of the students probably aren't counting on that!

We've seen what Ben and $ZOE are up to...
But how is the rest of Centerscore faring in the Spartan Games?
For Centerscore!
The swim team lays down cover fire for the retreating Centerscorians!
As the Spartans duck behind the hill, the swim team makes a break for it and runs into the forest for cover.
Deep in the forest, the swim team comes to a rest.
I think we finally put enough distance between us and those Spartan punks!
I can't believe they ambushed us!
`I` can. They've done this before.
They totally have the advantage.
What do we do now?
I'm not sure...
Sam scans the trees for an answer.
Through a small break in the forest, she sees a building off in the distance.
Look! Over there! I see a place where we can probably hole up or look for supplies.
The other girls look out into the distance.
Geez, that's really far away. Just how big `is` this property?!
Unbelievably big.
Come on. Let's just start walking.
After a long walk, Sam and the swim team find themselves in a large building.
It's a pool house! The pool is beautiful!
Wow, these Spartan boys are rich.
Yeah, yeah, don't be too impressed. They're rich, but arrogant.
Okay, now to find supplies.
Sam walks to the far end of the room where a row of lockers sits. She opens one.
Nothing.
She opens the next one.
Nothing... Come on... These guys have money bleeding out their ears, and these are all empty?
The next one she opens makes her cry out.
Hey, guys, take a look at this...
Sam points into the locker.
How fitting.
That's great!
These should give us a little bit of an edge, right?
Meanwhile, at another clearing in another part of the forest...
Colt is drawing diagrams in the dirt while Denni watches.
Okay, so they got the drop on us first, but that doesn't mean we're down for the count.
I didn't realize war would turn you into a man of many sports metaphors.
Hey...
I'm joking. Go on. You were saying?
So there are a bunch of Spartan guys between us and winning, right?
I see where you're going with this.
So we just blast them!
A little less clear now.
Our plan is going to be to isolate and shoot each one.
Look, between your one-liners and my brawn, we can take each of them down.
You don't want to take Chad down first?
Can't. He's too well protected. We have to whittle down his forces if we're going to have a shot at winning.
Okay, I'm good for this...
For the next few moments, Denni and Colt talk strategy. At last, Colt stands up.
Ready, Tiny Hipster?
Denni pumps her gun and stands beside him.
When you are.

It looks like Colt and Sam had some pretty exciting adventures... But what about the other Centerscore students?
Find out now!
In a forest grove not far from where Colt and Denni are, the nerds go sprinting through the trees...
Come on, Dex! They're closing in!
Dex slows down, wheezing!
I can't run any faster! My legs are disproportionately small!
Paintballs whizz from behind and splatter on trees around them!
Are you kidding me?!
Taylor slides to a stop, grabs Dex, and hoists him over her shoulder!
`Ooooof!`
Come... `On!`
Taylor sprints as hard as she can, carrying Dex!
I used to be... Popular! I used to go to... Parties!
How did it come... To `this?!`
I think it's pretty fun! It's like you're a caveman, and you're carrying me back to your cave!
Taylor pauses for a second and then tosses Dex down.
No! Not a caveman rejection! That's the worst kind there is!
Taylor grits her teeth and keeps running! Moments later, she bursts into a glade with Brendan, Ben and Erik!
What happened to Dex?
Sorry, guys. They got him.
And on the other side of the estate, the rebels have taken refuge in an abandoned shop. They gather around an elaborate make-shift tank, made by strapping their paintball guns to an old car...
I still don't know how I feel about this, Kenji... We could be out there, blasting Spartan losers, and instead, we've spent the whole time in here, tinkering around on this hunk of junk?
It's not a hunk of junk... It's the Battlehog 9000, and it's gonna win us this thing!
Yeah, but does it even work?
Of course it works! Watch! All I have to do is start the engine!
Kenji reaches in and revs the engine. For one moment, the tank whirrs to life...
And then it backfires! The paintballs guns explode, splattering Kenji and Megan with paint.
...Seriously?
I suppose there were... A few quirks... To iron out...
Meanwhile, in the Centerscore cafeteria, all of the students who have been taken out sit and watch the video streams...
Come on, Centerscore, come on! You can do this!
Go on, Amanda! Bring home the bacon!
Make 'em pay, Ben! Make 'em pay!
Uh, guys? Not to burst your bubbles... But have you seen what the Spartans are up to?
All the Centerscore students turn to look at the monitor $Scott is pointing to...
Oh no...
They can't be...
We're doomed!
What are the Spartans up to?

Sam tries to shoot, but her left hand slips on the gun!
She drops it!
By the time, she picks it up again, the Spartan boys have drawn their weapons.
Well, this looks bad...
It's about to get even worse.
The Spartans unleash a barrage of paintballs! Sam and Nick try to protect themselves from the onslaught, but they're hit!
Oh no! We're out of the game!
And you know what that means?
`Spartan wins.`
The next week, all of Centerscore watches in disgust as the money won in the Spartan Games gets lavished on the Spartans.
In the school hallway, personal butlers attend to each Spartan boy.
Why yes, Butler Alfred, I would like you to take my place in math class.
And don't forget to jot the homework down for you to finish later!
In the cafeteria, personal wait staff set down steaming plates of expensive food for them.
Is that steak and lobster with caviar for me? Why thank you!
I will eat them with my gold forks and knives now...
And outside, helicopters wait patiently to take the Spartan boys home.
It's awesome being rich! Spartan is the best! Spartan is the best!
Meanwhile, all the Centerscore students huddle together in the one classroom that the Spartans have left for them.
This sucks! They built their private swimming pools and their stretch limo parking lots all over our school!
At least they let us have something...
Yeah, this crappy classroom with no air conditioning, a leaky ceiling, and lights that don't work!
Ugh, Sam, this is all your fault! If you hadn't messed it all up...
Leave her alone! We all got shot.
No, Taylor's right. I shouldn't have crumbled under the pressure. I shouldn't have let you all down...
If only there were some way I could do it all again...
Sam has failed.
Try again and see if you can nail these Spartan creeps! They really deserve it!

The dust has settled. Most of the players are gone.
Nick and Sam stand alone in the town square...
And a few remaining Spartans stand on the other end!
Nick, what should we do?
I'm sorry I have to do this, Sam, but...
Nick holds up his gun and trains it on her.
Nick! What are you doing? I thought we had a truce!
Sorry, Samantha, but whatever you thought we had... It's over.
I... I don't know what to say.
Sam's hand goes for her back pocket.
Don't even bother going for your gun. It's out of ammo.
Sam freezes.
How do you know that?
I unloaded it while you were sleeping. See, I've been waiting for this moment.
Wait, so what you're telling me is that you've conned me this entire time?!
Yeah. Now you're coming with me.
Nick prods her forward with the paintball gun, and he makes her march down the long lane to the porch where Chad, Carson, and Lee are standing.
I'd advise you not to come any closer. Or we'll shoot. You know we're good for it.
I wouldn't advise that. I'm on your side.
I say we shoot him anyway.
Hey, before you start painting away, check this out.
I brought something just for you.
Nick pushes Sam forward.
Hey! Watch it!
What's the meaning of this?
If you're really on our side, why don't you shoot her yourself?
Because I know she's been giving you some trouble, and I thought I'd give you the honor.
What do you say? Shoot the last Centerscore student and end these games once and for all?
You're a jerk! You're the jerkiest jerk I know!
I can't believe I `trusted` you!
Thank you, Nick... We'll be glad to get rid of her. Lee, why don't you take this one?
Whatever makes these games go faster...
Lee's hand goes to his gun...
And that's when Sam pulls her own gun on him!
Not so fast, sucker!
That doesn't scare us. It's empty. I heard Nick say so.
Well, the funny thing about that is...
Nick `lied.`
Sam points her gun at Lee...
Get them!
Shoot!
What do you do?
Sam takes out Lee!
One down!
Aw, this will take forever to wash out of my leather jacket!
Sam jerks her gun to Carson...
Get them!
What do you do?
Shoot!
Miss!
Slip!
Sam takes out Carson!
My white shirt!
And finally, Sam jerks her gun to Chad...
Get them!
What do you do?
Shoot!
Drop it!
Slip!
Slip up!

For Centerscore! And for everyone you've humiliated and hunted down.
`Nooooo!!!`
You're going to regret this...
Careful, Chad... When I win the Spartan Games, I have a feeling you're the one who's going to be regretting a lot of the things you've done.
Spartans, to me!
The other Spartans hang back.
Whatever.
What did you say, Carson?
Don't you get it, Chad? It's over for us. Forget about being the Spartans.
Yeah. We'll be lucky if we even see any of that money.
They walk off, leaving Chad behind.
Chad walks off the field, dejected and alone.

A couple days later...
Welcome all to the closing ceremonies of the 77th Spartan Games.
We shall begin the proceedings by awarding the prizes.
First, I'd like to invite the winner of the 77th Spartan Games up to the stage...
Congratulations, Samantha!
Sam steps onstage to the applause of the Centerscore students and the broody silence of the Spartan crowd.
For your bravery, resilience, and courage in the games, our Spartan sponsors are proud to award you the Spartan Crown!
This is it!
I'm finally going to get a crown!
Here it is! The stunning Spartan Helm!
Shapiro has a couple students bring out a stunning, golden helmet with a rich red plume!
What is that?
It's the Spartan's traditional crown. It represents the true warrior, their mascot.
But I thought... That isn't a...
That's a helmet!
Yes, it is now yours to wear as you like.
Sam takes the helmet and looks it over.
Well, I guess it wouldn't really be my crown unless it was also a symbol of war.
Sam holds it up, and Centerscore cheers!
And of course we can't forget about the cash prize of $100,000!
Shapiro produces a huge check for Sam to hold.
As stipulated, this money is set aside for school repairs and improvements.
But how to spend the money is entirely up to you.
I hope I don't have to remind you that the teachers have always wanted another cushy chair in the lounge...
I'll take that into consideration.
From the crowd, the Centerscore students start calling out to Sam.
Use it for good, Sam!
Use it for the swim team!
Use it for the cheerleaders!
Use it on a date! With me!
Sam shakes her head and smiles.
I'll use it for Centerscore!
She's going to use it `all` for Centerscore?
Uh-oh! The Spartan Games may be over, but it looks like there's going to be more fighting on the horizon...
Just what will Sam do with the $100,000?
Find out next time on Surviving High School!

Now that Centerscore and Spartans have come together to co-exist, let's see how they're getting along!
After school, Hector and Carson are talking...
Even though I'm happy with Amanda, I still help struggling guys out with the ladies, using my six-part attraction technique, the H.E.C.T.O.R. method!
It's never failed! For a small fee, I'll let you in on the secrets, my new party pal!
I'd take your offer if I wasn't also in the attraction business, bro. My system,`The C.A.R.S.O.N`, is perfect.
The C.A.R.S.O.N?
Yeah. You tell me yours, I'll tell you mine?
You're on! You first!
It's simple... `C`heetah fur coat, `A`ftershave from Burma, `R`hinestones, `S`nakeskin wallet, `O`strich eggs... Always keep one nearby, and `N`ever upset your limo driver.
Pretty self-explanatory, right?
Uh, yeah... Mine's pretty much the same stuff.
On the football field, Chad, wearing football pads, rides his horse up to the football players.
Hey, guys. What position do you think suits me best?
Dude! How many times do I have to tell you?! There aren't any horses in football!
Are you sure? How are you supposed to get from one end of this big field to the other?
You run!
That... That can't be right. I'd perspire!
The football players shake their heads.
Uh... Why do you have a mallet?
To, you know, hit the ol' pigskin around. That's a phrase, right?
Forget the mallet. What position do you think you'd be good at? Quarterback? Runningback? Cornerback?
Uh... Horseback? Is that a position?
The football players sigh...
This is going to take a while...
Meanwhile, in the science lab, Preston and the rest of the nerds huddle around a complicated gizmo.
Excellent circuitry work on the seismic activity monitor, Dex!
Thanks! We should be able to capture even tiny tremors with this vibra-tab.
And you can monitor earthquake frequencies with the oscilloscope?
Precisely! This needle over here lets us know if there are any significant shifts in the tectonic plates!
I never thought I'd say this... But could we be `less` nerdy and just play some Ogres 'N' Elves?
Sure!
The nerds set themselves up around an expansive fantasy map...
If I remember correctly, my one-armed giant had just discovered a friendly troop of orcs!
Erik! They tied you to a stick and danced around it, wielding torches and drooling. I don't think they're friendly... I think they're planning on eating you.
They'll change their minds once they see that I'm friendly too!
Don't worry, Erik... My mage is cloaked among the orcs. I'll save you!
As the nerds get wrapped up in play, no one is watching Dex's seismic activity monitor...
No one sees the needle begin to twitch...
Slightly at first, then more...
And more!
What does this mean for Twin Branches?! Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!

Two minutes earlier, on the other side of campus...
Colt and Denni sneak into an empty classroom through an unlocked window. Colt holds it open for her...
Watch yourself...
Hee hee! I've never done this before!
You'd better get used to sneaking, Princess!
What else do I have to look forward to?

Let's see... Deactivating security systems in rich people's vacation homes, avoiding the sleepy dog that guards my neighbors' backyard pool, and slipping past the security guards at the movie theater so we can catch a free show using the Colt discount.
That sounded a lot like `sneaking,` `sneaking,` and `more sneaking?`
What can I say? You get what you pay for.
I don't remember `paying` for you...
Aww, crap!
What? Do I owe money to the Colt store?
I just remembered, I left something in my locker... A gift for you.
What is it?
Heh. I'm not a sucker. It's a surprise.
I like surprises...
Can you wait here, Princess? I'll be right back...
I'll be waiting...
Colt slips out of the classroom and bangs open his locker. He pulls out a delicate red rose and hides it in his jacket.
Then, he checks the hall and opens the door...
I brought you this...
The earthquake begins...
What the?!
Before either of them can move, the wall behind Denni cracks!
`Denni!`
He runs toward her, but it's too late! The wall splits, the ceiling collapses, and Denni is buried in a pile of rubble!
`Denni! No!`
Oh no! What's going to happen to Denni, Ben, and all the students of Twin Branches? Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!

In the hospital, Ben knocks on the door of Denni's hospital room...
Ben!
Hey, Tweed, come on in.
I was just going to pick up some food for Princess here. You want something?
I'm good. Thanks.
Colt leaves, and Ben takes a seat at the edge of Denni's bed.
So... Uh...
What do the doctors say?
My leg's pretty busted. Turns out that legs aren't meant to be crushed under a mountain of concrete.
I'm sorry...
It's okay. They keep telling me it'll heal.
That's good news...
Denni takes a deep breath...
How about you, huh? Ben, my hero.
Heh. I think your hero just left to get you some food.
Maybe I'm lucky... Maybe I've got two heroes.
Or unlucky. I think most people don't actually need `one,` let alone two.
Yeah, I guess I'll have to swear off megalomaniacal jerks with access to helicopters and, you know, walls.
That second one's going to be tough...
Hee hee... I've missed this.
What?
Talking to you like this.
Yeah... You know, I'm... I'm not going to let that happen again.
Uh... You can't prevent an earthquake, Ben.
Heh. No... I mean, I'm not going to let our friendship disappear like it did.
We should be friends... And not just on Faceplace... Real life friends.
I couldn't agree more!
So, how's it going with Colt? He, uh, he seems to really care about you.
He does!
Also, based on our last talk, I think I'm apparently going to be doing a lot of `sneaking...`
Heh. That seems about right.
Hey, what about Lee? I heard he's in here too...
I was going to check on him after I checked on you...
What? Go see what's up with him and then let me know!
Heh. If you think I'm leaving you by yourself, you're crazy.
You `have` changed.
A little while later, Colt comes back with food, and Ben leaves to check on Lee...
Ben steps into Lee's room...
And catches him and Paige making out!
Whoa! Sorry!
Knock, ever?
It's all right, Paige. What's up, Ben?
I just wanted to make sure you were okay.
No complaints!
I'm alive, I'm with a girl I really like...
Awww...
And I'm a part of Twin Branches...
How could I not be okay?
Heh. That's an unusual perspective.
What do you mean?
Well, I just have this feeling that a lot's going to change now because of the earthquake...
I mean... I know `I` have...
I'm just wondering what else will.
It looks like Ben and Denni have patched up their friendship!
But what's going to happen to the students of Twin Branches in the aftermath of the earthquake?
Find out in the next season of Surviving High School!
